global.meta.description: Medsafar tana taimaka wa marasa lafiya daga ƙasashen waje su samu jinya a Indiya. Muna shirya asibiti, likita, ƙiyasin kuɗi a rubuce, biza, tafiya, masauki da kulawa bayan jinya.

global.faq.heading: Tambayoyin da marasa lafiya ke yi
global.faq.items.0.question: Nawa Medsafar take karɓa daga gare ni?
global.faq.items.0.answer: Babu komai don shirin jinya da ƙiyasin kuɗi. Kuna biyan asibiti kuɗin jinya da kuɗaɗen tafiya da masauki da aka saba. Duk abin da Medsafar za ta karɓa ana rubuta shi kafin ku amince.
global.faq.items.1.question: Me ya sa babu farashi a wannan shafi?
global.faq.items.1.answer: Domin ainihin adadi ya dogara da rahotanninku, asibiti da tsawon zamanku. Inda asibiti ya ba mu farashin fakitinsa, suna a shafin asibitin a matsayin jagora. Ko ta yaya, muna aiko muku da ƙiyasin kuɗi a rubuce wanda aka shirya don al'amarinku.
global.faq.items.2.question: Shin Medsafar asibiti ce?
global.faq.items.2.answer: A'a. Medsafar mai sauƙaƙa tafiye-tafiyen jinya ce. Asibitoci da likitoci masu zaman kansu a Indiya ne ke ba da jinya. Mu muna shirya duk abin da ke kewaye da ita.
global.faq.items.3.question: Waɗanne rahotanni zan aika?
global.faq.items.3.answer: Duk abin da kuke da shi: wasiƙar likita, hotunan na'ura, sakamakon gwajin jini ko takardar sallama daga asibiti. Hotuna masu kyau da aka ɗauka da waya sun isa.
global.faq.items.4.question: Yaushe wani zai amsa?
global.faq.items.4.answer: Mai kula da al'amura zai karɓi tambayarku ya tuntuɓe ku ta WhatsApp ko ta kira. Ra'ayin likita yana ɗaukar lokaci fiye da haka, domin dole ƙwararren likita ya karanta rahotannin.
global.faq.items.5.question: Kwana nawa zan yi a Indiya?
global.faq.items.5.answer: Ya danganta da abin da kuke buƙata. Duba lafiya ko ƙaramar jinya na iya ɗaukar 'yan kwanaki kawai. Babbar tiyata, kamar maye gurbin gwiwa ko kwatangwalo, yawanci tana nufin mako biyu zuwa uku, don ku murmure kafin jirgin komawa gida. Shirin jinyarku zai gaya muku abin da za ku yi tsammani.
global.faq.items.6.question: Shin ɗan uwa zai iya tafiya tare da ni?
global.faq.items.6.answer: I, kuma yana da amfani a sami wani tare da ku. Bizar jinya ta Indiya tana ba da izinin masu rakiya, don haka muna ƙara su a wasiƙar gayyatar biza kuma muna shirya musu ɗaki kusa da asibiti.
global.faq.items.7.question: Yaya ake biyan kuɗin jinya?
global.faq.items.7.answer: Kuna biyan asibiti, bisa rubutaccen ƙiyasin da ya ba ku. Wasu asibitoci suna karɓar ƙaramin ajiya don tabbatar da kwantar da ku, sauran kuma ana biya bayan kun iso. Muna duba kowane adadi tare da ku tun da wuri.
global.faq.items.8.question: Shin Medsafar tana taimakawa bayan na koma gida?
global.faq.items.8.answer: I. Muna shirya kiran bibiya da likitanku, muna raba rahotanninku da likitanku na gida idan kuna so, kuma muna ci gaba da tuntuɓar ku yayin da kuke murmurewa.
global.faq.items.9.question: Me ke faruwa da rahotannin lafiyata?
global.faq.items.9.answer: Suna zuwa ga likitoci da asibitocin da ke duba al'amarinku, ba wani wuri dabam ba. Kuna duba akwati don ba da izini kafin mu raba komai.

catalog.treatments.meta.title: Jiyya a Indiya. Medsafar India.
catalog.treatments.meta.description: Jiyyar da Medsafar ke shiryawa a asibitoci abokan hulɗa a Indiya, an rarraba su bisa fanni. Ku nemi shirin jinya kyauta don al'amarinku.
catalog.treatments.heading: Jiyyar da muke shiryawa a Indiya
catalog.treatments.intro: Ku nemi jinyar da aka shawarce ku ku yi, ko ku gaya mana abin da ke damun ku, likita zai ba da shawara.
catalog.treatments.note: An rubuta kowane bayani da kalmomi masu sauƙi, kuma ana yi masa alama har sai likita ya duba shi.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.heading: Abin da ke shafar kuɗin
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.intro: Kowane mara lafiya yana samun nasa ƙiyasin, a rubuce, daga asibiti. Waɗannan su ne abubuwan da ke canza shi.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.factors.0: Irin ɗakuna, kayan aiki da kuɗaɗen gudanarwa sun bambanta daga wani asibiti zuwa wani.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.factors.1: Kuɗin likitan tiyata ya dogara da gogewarsa da yadda tiyatar take da wahala.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.factors.2: Tiyata ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot, da kamfanin da ya ƙera duk wani abin da za a saka a jiki, na iya canza farashin.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.factors.3: Wasu cututtuka, jinyar da aka yi a baya da gwaje-gwajen da kuke buƙata kafin jinya duk suna da tasiri.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.factors.4: Kwanaki a asibiti, duk wani lokaci a sashen kulawa ta musamman da makonnin da kuke murmurewa a Indiya.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.factors.5: Jinyar motsa jiki (physiotherapy), magungunan da za ku tafi da su gida da ziyarar bibiya ana ƙara su ne kawai idan likitanku ya buƙace su.
catalog.treatments.detail.cost.note: Ƙiyasin ba na ƙarshe ba ne har sai likita ya duba ku a Indiya. Idan wani abu ya canza, muna bayyana shi kafin ku amince.

about.meta.title: Game da Medsafar India.
about.meta.description: Medsafar tana haɗa marasa lafiya da ke wajen Indiya da gogaggun likitoci da asibitoci masu fannoni da yawa a Indiya, kuma tana shirya tafiyar da ke kewaye da jinyarsu.
about.heading: Kyakkyawar jinya a Indiya, ba tare da wahala ba.
about.intro: Medsafar mai sauƙaƙa tafiye-tafiyen jinya ce. Ba asibiti ba ce kuma ba ta ba da jinya.
about.who.heading: Su wane ne mu
about.who.body.0: Medsafar tana taimaka wa mutanen da ke zaune a wajen Indiya su samu kulawar lafiya mai inganci a Indiya a farashi mai adalci. Muna haɗa kowane mara lafiya da gogaggun likitoci, likitocin tiyata da asibitoci masu fannoni da yawa, kuma muna kula da duk abin da ke kewaye da jinyar don mara lafiya da iyalinsa su mai da hankali kan samun sauƙi.
about.who.body.1: Medsafar India reshe ne na Travgrub Private Limited, kamfanin tafiye-tafiye da ke Mumbai. Shi ya sa muke kula da ɓangaren tafiya da kanmu: wasiƙar gayyatar biza, jiragen sama, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi da wurin zama.

about.founder.name: Vicky Prabhu
about.founder.role: Wanda ya kafa kuma Babban Darakta, Medsafar India
about.founder.picture.alt: Vicky Prabhu, wanda ya kafa kuma Babban Daraktan Medsafar
about.founder.quote.text: Medsafar tana nan ne don mayar da burina na tsawon rayuwa na yi wa bil'adama hidima zuwa aiki: taimaka wa marasa lafiya su samu kulawar da suke buƙata, da kawo bege ga iyalai a lokutansu mafi wahala.
about.founder.story.heading: Dalilin da ya sa na fara Medsafar
about.founder.story.body.0: Kullum ina son yin wani abu mai ma'ana ga mutane. Shekarun da na yi tare da Rotary sun nuna mini cewa ko ƙaramin aikin alheri na iya kawo babban canji a rayuwar wani.
about.founder.story.body.1: Gudanar da Travgrub ya koya mini cewa tafiya ta shafi mutane ne, ba tikiti ba. Taimakon biza, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi, wurin zama, wanda za ku kira idan kuna buƙatar taimako: ƙananan abubuwa ne da ke kawo kwanciyar hankali na gaske a ƙasar da ba ku sani ba.
about.founder.story.body.2: Idan wani ya kamu da rashin lafiya mai tsanani, duk iyalin suna ɗaukar tsoron. Medsafar tana amfani da gogewata ta tafiye-tafiye ta hanya mafi ma'ana: tsayawa tare da marasa lafiya da iyalansu, don kada su taɓa jin su kaɗai ne.
about.founder.contact.body: Medsafar ƙarama ce da gangan. Vicky da kansa yake kula da kowane mara lafiya, daga saƙon farko har zuwa bibiya a gida.
about.founder.contact.label: Aika wa Vicky saƙo a WhatsApp
about.mission.heading: Abin da muke nan dominsa
about.mission.items.0.title: Manufarmu
about.mission.items.0.body: Taimaka wa marasa lafiya su samu kulawar da ta dace a Indiya, da kawo bege ga iyalansu, mara lafiya ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
about.mission.items.1.title: Hangen nesanmu
about.mission.items.1.body: Mu zama suna amintacce ga marasa lafiya daga Afirka, Gabas ta Tsakiya, yankin CIS da Kudancin Asiya, ba tare da rasa kulawa ta kai da kai ba.
about.mission.items.2.title: Mayar da alheri
about.mission.items.2.body: Yayin da Medsafar ke girma, wani ƙayyadadden kaso na kuɗin shigarta zai taimaka wa marasa lafiya da ba za su iya biyan jinyar da suke buƙata ba, tare da bayyanannun ƙa'idoji kan wanda ya cancanta.
about.values.heading: Alƙawarinmu ga kowane iyali
about.values.intro: Tura wanda kuke ƙauna zuwa ƙasar waje don jinya abin tsoro ne. Ga abin da za ku iya dogara da shi.
about.values.items.0.title: Ku ba wani al'amari kawai ba ne
about.values.items.0.body: Ku iyali ne da ke amincewa da mu a ɗaya daga cikin lokuta mafi wahala a rayuwarku. Muna ɗaukar wannan amana da muhimmanci.
about.values.items.1.title: Gaskiya, a kodayaushe
about.values.items.1.body: Babu wanda zai iya yin alƙawarin sakamakon jinya. Muna alƙawarin gaskiya, kulawa da bayyanannun bayanai, don ku yanke shawara da tabbaci.
about.values.items.2.title: Ba za ku taɓa kasancewa ku kaɗai ba
about.values.items.2.body: Asibitoci, ƙwararrun likitoci, tafiya da wurin zama, an shirya muku, tare da wanda za ku koma gare shi a kowane mataki.
about.does.heading: Abin da Medsafar ke yi
about.does.items.0: Tana aika rahotanninku ga gogaggen likita a asibitin abokin hulɗa
about.does.items.1: Tana dawo muku da shirin jinya da aka yi don al'amarinku, tare da ƙiyasin kuɗi a rubuce daga asibiti
about.does.items.2: Tana ba ku mai tsara al'amura a Indiya, wanda za a iya samu a kowane lokaci
about.does.items.3: Tana shirya wasiƙar gayyatar biza, jiragen sama, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi da wurin zama
about.does.items.4: Tana hulɗa da kamfanin inshorarku idan inshora ta ɗauki nauyin jinyarku
about.does.items.5: Tana kiyaye sirrin bayananku da rahotanninku
about.does.items.6: Tana bayyana kowane kuɗi kafin ku amince
about.doesNot.heading: Abin da Medsafar ba ta yi
about.doesNot.items.0: Ba da jinya ko shawarar likita
about.doesNot.items.1: Yanke shawara kan jinyarku. Wannan tsakaninku da likita ne
about.doesNot.items.2: Ƙayyade kuɗin jinya. Ƙiyasin daga asibitin da ke jinyar yake zuwa
about.selection.heading: Yadda ake zaɓar likitoci da asibitoci
about.selection.body: Muna aiki ne kawai da likitoci da likitocin tiyata masu gogewar fiye da shekaru 15, a asibitoci masu fannoni da yawa a Indiya. Al'amarinku yana zuwa ga ƙwararren likita a fannin cutarku, wanda yake karanta rahotanninku kafin a shirya komai.

contact.form.heading: Samu shirin jinyarku kyauta
contact.form.intro: Yana ɗaukar minti ɗaya. Babu kuɗi, babu wajibci.
contact.steps.heading: Abin da zai biyo baya
contact.steps.items.0.title: Za mu kira ku
contact.steps.items.0.body: Mai kula da al'amura zai tuntuɓe ku, ya saurari abin da kuke buƙata kuma ya nemi duk rahotannin da kuke da su.
contact.steps.items.1.title: Ƙwararren likita yana duba al'amarinku
contact.steps.items.1.body: Gogaggen likita a asibitin abokin hulɗa yana karanta rahotanninku ya ba da shawarar shiri, tare da ƙiyasin kuɗi a rubuce.
contact.steps.items.2.title: Muna shirya tafiyar
contact.steps.items.2.body: Da zarar kun yanke shawara, muna shirya wasiƙar gayyatar biza, jiragen sama, ɗaukar ku a filin jirgi, masauki da mai tsara al'amura a Indiya.
contact.why.heading: Dalilin da ya sa marasa lafiya ke zaɓar Medsafar
contact.why.items.0.title: Manyan likitoci kaɗai
contact.why.items.0.body: Al'amarinku yana zuwa ga ƙwararren likita mai gogewar fiye da shekaru 15, a asibiti mai fannoni da yawa.
contact.why.items.1.title: Bayyanannun kuɗaɗe, tun da wuri
contact.why.items.1.body: Ƙiyasin yana zuwa a rubuce daga asibiti. Kuna ganin kowane kuɗi kafin ku amince da komai.
contact.why.items.2.title: Ƙungiya ɗaya, daga farko har ƙarshe
contact.why.items.2.body: Daga saƙon farko har zuwa bibiya a gida, mai kula da al'amura ɗaya ne ke kula da ku da iyalinku.
contact.faq.heading: Kafin ku tuntuɓe mu
contact.faq.items.0.question: Shin zan biya wani abu don samun shirin jinya?
contact.faq.items.0.answer: A'a. Ra'ayin likita, shirin jinya da ƙiyasin kuɗi kyauta ne, kuma ba ku da wajibcin ci gaba.
contact.faq.items.1.question: Har yaushe zan zauna a Indiya?
contact.faq.items.1.answer: Ya danganta da jinyar. Gwaje-gwaje da ƙananan ayyukan jinya na iya ɗaukar 'yan kwanaki. Manyan tiyatoci, kamar maye gurbin gaɓa, yawanci suna nufin mako biyu zuwa uku, har da lokacin murmurewa kafin ku koma gida. Shirinku yana ba da tsawon zaman da ake tsammani.
contact.faq.items.2.question: Shin wani zai iya zuwa tare da ni?
contact.faq.items.2.answer: I, kuma muna ba da shawarar hakan. Dangi ko aboki zai iya tafiya a matsayin mai rakiyarku. Muna saka shi a wasiƙar gayyatar biza kuma muna nema masa ɗaki kusa da asibiti.
contact.faq.items.3.question: Yaya zan biya kuɗin jinya?
contact.faq.items.3.answer: Kuna biyan asibiti kai tsaye, bisa rubutaccen ƙiyasinsa. Wasu asibitoci suna neman ƙaramin ajiya don tanadar kwantar da ku, sauran kuma ana biya idan kun iso. Babu abin da ke ɓoye, kuma muna bayyana kowane adadi tun farko.
contact.faq.items.4.question: Me ke faruwa bayan na koma gida?
contact.faq.items.4.answer: Muna ci gaba da tuntuɓar ku. Muna shirya kiran bibiya da likitanku, muna isar da rahotanninku, kuma muna taimakawa da duk abin da kuke buƙata yayin da kuke murmurewa.
privacy.meta.title: Manufar sirri. Medsafar India.
privacy.meta.description: Yadda Medsafar India ke tattarawa, amfani da kuma kare bayanan sirri da na lafiya.
privacy.heading: Manufar sirri
privacy.intro: Wannan manufa tana bayyana yadda Medsafar India ke tattarawa, amfani, adanawa, rabawa da kuma kare bayanan sirri, har da bayanan lafiya, lokacin da kuke amfani da shafin yanar gizonmu ko ayyukanmu.
privacy.effective.label: Ranar fara aiki
privacy.updated.label: An sabunta a ƙarshe
privacy.sections.0.heading: 1. Gabatarwa
privacy.sections.0.body.0: Med Safar India (“Med Safar”, “mu”, “namu” ko “gare mu”) ta dukufa wajen kare sirri, keɓantattun bayanai da tsaron bayanan sirri na mutanen da ke ziyartar shafin yanar gizonmu, aiko da tambayoyi, yin rajista tare da mu, ko amfani da ayyukanmu na sauƙaƙa yawon jinya da daidaita al'amuran marasa lafiya.
privacy.sections.0.body.1: Wannan Manufar Sirri tana bayyana yadda muke tattarawa, amfani, adanawa, sarrafawa, bayyanawa da kuma kare bayanan sirri, har da bayanan lafiya masu muhimmanci, dangane da shafin yanar gizonmu da ayyukanmu.
privacy.sections.0.body.2: Med Safar India tana sauƙaƙa samun ayyukan kiwon lafiya ta hanyar haɗa kai da asibitoci, likitoci, cibiyoyin bincike da sauran masu ba da ayyuka da suka dace. Mun fahimci cewa bayanan lafiya abu ne na sirri, kuma mun dukufa wajen sarrafa su cikin alhaki da gaskiya.
privacy.sections.0.body.3: Wannan Manufar Sirri ta shafi masu ziyartar shafin yanar gizo, waɗanda ke iya zama marasa lafiya, marasa lafiya da suka yi rajista, masu raka su ko wakilansu masu izini, da sauran mutanen da ke hulɗa da ayyukanmu.
privacy.sections.0.body.4: Yadda muke sarrafa bayanan sirri yana ƙarƙashin dokokin Indiya da suka dace, ciki har da Dokar Kare Bayanan Sirri ta Dijital, 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023), gwargwadon yadda ta shafa kuma take aiki, Dokar Fasahar Sadarwa, 2000 (Information Technology Act, 2000), da ƙa'idoji da dokoki masu alaƙa.
privacy.sections.1.heading: 2. Bayanan da Muke Tattarawa
privacy.sections.1.body.0: Gwargwadon ayyukan da aka nema da kuma yadda kuke hulɗa da mu, za mu iya tattara waɗannan rukunan bayanai.
privacy.sections.1.body.1: A. Bayanan Sirri da na Tuntuɓa
privacy.sections.1.body.4: • Lambar wayar hannu da ta WhatsApp
privacy.sections.1.body.5: • Ƙasar zama da ƙasar asali, inda ake buƙata
privacy.sections.1.body.7: • Jinsi, inda ya shafi ayyukan da aka nema
privacy.sections.1.body.8: • Adireshin gida ko na aika wasiƙa
privacy.sections.1.body.9: • Harshen da aka fi so da yadda ake son a yi sadarwa
privacy.sections.1.body.11: Don sauƙaƙa ganawa da likita da ta dace da daidaita jinya, za mu iya tattara bayanai kamar haka:
privacy.sections.1.body.12: • Tarihin lafiya da bayanan cututtukan da ake da su
privacy.sections.1.body.14: • Rahotannin lafiya, sakamakon gwaje-gwajen dakin bincike da hotunan bincike (scans)
privacy.sections.1.body.15: • Takardun magani da bayanan da likitoci suka rubuta
privacy.sections.1.body.16: • Bayanan ganawar da aka yi a baya, tiyata ko jinyar da aka yi
privacy.sections.1.body.17: • Hotuna ko wasu takardun lafiya, inda suka dace kuma aka bayar da su da son rai
privacy.sections.1.body.18: • Bayanan da asibiti ko likitan da ke jinya ke buƙata don tantance buƙatar jinya
privacy.sections.1.body.19: Muna neman bayanan lafiya ne kawai idan suna da muhimmanci bisa hankali ga ayyukan da ake nema, kuma muna sarrafa su da matakan kiyaye sirri da suka dace.
privacy.sections.1.body.21: Inda aka nemi taimakon tafiya, za mu iya tattara:
privacy.sections.1.body.22: • Bayanan fasfo da sauran takardun tafiya, inda ya zama dole
privacy.sections.1.body.23: • Ranakun tafiya da tsarin tafiyar da ake so
privacy.sections.1.body.24: • Jirgin sama da masaukin da ake so
privacy.sections.1.body.25: • Bayanan 'yan uwa ko masu raka mara lafiya
privacy.sections.1.body.26: • Bayanan da suka shafi biza, inda ake buƙata don shirya tafiya
privacy.sections.1.body.27: • Buƙatun taimako na musamman ko na sauƙin motsi da suka shafi tafiyar
privacy.sections.1.body.28: D. Bayanan Shafin Yanar Gizo da na Fasaha
privacy.sections.1.body.29: Lokacin da kuka ziyarci shafin yanar gizonmu, ana iya tattara wasu bayanan fasaha kai tsaye, ciki har da:
privacy.sections.1.body.31: • Irin burauza da tsarin aiki na na'ura
privacy.sections.1.body.32: • Alamomin tantance na'ura da na fasaha
privacy.sections.1.body.33: • Shafukan da aka ziyarta da lokacin da aka ɗauka a shafin
privacy.sections.1.body.34: • Shafin yanar gizo ko tushen da ya kawo ku
privacy.sections.1.body.35: • Yadda ake amfani da shafin yanar gizo da bayanan gano matsala
privacy.sections.1.body.36: • Alamomin kukis (cookies) da makamantan bayanan bin diddigi, inda aka kunna su
privacy.sections.1.body.38: Za mu iya adana bayanan tambayoyi da sadarwar da aka yi ta shafin yanar gizonmu, imel, waya, WhatsApp ko wasu hanyoyin sadarwa. Waɗannan na iya haɗawa da saƙonni, buƙatun ganawa, zaɓuɓɓukan ayyuka da wasiƙun da suka shafi hakan.
privacy.sections.1.body.39: Ana iya naɗar kiran waya don tabbatar da inganci, horarwa, tsaro ko adana bayanai, inda ya dace kuma tare da sanarwa ko izini da ya dace.
privacy.sections.1.body.40: F. Bayanai Game da Masu Raka Mara Lafiya ko Wakilai
privacy.sections.1.body.41: Inda mara lafiya ya ba da bayanan mai raka shi, ɗan uwa ko wakili mai izini, za mu iya sarrafa bayanan tuntuɓar wannan mutum don shirya ganawa, tafiya ko sauran ayyukan da aka nema. Wanda ke ba da irin waɗannan bayanai ya kamata ya kasance yana da ikon da ya dace na raba su.
privacy.sections.2.heading: 3. Yadda Muke Tattara Bayanai
privacy.sections.2.body.1: • Kai tsaye daga gare ku ta fom-fom na shafin yanar gizo, fom-fom na rajista, kiran waya, imel ko manhajojin aika saƙo.
privacy.sections.2.body.2: • Lokacin da kuka raba takardun lafiya ko takardun tafiya da mu da son ranku.
privacy.sections.2.body.3: • Daga wakilinku mai izini ko mai raka ku.
privacy.sections.2.body.4: • Daga asibitoci, likitoci ko sauran masu ba da ayyuka da ke da hannu wajen shirya ayyukan da kuka nema, inda doka ta halatta.
privacy.sections.2.body.5: • Kai tsaye ta kukis, kayan aikin nazari da fasahohin shafin yanar gizo.
privacy.sections.2.body.6: • Daga wasu hanyoyi na halal inda ya zama dole don ba da ayyukan da aka nema ko cika wajibai na doka.
privacy.sections.2.body.7: Inda ake buƙatar izini, za mu nemi shi ta hanyar da ta dace kafin mu sarrafa bayanan da abin ya shafa.
privacy.sections.3.heading: 4. Dalilan da Muke Amfani da Bayananku
privacy.sections.3.body.0: Med Safar India za ta iya amfani da bayananku don waɗannan dalilai:
privacy.sections.3.body.1: 1. Don amsa tambayoyi da fahimtar buƙatunku na kiwon lafiya.
privacy.sections.3.body.2: 2. Don shirya ganawa da likita, tantance jinya, alƙawura da ayyuka masu alaƙa.
privacy.sections.3.body.3: 3. Don raba bayanan lafiya da suka dace da asibitoci, likitoci, cibiyoyin bincike da sauran masu ba da kiwon lafiya da aka zaɓa don shirya jinyarku.
privacy.sections.3.body.4: 4. Don sauƙaƙa tafiya, masauki, ɗauka daga filin jirgin sama da shirye-shiryen masu raka mara lafiya, inda aka nema.
privacy.sections.3.body.5: 5. Don sanar da tabbatar da alƙawura, sabbin bayanai kan jinya, bayanan ayyuka da shirye-shiryen tafiya.
privacy.sections.3.body.6: 6. Don ba da tallafi ga abokan hulɗa da amsa ƙorafe-ƙorafe ko buƙatu.
privacy.sections.3.body.7: 7. Don adana bayanan cikin gida, inganta ayyuka da kula da shafin yanar gizonmu.
privacy.sections.3.body.8: 8. Don hana zamba, kare tsaro da bincika yadda ake amfani da ayyukanmu ba bisa ƙa'ida ba.
privacy.sections.3.body.9: 9. Don bin buƙatun doka, na hukumomi, na lissafin kuɗi ko na bayar da rahoto da suka dace.
privacy.sections.3.body.10: 10. Don aika saƙonnin talla, wasiƙun labarai ko abubuwan ilimantarwa inda aka samu izinin da ake buƙata.
privacy.sections.3.body.11: 11. Don yin nazari na tattarau ko wanda aka cire alamomin tantance mutum, don fahimtar yadda ake amfani da ayyuka da inganta abin da muke bayarwa.
privacy.sections.3.body.12: Ba za mu yi amfani da bayanan lafiyarku don wata talla da ba ta da alaƙa ba sai da hujjar doka da ta dace da kuma izini, inda ake buƙata.
privacy.sections.4.heading: 5. Izini da Sarrafa Bayanai bisa Doka
privacy.sections.4.body.0: Muna sarrafa bayanan sirri bisa dalilan doka da suka dace, waɗanda za su iya haɗawa da:
privacy.sections.4.body.2: • Sarrafawar da ta zama dole don ba da ayyukan da kuka nema ko kuka yarda ku karɓa, inda doka ta halatta.
privacy.sections.4.body.3: • Bin wajibai na doka da suka dace.
privacy.sections.4.body.4: • Sauran dalilai na halal da ke ƙarƙashin dokokin da suka dace.
privacy.sections.4.body.5: Inda muka dogara da izini, za ku iya janye shi bisa ga dokar da ta dace. Janye izini ba zai shafi halaccin sarrafawar da aka yi kafin janyewar ba.
privacy.sections.4.body.6: Idan kuka zaɓi kada ku ba da bayanan da suka zama dole don wani aiki da aka nema, ƙila ba za mu iya shirya wasu ganawa da likita, tantance jinya ko shirye-shiryen tafiya ba.
privacy.sections.5.heading: 6. Rabawa da Bayyana Bayanai
privacy.sections.5.body.0: Ba ma sayar da bayananku na sirri ko na lafiya.
privacy.sections.5.body.1: Za mu iya raba bayanan da suka dace, gwargwadon buƙata kuma bisa ga dokar da ta dace, da:
privacy.sections.5.body.3: Asibitoci, likitocin da ke jinya, ƙwararrun likitoci, dakunan gwaje-gwaje da sauran masu ba da kiwon lafiya da ke da hannu wajen tantancewa ko shirya jinyar da kuka nema.
privacy.sections.5.body.4: B. Abokan Hulɗa na Tafiya da Masauki
privacy.sections.5.body.5: Kamfanonin jirgin sama, hukumomin tafiye-tafiye, masu taimakon biza, otal-otal, masu sufuri da sauran masu ba da ayyuka da suka dace, inda ake buƙata don shirya tafiya ko masauki.
privacy.sections.5.body.6: C. Masu Ba da Fasaha da Ayyuka
privacy.sections.5.body.7: Masu ɗaukar nauyin shafin yanar gizo, dillalan fasahar sadarwa, manhajojin CRM, masu ba da ma'ajiyar bayanai ta intanet (cloud), ayyukan sadarwa da sauran dillalai da ke tallafa wa ayyukanmu.
privacy.sections.5.body.8: D. Hukumomin Shari'a da na Sa Ido
privacy.sections.5.body.9: Hukumomin gwamnati, kotuna, hukumomin sa ido ko jami'an tsaro inda doka ta buƙaci ko ta halatta bayyanawa.
privacy.sections.5.body.11: Mai raka ku mai izini, ɗan uwa, wakili ko wani mutum inda kuka ba da izinin bayyanawa ko inda bayyanawar ta halatta ta wata hanya.
privacy.sections.5.body.12: Muna ƙoƙarin taƙaita bayyanawa zuwa bayanan da suka zama dole bisa hankali don dalilin da abin ya shafa. Masu ba da ayyuka na ɓangare na uku na iya sarrafa bayanai ƙarƙashin manufofinsu na sirri da wajibansu na kwangila, gwargwadon yadda ya dace.
privacy.sections.6.heading: 7. Tura Bayanai zuwa Ƙasashen Waje
privacy.sections.6.body.0: Med Safar India na iya shirya jinya ga marasa lafiya da ke zaune a Indiya ko a wasu ƙasashe. Saboda haka, ana iya buƙatar raba bayanan sirri ko na lafiya da suka dace da masu ba da kiwon lafiya ko abokan hulɗa da ke Indiya ko a ƙasashen waje.
privacy.sections.6.body.1: Duk wani tura ko sarrafa bayanan sirri a ketare iyaka za a yi shi ne bisa ga dokar Indiya da ta dace, ciki har da duk wani hani ko sharuɗɗa da hukumomin da abin ya shafa suka sanya, da sauran buƙatun doka da suka dace.
privacy.sections.6.body.2: Muna ɗaukar matakai masu dacewa don tabbatar da cewa ana raba bayanai ne kawai da waɗanda suka dace don dalilai na halal da suka shafi ayyuka.
privacy.sections.7.heading: 8. Kukis da Makamantan Fasahohi
privacy.sections.7.body.0: Shafin yanar gizonmu na iya amfani da kukis da makamantan fasahohi don:
privacy.sections.7.body.1: • Tabbatar da cewa shafin yanar gizo yana aiki yadda ya kamata.
privacy.sections.7.body.2: • Tuna zaɓuɓɓuka da inganta yadda masu amfani ke jin daɗin shafin.
privacy.sections.7.body.3: • Fahimtar yawan masu ziyara da yadda ake amfani da shafin.
privacy.sections.7.body.4: • Gano matsalolin fasaha da inganta aiki.
privacy.sections.7.body.5: • Tallafa wa nazari da, inda ya dace, ayyukan talla da suka dogara da izini.
privacy.sections.7.body.6: Za ku iya sarrafa ko kashe kukis ta saitunan burauzarku. Wasu fasalolin shafin yanar gizo ƙila ba za su yi aiki yadda ya kamata ba idan an kashe wasu kukis.
privacy.sections.7.body.7: Inda ake buƙata, za mu sami izini kafin amfani da kukis marasa muhimmanci ko makamantan fasahohi.
privacy.sections.8.heading: 9. Tsaron Bayanai
privacy.sections.8.body.0: Muna aiwatar da matakan kariya na fasaha, na tsari da na gudanarwa masu dacewa da aka tsara don kare bayanan sirri daga shiga ba tare da izini ba, bayyanawa, sauyawa, ɓacewa ko amfani da su ba daidai ba.
privacy.sections.8.body.1: Gwargwadon irin bayanan da tsarin da ake amfani da shi, matakan kariya na iya haɗawa da:
privacy.sections.8.body.2: • Takaita shiga da izini bisa matsayin mutum.
privacy.sections.8.body.3: • Aika bayanai cikin tsaro da ɓoye su (encryption) inda ya dace.
privacy.sections.8.body.4: • Kariya da kalmar sirri da matakan tsaron asusu.
privacy.sections.8.body.5: • Buƙatun kiyaye sirri ga ma'aikata da masu ba da ayyuka da abin ya shafa.
privacy.sections.8.body.6: • Sa ido kan tsaro, ajiyar kwafin bayanai da hanyoyin magance aukuwar matsala.
privacy.sections.8.body.7: • Sake duba hanyoyin sarrafa bayanai lokaci-lokaci.
privacy.sections.8.body.8: Duk da haka, babu wani shafin yanar gizo, aika bayanai ta na'ura ko tsarin ajiya da za a iya ba da tabbacin cewa yana da cikakken tsaro. Ba za mu iya ba da tabbacin cikakken tsaro ba, amma za mu ɗauki matakan da suka dace don magance aukuwar matsalolin tsaro bisa ga dokar da ta dace.
privacy.sections.9.heading: 10. Adana Bayanai da Goge Su
privacy.sections.9.body.0: Muna adana bayanan sirri ne kawai har tsawon lokacin da ya zama dole bisa hankali don cika dalilan da aka bayyana a wannan Manufa, ba da ayyukan da aka nema, adana bayanan da ake buƙata, warware rikice-rikice, kare muradu na halal ko bin wajibai na doka da suka dace.
privacy.sections.9.body.1: Tsawon lokacin adanawa na iya bambanta gwargwadon irin bayanan da irin ayyukan da aka bayar.
privacy.sections.9.body.2: Idan ba a ƙara buƙatar bayanai ba, za mu ɗauki matakan da suka dace don goge su ko cire alamomin tantance mutum daga cikinsu, bisa ga buƙatun doka da suka dace da duk wata buƙata ta halal ta adana su.
privacy.sections.9.body.3: Za ku iya neman a goge bayananku na sirri, bisa ga dokar da ta dace. Ana iya buƙatar adana wasu bayanai inda doka ta buƙata ko don kafawa, aiwatarwa ko kare haƙƙoƙi a shari'a.
privacy.sections.10.heading: 11. Haƙƙoƙinku na Sirri
privacy.sections.10.body.0: Bisa ga dokar da ta dace, kuna iya samun haƙƙin:
privacy.sections.10.body.1: • Neman bayani game da bayanan sirri da muke sarrafawa game da ku.
privacy.sections.10.body.2: • Neman gyara ko sabunta bayanan da ba daidai ba ko ba cikakku ba.
privacy.sections.10.body.3: • Neman goge bayanan sirri inda doka ta halatta.
privacy.sections.10.body.4: • Janye izinin sarrafawa inda sarrafawar ta dogara da izini.
privacy.sections.10.body.5: • Kai ƙorafi game da yadda ake sarrafa bayananku na sirri.
privacy.sections.10.body.6: • Naɗa wani mutum ya yi amfani da haƙƙoƙin da suka dace idan an rasu ko an kasa iyawa, inda doka ta tanada.
privacy.sections.10.body.7: • Yin amfani da duk wasu haƙƙoƙi da ke ƙarƙashin dokokin kare bayanai da suka dace.
privacy.sections.10.body.8: Don yin amfani da haƙƙoƙinku, don Allah ku tuntuɓe mu ta bayanan da aka bayar a sashen Tuntuɓe Mu da ke ƙasa. Ƙila mu buƙaci tabbatar da ko wanene ku kafin mu ɗauki mataki kan buƙatarku.
privacy.sections.11.heading: 12. Saƙonnin Talla
privacy.sections.11.body.0: Za mu iya aika bayanai game da ayyukanmu, shirye-shiryen kiwon lafiya, ayyukan taimakon marasa lafiya, taruka ko abubuwan ilimantarwa inda dokar da ta dace ta halatta kuma aka samu izinin da ake buƙata.
privacy.sections.11.body.1: Za ku iya fita daga karɓar saƙonnin talla a kowane lokaci ta bin umarnin dakatar da karɓa da ke cikin saƙon ko ta tuntuɓar mu kai tsaye.
privacy.sections.11.body.2: Ko da kun fita daga karɓar talla, za mu iya ci gaba da aika muhimman saƙonnin da suka shafi ayyuka, kamar bayanan alƙawari ko sabbin bayanai game da wata buƙata da kuka yi.
privacy.sections.12.heading: 13. Shafukan Yanar Gizo da Ayyukan Ɓangare na Uku
privacy.sections.12.body.0: Shafin yanar gizonmu na iya ƙunsar hanyoyin haɗi zuwa wasu shafukan yanar gizo na waje, shafukan asibitoci, manhajojin yin booking ko sauran ayyukan ɓangare na uku.
privacy.sections.12.body.1: Waɗannan shafuka da ayyuka na iya aiki ƙarƙashin manufofinsu na sirri da sharuɗɗansu. Med Safar India ba ta da iko kan hanyoyin kiyaye sirri na ɓangarori na uku masu zaman kansu, kuma tana ƙarfafa ku ku duba manufofinsu kafin ku raba bayanan sirri.
privacy.sections.13.heading: 14. Sanarwar Lafiya da Matsayin Med Safar India
privacy.sections.13.body.0: Med Safar India tana aiki a matsayin mai sauƙaƙa yawon jinya da kuma mai daidaita al'amuran marasa lafiya. Sai dai idan an faɗi akasin haka a fili cikin wata rubutacciyar yarjejeniya daban, ba ma gano cututtuka da kanmu, ba ma rubuta magani, kuma ba ma ba da jinya.
privacy.sections.13.body.1: Tantance lafiya, gano cuta, shawarwarin jinya da yanke shawarar likitanci alhakin ƙwararrun ma'aikatan lafiya masu cancanta da cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya da abin ya shafa ne.
privacy.sections.13.body.2: Raba bayanan lafiya da mu ba ya kafa dangantakar likita da mara lafiya da Med Safar India da kansa.
privacy.sections.14.heading: 15. Sirrin Yara
privacy.sections.14.body.0: Lokaci-lokaci ayyukanmu na iya haɗawa da shirya jinya ko tafiya ga mutanen da shekarunsu ba su kai 18 ba.
privacy.sections.14.body.1: Inda bayanan sirri suka shafi yaro, za mu sarrafa su bisa ga dokar da ta dace kuma mu sami izinin iyaye ko mai kula da yaro bisa doka wanda za a iya tabbatarwa, inda ake buƙata.
privacy.sections.14.body.2: Ba ma tattara bayanan sirri na yara da gangan don dalilan da ba su da alaƙa ba, ko amfani da su don tallan da aka nufa inda doka ta hana.
privacy.sections.15.heading: 16. Sauye-sauye ga Wannan Manufar Sirri
privacy.sections.15.body.0: Za mu iya sabunta wannan Manufar Sirri lokaci zuwa lokaci don nuna sauye-sauye a ayyukanmu, fasaha, hanyoyin gudanar da kasuwanci ko buƙatun doka da suka dace.
privacy.sections.15.body.1: Za a wallafa sabon tsari a shafin yanar gizonmu tare da sabunta ranar “An Sabunta a Ƙarshe”. Inda doka ta buƙata, za mu ba da ƙarin sanarwa ko mu sami izini don manyan sauye-sauye.
privacy.sections.15.body.2: Muna ƙarfafa ku ku riƙa duba wannan shafi lokaci-lokaci.
privacy.sections.16.heading: 17. Tuntuɓe Mu da Magance Ƙorafi
privacy.sections.16.body.0: Idan kuna da wata tambaya, damuwa ko buƙata game da wannan Manufar Sirri ko yadda ake sarrafa bayananku na sirri, don Allah ku tuntuɓe mu:
privacy.sections.16.body.4: Ofishin Rajista: Office No. 222, 2nd Floor, NEO Corporate Plaza, Ramchandra Lane, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400064, India
privacy.sections.16.body.5: Wanda za a tuntuɓa kan Sirri da Ƙorafi: don Allah ka rubuta zuwa care@medsafar.com kawai, don kowace buƙata ko ƙorafi game da sirri.
privacy.sections.16.body.6: Za mu duba kuma mu amsa buƙatu ko ƙorafe-ƙorafen da suka shafi sirri cikin wa'adin lokacin da dokar da ta dace ta tanada.
privacy.sections.17.heading: Alƙawarinmu ga Marasa Lafiya
privacy.sections.17.body: A Med Safar India, mun fahimci cewa bayanan lafiya abu ne na sirri ƙwarai. Mun dukufa wajen kula da bayanan marasa lafiya cikin kulawa, sirri da girmamawa, da kuma amfani da su cikin alhaki don sauƙaƙa kiwon lafiya da ayyuka masu alaƙa.
terms.meta.title: Sharuɗɗa da ƙa'idoji. Medsafar India.
terms.meta.description: Sharuɗɗa da ƙa'idojin amfani da shafin yanar gizo da ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya na Med Safar India.
terms.heading: Sharuɗɗa da ƙa'idojin amfani da shafin yanar gizo da ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya
terms.intro: Waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da Ƙa'idoji (“Sharuɗɗa”) suna tsara shiga da amfani da shafin yanar gizo na Med Safar India, manhajojin dijital, hanyoyin sadarwa da ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya.
terms.draft: Daftari. Ana nazarin wannan rubutu ta fuskar doka kuma yana iya sauyawa.
terms.updated.label: An sabunta a ƙarshe
terms.preamble.0: Med Safar India sunan kasuwanci ne na sauƙaƙa jinya wanda TravGrub Private Limited ke gudanarwa, kamfani mai rajista a Indiya (“Kamfani”, “Med Safar India”, “mu”, “gare mu” ko “namu”).
terms.preamble.1: Ta hanyar shiga shafin yanar gizonmu, aiko da tambaya, neman taimakon jinya, ɗaukar ayyukanmu ko yin booking ta hannunmu, kun tabbatar da cewa kun karanta kuma kun fahimci waɗannan Sharuɗɗa, kuma kun yarda ku bi tanade-tanaden da suka shafi amfaninku da ayyukanmu.
terms.preamble.2: Idan ba ku yarda da waɗannan Sharuɗɗa ba, ya kamata ku guji amfani da shafin yanar gizonmu ko ɗaukar ayyukanmu.
terms.sections.0.heading: 1. Ma'anoni da fassara
terms.sections.0.body.1: “Mara Lafiya” yana nufin mutumin da ke neman ganawa da likita, bincike, jinya, tiyata, gyaran jiki bayan jinya ko sauran ayyukan kiwon lafiya a Indiya.
terms.sections.0.body.2: “Mai Amfani” ko “ku” yana nufin Mara Lafiya ko duk wani mutum da ke shiga shafin yanar gizonmu ko yake aiki a madadin Mara Lafiya, ciki har da wakili mai izini, ɗan uwa, abokin tafiya, mai kula ko mutumin da ke yin tambaya, booking ko biya.
terms.sections.0.body.3: “Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya” yana nufin asibiti mai zaman kansa, asibitin shan magani (clinic), likita, likitan tiyata, cibiyar bincike, dakin gwaje-gwaje, cibiyar gyaran jiki ko wani ƙwararren ma'aikacin lafiya ko cibiya.
terms.sections.0.body.4: “Mai Ba da Ayyuka na Ɓangare na Uku” yana nufin mai zaman kansa da ke ba da ayyuka kamar masauki, sufuri, jiragen sama, masu fassara, taimakon tafiya, inshora ko sauran ayyukan da aka shirya dangane da ziyarar Mara Lafiya.
terms.sections.0.body.5: “Ayyukan Sauƙaƙa Jinya” yana nufin ayyukan daidaitawa da taimako da ba na likitanci ba da Med Safar India ke bayarwa, kamar yadda aka bayyana a waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da kuma a cikin shawarar aiki ko rubutaccen tabbaci da ya dace.
terms.sections.0.body.6: “Shafin Yanar Gizo” yana nufin shafin yanar gizo na Med Safar India da duk wata manhajar dijital da Kamfanin ke gudanarwa ko ake gudanarwa a madadinsa.
terms.sections.1.heading: 2. Game da Med Safar India
terms.sections.1.body.0: Med Safar India tana taimaka wa Marasa Lafiya na cikin gida da na ƙasashen waje wajen bincike da shirya samun ayyukan kiwon lafiya a Indiya.
terms.sections.1.body.1: Gwargwadon buƙatun Mara Lafiya da iyakar aikin da aka amince da shi a rubuce, ayyukanmu na iya haɗawa da:
terms.sections.1.body.2: a. Karɓa da daidaita tambayoyin jinya;
terms.sections.1.body.3: b. Sauƙaƙa aika takardun lafiya cikin tsaro zuwa ga Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da suka dace, bisa ga izini da ya dace da dokar da ta dace;
terms.sections.1.body.4: c. Neman tantancewar lafiya ta farko, ra'ayoyin jinya ko ƙiyasin kuɗi na nuni daga Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya;
terms.sections.1.body.5: d. Shirya alƙawura, ganawa da likita, ziyarar asibiti da jadawalin jinya;
terms.sections.1.body.6: e. Sauƙaƙa sadarwa tsakanin Marasa Lafiya da Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya;
terms.sections.1.body.7: f. Taimakawa da takardun da suka shafi jinya da daidaitawa da asibiti;
terms.sections.1.body.8: g. Ba da taimako mai dacewa wajen takardun gayyatar bizar jinya inda Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da abin ya shafa ya samar da su, ba tare da ba da tabbacin amincewa da biza ba;
terms.sections.1.body.9: h. Shirya masauki, ɗauka daga filin jirgin sama, sufuri a cikin gari, fassara da sauran shirye-shiryen da suka shafi tafiya inda aka nema musamman kuma aka amince;
terms.sections.1.body.10: i. Taimakawa wajen shirya sallamar mara lafiya daga asibiti, alƙawuran bibiya da sadarwa da Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya; da
terms.sections.1.body.11: j. Ba da sauran ayyukan gudanarwa da tallafin marasa lafiya da aka amince da su a fili tare da Mara Lafiya.
terms.sections.1.body.12: Za a sanar da cikakken iyakar ayyuka, kuɗaɗe, abubuwan da aka haɗa da waɗanda ba a haɗa ba ta hanyar ƙiyasin farashi, shawarar aiki, takardar kuɗi (invoice) ko rubutaccen tabbaci da ya dace.
terms.sections.1.body.13: Med Safar India ba ta ɗauki alƙawarin ba da kowane aiki da aka lissafa a sama a kowane al'amari ba.
terms.sections.2.heading: 3. Yanayi da iyakokin ayyukanmu
terms.sections.2.body.0: Med Safar India tana aiki a matsayin mai ba da ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya da daidaitawa. Aikinmu shi ne taimaka wa Marasa Lafiya wajen samun da daidaita ayyukan da Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya masu zaman kansu da sauran masu ba da ayyuka ke bayarwa.
terms.sections.2.body.1: Sai dai idan an amince da akasin haka a fili cikin wata rubutacciyar yarjejeniya daban, Med Safar India da kanta ba ta gudanar da asibiti, asibitin shan magani, dakin gwaje-gwaje ko cibiyar lafiya, kuma ba ta gano cututtuka ta hanyar likitanci, ba ta rubuta magunguna, ba ta yin ayyukan likitanci ko tiyata.
terms.sections.2.body.2: Duk shawarwarin likitanci, ciki har da dacewar wata jinya, zaɓin aikin likitanci, rubuta magani, fassara sakamakon bincike da tantance lafiyar jiki, sun kasance a hannun Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya masu cancanta.
terms.sections.2.body.3: Med Safar India ba ta jagoranci ko sarrafa hukuncin likitanci na kansa na Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya.
terms.sections.2.body.4: Bai kamata a ɗauki ayyukanmu na daidaitawa, sadarwa da tallafin marasa lafiya a matsayin madadin ganawa da ƙwararren likita ko kulawar gaggawa ta likitanci ba.
terms.sections.3.heading: 4. Bayanan lafiya da shawarwarin jinya
terms.sections.3.body.0: Bayanan da ke kan Shafin Yanar Gizonmu ko waɗanda wakilanmu ke sanarwa an yi su ne da farko don bayyana ayyukanmu da sauƙaƙa samun Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da suka dace.
terms.sections.3.body.1: Duk wani bayanin jinya, ra'ayin likita, shirin jinya da aka gabatar ko ƙiyasin da aka samu daga Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya yana ƙarƙashin tantancewar ƙwarewar wannan mai bayarwa da sharuɗɗansa.
terms.sections.3.body.2: Ra'ayoyin farko da aka gina bisa takardun lafiya, hotuna, rahotanni ko ganawa ta intanet na iya bambanta da matsayar da aka cimma bayan duba jiki, bincike ko ganawa ido da ido a Indiya.
terms.sections.3.body.3: Med Safar India ba ta ba da tabbacin cewa tantancewar farko za ta kasance ba tare da sauyi ba bayan ƙarin nazari.
terms.sections.3.body.4: Ana ƙarfafa Marasa Lafiya su tattauna yanayin jinyar da aka gabatar, sauran zaɓuɓɓuka, amfanin da ake tsammani, haɗarin da ka iya faruwa, abin da murmurewa ke buƙata da kuɗin da ake tsammani kai tsaye da Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da ke jinyar su kafin su yanke shawarar jinya.
terms.sections.3.body.5: Mara Lafiya yana da haƙƙin yanke shawara bisa cikakken sani game da ko zai ci gaba da jinya, bisa ga buƙatun likitanci da na doka da suka dace.
terms.sections.4.heading: 5. Babu tabbacin sakamakon jinya
terms.sections.4.body.0: Kowane aikin likitanci, ciki har da tiyata, yana tattare da haɗari da rashin tabbas. Sakamakon jinya na iya bambanta gwargwadon tarihin lafiyar Mara Lafiya, cututtukan da yake da su, shekaru, yadda jikinsa ke karɓar jinya, matsalolin da suka taso da wasu abubuwa.
terms.sections.4.body.1: Med Safar India ba ta yin wani iƙirari ko ba da tabbaci game da:
terms.sections.4.body.2: a. Dacewar wata jinya ga Mara Lafiya;
terms.sections.4.body.3: b. Samuwar wani takamaiman aikin likitanci ko cancantar Mara Lafiya gare shi;
terms.sections.4.body.4: c. Sakamako, yawan nasara ko tsawon lokacin murmurewa daga jinya;
terms.sections.4.body.5: d. Rashin samun matsaloli, illolin magani ko mummunan martanin jiki; ko
terms.sections.4.body.6: e. Ainihin tsawon zama a asibiti ko ranar da Mara Lafiya zai samu ƙarfin yin tafiya.
terms.sections.4.body.7: Ya kamata a tattauna duk abubuwan da ake tsammani game da jinya da Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da abin ya shafa. Bai kamata a ɗauki wani bayani a Shafin Yanar Gizo ko wanda wakilanmu suka bayar a matsayin alƙawarin wani takamaiman sakamakon likitanci ba.
terms.sections.5.heading: 6. Hakkokin Mara Lafiya da bayyana bayanai
terms.sections.5.body.0: Mara Lafiya da, inda ya dace, wakilinsa mai izini, suna da alhakin ba da ingantattun bayanai, cikakku kuma na zamani da suka shafi ayyukan da aka nema.
terms.sections.5.body.1: Wannan ya haɗa da, inda ya dace:
terms.sections.5.body.2: a. Tarihin lafiya, cututtukan da ake da su da rashin jituwa da abubuwa (allergies) da aka sani;
terms.sections.5.body.3: b. Magungunan da ake sha yanzu, tiyatar da aka yi a baya da jinyar da ake ci gaba da yi;
terms.sections.5.body.4: c. Rahotannin bincike, gwaje-gwaje da takardun lafiya;
terms.sections.5.body.5: d. Fasfo, takardun shaidar ɗan ƙasa, biza da takardun tafiya; da
terms.sections.5.body.6: e. Bayanan da ake buƙata bisa hankali don shirya alƙawura, tsara jinya da shirye-shiryen tafiya.
terms.sections.5.body.7: Dole ne Mara Lafiya ya sanar da Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da ke jinyarsa nan da nan game da duk wani muhimmin sauyi a yanayin lafiyarsa.
terms.sections.5.body.8: Rashin ba da bayanan da suka dace na iya shafar tantance lafiya, cancantar jinya, ƙiyasin kuɗi, tsara lokaci ko shirye-shiryen tafiya.
terms.sections.5.body.9: Med Safar India ba za ta ɗauki alhakin sakamakon da ya samo asali daga bayanan da ba daidai ba sosai, ba cikakku ba ko masu ɓatarwa da Mara Lafiya ko wakilinsa ya bayar ba, gwargwadon abin da dokar da ta dace ta halatta.
terms.sections.5.body.10: Dole ne Marasa Lafiya su bi umarnin Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da ke jinyar su, kuma kada su dogara da Med Safar India don shawarar likitanci ta gaggawa.
terms.sections.6.heading: 7. Takardun lafiya, sirri da izini
terms.sections.6.body.0: Mara Lafiya ya ba Med Safar India izini, gwargwadon abin da ya zama dole don ayyukan da aka nema kuma bisa ga dokar da ta dace, ta shirya raba takardun lafiya da bayanan sirri da suka dace da Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da aka zaɓa da sauran abokan hulɗa masu izini.
terms.sections.6.body.1: Ana iya amfani da irin waɗannan bayanai don tambayoyin jinya, tantancewar farko, tsara alƙawura, ƙiyasin farashi, daidaita jinya, tallafin gudanarwa da ayyuka masu alaƙa da Mara Lafiya ya nema.
terms.sections.6.body.2: Inda bayanai suka shafi wani mutum, dole ne wanda ke aiko da su ya kasance yana da iko da izinin da ake buƙata na yin hakan.
terms.sections.6.body.3: Med Safar India za ta sarrafa bayanan sirri bisa ga dokokin kare bayanai da sirri da suka dace da kuma Manufarta ta Sirri.
terms.sections.6.body.4: Ya kamata Mara Lafiya ya duba Manufar Sirri don ƙarin bayani game da tattarawa, amfani, bayyanawa, adanawa da kare bayanan sirri.
terms.sections.6.body.5: Izinin karɓar saƙonnin da suka shafi ayyuka ba ya zama izinin karɓar saƙonnin talla kai tsaye ba. Za a sarrafa saƙonnin talla, inda suka dace, bisa ga dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.7.heading: 8. Masu ba da kiwon lafiya da masu ba da ayyuka masu zaman kansu
terms.sections.7.body.0: Med Safar India na iya gabatar da Marasa Lafiya ga, ko shirya booking tare da, Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya masu zaman kansu da Masu Ba da Ayyuka na Ɓangare na Uku.
terms.sections.7.body.1: Kowane mai bayarwa yana da alhakin ayyukan da yake bayarwa da kansa, ciki har da cancantarsa ta ƙwarewa, shawarwarinsa na likitanci, kayan aikinsa, ma'aikatansa, ƙa'idojin aikinsa, kuɗaɗensa, wajibansa na kwangila da bin ƙa'idojin hukumomi da suka dace.
terms.sections.7.body.2: Med Safar India na iya yin binciken gudanarwa masu dacewa ko dogara da bayanan da masu bayarwa da abin ya shafa suka bayar yayin shirya ayyuka. Duk da haka, irin waɗannan ayyuka ba sa zama tabbacin aikin mai bayarwa, samuwarsa, dacewarsa ko sakamakon likitancinsa.
terms.sections.7.body.3: Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya na iya buƙatar Marasa Lafiya su sa hannu a fom-fom na izini daban, takardun kwantar da su a asibiti, yarjejeniyoyin jinya ko sauran takardun kwangila.
terms.sections.7.body.4: Haka nan, kamfanonin jirgin sama, otal-otal, masu sufuri da sauran masu ba da ayyuka na iya sanya nasu sharuɗɗan booking, buƙatun biya da manufofin soke booking.
terms.sections.7.body.5: Mara Lafiya yana da alhakin dubawa da kuma bin sharuɗɗan da suka shafi kowane mai bayarwa.
terms.sections.7.body.6: Babu wani abu a wannan sashe da ke cire ko taƙaita duk wani alhaki da dokar da ta dace ta ɗora kai tsaye kan Med Safar India.
terms.sections.8.heading: 9. Tantancewar lafiya da ƙiyasin farashi
terms.sections.8.body.0: Duk wata tantancewar farko, shawarar jinya ko ƙiyasin kuɗi da aka sanar kafin a duba Mara Lafiya ido da ido na nuni ne kawai, sai dai idan mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa ya tabbatar da akasin haka a fili a rubuce.
terms.sections.8.body.1: Shirin jinya na ƙarshe da kuɗaɗensa na iya sauyawa bayan duba jiki da likita ya yi, binciken gwaje-gwaje, nazarin tarihin lafiya ko gano ƙarin buƙatun lafiya.
terms.sections.8.body.2: Ƙiyasin farashi zai, inda zai yiwu, bayyana ayyukan da aka haɗa, waɗanda ba a haɗa ba, tsarin biya da tsawon lokacin da yake aiki.
terms.sections.8.body.3: Sai dai idan an faɗi a fili a rubuce, bai kamata a ɗauki ƙiyasin farashi a matsayin alƙawari maras sharaɗi ko na tsayayyen farashi daga Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya ba.
terms.sections.8.body.4: Ya kamata Mara Lafiya ya nemi bayani a rubuce game da duk wasu ƙarin kuɗaɗe, ciki har da kuɗaɗen da suka shafi tsawaita zama a asibiti, ƙarin ayyukan likitanci, magunguna, kayan amfani na lokaci ɗaya, kulawa ta musamman (ICU), ganawa da ƙwararrun likitoci, gyaran jiki ko matsalolin da ba a yi tsammani ba.
terms.sections.8.body.5: Med Safar India za ta sanar da manyan sauye-sauye ga ƙiyasi da mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa ya sanar da ita, gwargwadon bayanan da muke da su.
terms.sections.9.heading: 10. Cututtukan da ake da su tun kafin jinya da ƙarin buƙatun lafiya
terms.sections.9.body.0: Dole ne Marasa Lafiya su bayyana cututtukan da aka sani da suke da su tun da farko, rashin jituwa da abubuwa (allergies), magunguna da tarihin lafiya da ya dace ga Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da ke jinyar su.
terms.sections.9.body.1: Bayan duba jiki ko bincike, Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya na iya yanke shawarar cewa ana buƙatar ƙarin gwaje-gwaje, tantancewar ƙwararrun likitoci, kulawar likita ko sauye-sauye a jinya.
terms.sections.9.body.2: Irin waɗannan buƙatu na iya haifar da ƙarin kuɗaɗe ko sauye-sauye a jadawalin jinyar da aka gabatar.
terms.sections.9.body.3: Inda Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya ya buƙaci ƙarin ajiya ko biya, ya kamata a tabbatar da adadin, dalilin da sharuɗɗan maido da kuɗi tare da mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa kafin biya, a duk inda zai yiwu bisa hankali.
terms.sections.9.body.4: Med Safar India ba ta yanke shawarar cancantar likitanci da kanta, kuma ba ta ba da tabbacin cewa za a karɓi Mara Lafiya don aikin likitancin da aka gabatar ba.
terms.sections.9.body.5: Idan an ɗage, an sauya ko an ƙi jinya saboda dalilai na lafiya, sharuɗɗan maido da kuɗi da soke booking da suka dace za su dogara ne da ayyukan da aka riga aka bayar, manufofin mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa da dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.10.heading: 11. Matsalolin lafiya da tsawaita zama a asibiti
terms.sections.10.body.0: Idan matsaloli suka taso ko ƙarin shiga tsakani na likitanci ya zama dole, Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da ke jinya zai yanke shawarar matakin likitanci da ya dace.
terms.sections.10.body.1: Ƙarin jinya, gwaje-gwaje, magunguna, zama a asibiti ko sauran ayyuka na iya haifar da kuɗaɗen da suka wuce ƙiyasin farko.
terms.sections.10.body.2: Dole ne Mara Lafiya ko wanda ke da alhakin biya ya biya ƙarin kuɗaɗen da suka dace bisa ga sharuɗɗan biyan mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa.
terms.sections.10.body.3: Med Safar India na iya taimakawa da daidaita al'amuran gudanarwa da sadarwa inda aka nema, amma ba ta ɗaukar alhakin yanke shawarar likitanci ko ba da tabbacin samuwar ƙarin jinya.
terms.sections.10.body.4: Babu wani abu a waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da ke hana Mara Lafiya neman kulawar gaggawa ko taƙaita duk wani haƙƙi ko mafita da ke ƙarƙashin dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.11.heading: 12. Kuɗaɗe, biya da takardun kuɗi
terms.sections.11.body.0: Za a sanar da kuɗaɗen da za a biya don ayyukan Med Safar India ta rubutaccen ƙiyasin farashi, shawarar aiki, takardar kuɗi (invoice) ko wani rubutaccen tabbaci.
terms.sections.11.body.1: Kuɗaɗen Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da kuɗaɗen Masu Ba da Ayyuka na Ɓangare na Uku na iya zama daban da kuɗaɗen sauƙaƙa jinya na Med Safar India.
terms.sections.11.body.2: Takardun da suka dace za su bayyana, gwargwadon yadda ya dace, wanda zai karɓi kowane biya, ayyukan da aka rufe, harajin da ya dace, wa'adin biya da duk wata buƙatar ajiya ko biyan gaba.
terms.sections.11.body.3: Sai dai idan an amince da akasin haka a fili a rubuce:
terms.sections.11.body.4: a. Dole ne a biya Med Safar India ta hanyoyin biya da zuwa asusun da aka ƙayyade a takardar kuɗi ta hukuma ta Kamfani ko rubutaccen umarnin biya;
terms.sections.11.body.5: b. Dole ne a biya kuɗaɗen da ake bin Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya ko wani mai ba da ayyuka kai tsaye bisa ga umarnin wannan mai bayarwa;
terms.sections.11.body.6: c. Za a karɓi duk wani haraji da ya dace, ciki har da GST, kamar yadda doka ta buƙata kuma kamar yadda aka ƙayyade a takardar kuɗin da ta dace; da
terms.sections.11.body.7: d. Mara Lafiya yana da alhakin kuɗaɗen banki, kuɗaɗen canjin kuɗin waje ko kuɗaɗen mai ba da hanyar biya da suka shafi hada-hadarsa, inda doka ta halatta karɓar su kuma aka bayyana su.
terms.sections.11.body.8: Med Safar India ba za ta ɗauki alhakin biyan da aka yi wa mutum ko asusu marasa izini ba inda Mara Lafiya ya kasa tabbatar da sahihancin umarnin biya, bisa ga dokar da ta dace da duk wani alhaki da ya rataya kan Kamfani.
terms.sections.11.body.9: Booking na iya kasancewa ba a tabbatar da shi ba har sai an karɓi biyan da ake buƙata da takardu kuma mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa ya tabbatar da samuwa.
terms.sections.12.heading: 13. Soke booking, maido da kuɗi da janyewa daga ayyuka
terms.sections.12.body.0: Haƙƙoƙin soke booking da maido da kuɗi sun dogara ne da irin aikin, matakin da aka soke a cikinsa, ayyukan da aka riga aka yi da sharuɗɗan da suka shafi mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa.
terms.sections.12.body.1: Inda manufar soke booking ko maido da kuɗi ta shafa, Med Safar India za ta sanar da sharuɗɗan da suka dace ta ƙiyasin farashi, tabbacin booking, takardar kuɗi ko wata rubutacciyar takarda.
terms.sections.12.body.3: Idan Mara Lafiya ya soke kafin ya yi tafiya zuwa Indiya, ya kamata ya sanar da Med Safar India a rubuce da wuri-wuri gwargwadon iko.
terms.sections.12.body.4: Za a tantance maido da kuɗaɗen da aka biya Med Safar India bisa ga sharuɗɗan aikin da aka amince da su, ayyukan da aka riga aka bayar, kuɗaɗen soke booking da suka dace da dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.12.body.5: Kuɗaɗen da aka riga aka biya asibitoci, likitoci, otal-otal, kamfanonin jirgin sama ko sauran masu bayarwa masu zaman kansu za su kasance ƙarƙashin manufofin maido da kuɗi da soke booking na mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa.
terms.sections.12.body.6: Med Safar India ba za ta iya ba da tabbacin dawo da kuɗin da aka biya wani mai bayarwa mai zaman kansa ba inda sharuɗɗan wannan mai bayarwa ba su halatta maido da kuɗi ba.
terms.sections.12.body.8: Idan Mara Lafiya ya yanke shawarar kada ya ci gaba da jinyar da aka gabatar bayan isowa ko ganawa da likita, kuɗaɗen da aka riga aka kashe don ganawa da likita, gwaje-gwaje, masauki, sufuri, ayyukan gudanarwa ko sauran booking na iya ci gaba da kasancewa abin biya.
terms.sections.12.body.9: Duk wani maido da ajiyar kuɗin asibiti ko na jinya zai kasance ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗan mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa, bisa ga dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.12.body.11: Idan Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya ya soke, ya ɗage ko ya ƙi wani aikin likitanci, Med Safar India za ta, inda zai yiwu bisa hankali, taimaka da sadarwa da shirya sauran zaɓuɓɓukan da ake da su.
terms.sections.12.body.12: Za a yanke hukuncin duk wani maido da kuɗaɗen mai bayarwa ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗan mai bayarwa da dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.12.body.14: Inda Med Safar India ta amince da maido da kuɗin da ta karɓa, yawanci za a aiwatar da maido da kuɗin ta hanyar biyan da aka yi amfani da ita da farko, bisa ga buƙatun mai ba da hanyar biya da dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.12.body.15: Dole ne a bayyana duk wani ragi da aka halatta, a ba da hujjarsa, kuma ya dace da sharuɗɗan da aka amince da su da dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.12.body.16: Babu wani abu a wannan sashe da ke cire maido da kuɗi ko mafita da dokar da ta dace ta wajabta.
terms.sections.13.heading: 14. Sauye-sauye ga booking da tsarin tafiya
terms.sections.13.body.0: Buƙatun sauya ranakun ganawa da likita, jadawalin jinya, masauki, sufuri ko shirye-shiryen tafiya suna ƙarƙashin samuwa da manufofin mai bayarwa da ya dace.
terms.sections.13.body.1: Sauye-sauye na iya haifar da ƙarin kuɗaɗe, sabon ƙiyasi ko kuɗaɗen soke booking.
terms.sections.13.body.2: Jadawalin jinya na iya sauyawa saboda buƙatun likitanci, samuwar ma'aikatan lafiya, ƙarfin ɗaukar asibiti, gwaje-gwaje ko wasu yanayi da suka fi ƙarfin ikon Med Safar India bisa hankali.
terms.sections.13.body.3: Med Safar India za ta yi ƙoƙari mai dacewa don sanar da sauye-sauyen da aka kawo mata sani kuma ta taimaka da daidaitawa inda hakan na cikin ayyukan da aka amince da su.
terms.sections.13.body.4: Ya kamata Marasa Lafiya su guji yin booking na tafiya ko na nishaɗi wanda ba a maido da kuɗinsa ba kuma ya dogara da jadawalin jinya da ba a tabbatar ba.
terms.sections.14.heading: 15. Al'amuran tafiya, masauki, biza da shige da fice
terms.sections.14.body.0: Inda aka nema musamman, Med Safar India na iya taimakawa wajen shirya masauki, sufuri, jiragen sama ko sauran ayyukan da suka shafi tafiya ta hannun masu bayarwa da suka dace.
terms.sections.14.body.1: Sai dai idan an amince a fili a rubuce, Med Safar India da kanta ba ta gudanar da kamfanonin jirgin sama, otal-otal, ayyukan sufuri ko hukumomin shige da fice.
terms.sections.14.body.2: Marasa Lafiya suna da alhakin samu da riƙe ingantattun fasfo, biza, izinin tafiya don jinya da sauran takardun da ake buƙata don shiga, zama a, da fita daga Indiya.
terms.sections.14.body.3: Med Safar India na iya sauƙaƙa samun takardun lafiya masu tallafi daga Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da ya dace inda ake da su. Ba za ta iya ba da tabbacin bayarwa, sabuntawa ko aiwatar da biza ko wani izinin tafiya a kan lokaci ba.
terms.sections.14.body.4: Ya kamata a tsara ranakun tafiya tare da shawarar Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya da ke jinya, musamman inda lokacin murmurewa ko ƙarfin hawa jirgin sama ya shafa.
terms.sections.14.body.5: Dole ne Mara Lafiya ya bi shawarar likita game da tafiya da murmurewa. Duk wani sauyi ga shirye-shiryen tafiyar komawa gida zai kasance ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗan kamfanin jirgin sama, masauki ko mai ba da tafiya da ya dace.
terms.sections.15.heading: 16. Inshora
terms.sections.15.body.0: Sai dai idan an haɗa a fili cikin rubutacciyar shawarar aiki, kuɗaɗen sauƙaƙa jinya na Med Safar India ba su haɗa da inshorar tafiya, inshorar lafiya ko inshorar da ke rufe matsalolin jinya ba.
terms.sections.15.body.1: Ana ƙarfafa Marasa Lafiya su duba zaɓuɓɓukan inshora da suka dace kafin tafiya, ciki har da rufe soke tafiya, kuɗaɗen jinyar gaggawa, mayar da mutum ƙasarsa, katsewar tafiya da sauran haɗari masu alaƙa.
terms.sections.15.body.2: Ya kamata Marasa Lafiya su tabbatar kai tsaye da kamfanin inshora ko jinyar zaɓi a Indiya, matsalolin da suka taso daga jinya, kwashe mara lafiya don jinya da kuɗaɗen da ke tattare da su suna cikin abin da aka rufe.
terms.sections.15.body.3: Med Safar India ba ta ba da tabbacin cancantar inshora, karɓar buƙatar biyan inshora (claim) ko biyan duk wata fa'idar inshora ba.
terms.sections.16.heading: 17. Abubuwan da ke cikin shafin yanar gizo da mallakar fasaha
terms.sections.16.body.0: Duk abubuwan asali da ke kan Shafin Yanar Gizo, ciki har da rubutu, zane-zane, alamar kasuwanci, tambura, abubuwan zane da sauran kayayyakin da Kamfanin ya mallaka ko yake amfani da su bisa doka, suna ƙarƙashin kariyar dokokin mallakar fasaha da suka dace.
terms.sections.16.body.1: Za ku iya shiga da amfani da abubuwan da ke cikin Shafin Yanar Gizo don neman bayani na kanku, ba don kasuwanci ba.
terms.sections.16.body.2: Kada ku kwafa, rarraba, sauya, yi amfani da su don kasuwanci ko sake wallafa abubuwan da ke cikin Shafin Yanar Gizo ba tare da rubutaccen izini tun da farko ba, sai inda dokar da ta dace ta halatta.
terms.sections.16.body.3: Sunaye, tambura da kayayyakin asibitoci, likitoci da sauran ɓangarori na uku sun kasance mallakar masu su, kuma ana iya amfani da su ne kawai da izinin da ya dace.
terms.sections.16.body.4: Kamfanin na iya sabuntawa, sauyawa ko cire abubuwan da ke cikin Shafin Yanar Gizo lokaci zuwa lokaci.
terms.sections.17.heading: 18. Samuwar shafin yanar gizo da amfani da ya dace
terms.sections.17.body.0: Muna burin kiyaye Shafin Yanar Gizo mai inganci da sauƙin shiga, amma ba mu ba da tabbacin samuwarsa ba tare da katsewa ba ko kuɓuta daga kowace matsalar fasaha ba.
terms.sections.17.body.1: Shafin Yanar Gizo na iya kasancewa ba ya samuwa na ɗan lokaci saboda gyare-gyare, haɓakawa, matakan tsaro ko yanayin da ya fi ƙarfin ikonmu bisa hankali.
terms.sections.17.body.2: Kun yarda ba za ku yi amfani da Shafin Yanar Gizo ba daidai ba, ku tsoma baki a aikinsa, ku yi ƙoƙarin shiga ba tare da izini ba, ku aika bayanan ƙarya da gangan ko ku yi amfani da shi don abubuwan da suka saɓa wa doka.
terms.sections.17.body.3: Muna da haƙƙin taƙaita ko dakatar da shiga inda ya zama dole bisa hankali don kare Shafin Yanar Gizo, masu amfani da shi ko muradun Kamfanin na halal, bisa ga dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.18.heading: 19. Iyakance alhaki
terms.sections.18.body.0: Med Safar India za ta yi taka-tsantsan mai dacewa wajen gudanar da ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya da aka amince da su a fili tare da Mara Lafiya.
terms.sections.18.body.1: Gwargwadon abin da dokar da ta dace ta halatta, Kamfanin ba zai ɗauki alhakin asarar da ta samo asali kawai daga shawarwarin likitanci na kansa, ayyuka ko sakacin Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya ba, ko daga aikin wani mai ba da ayyuka mai zaman kansa, inda irin waɗannan al'amura ba su cikin alhakin Kamfanin.
terms.sections.18.body.2: Kamfanin ba ya ba da tabbacin hali, samuwa, aiki ko sakamakon ayyukan da ɓangarori na uku ke bayarwa da kansu.
terms.sections.18.body.3: Gwargwadon abin da doka ta halatta, Med Safar India ba za ta ɗauki alhakin asara ta kaikaice ko mai biyo baya da ba za a iya hasashenta bisa hankali ba, ciki har da asarar damar kasuwanci da ake tsammani ko kuɗaɗen da suka taso daga shirye-shiryen tafiya na kai da ba su da alaƙa da ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya da aka amince da su.
terms.sections.18.body.4: Kamfanin ba zai ɗauki alhakin jinkiri ko gazawar da abubuwan da suka fi ƙarfin ikonsa bisa hankali suka haifar ba, matuƙar ya bi duk wajibai na doka da suka dace.
terms.sections.18.body.5: Babu wani abu a waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da ke cire ko taƙaita alhaki inda doka ta hana irin wannan cirewa ko taƙaitawa, ciki har da alhakin da ba za a iya cirewa bisa doka ba saboda zamba, mugun aiki da gangan, sakaci ko karya wani wajibi na doka.
terms.sections.18.body.6: Babu wani abu a waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da aka yi niyyar cire duk wani haƙƙin mai sayayya da ba za a iya yafewa ba ko sauran kariyar da Mara Lafiya ke da ita ƙarƙashin dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.19.heading: 20. Biyan diyya
terms.sections.19.body.0: Gwargwadon abin da dokar da ta dace ta halatta, kun yarda ku biya Med Safar India diyyar asara kai tsaye da kuɗaɗe masu dacewa da suka taso daga amfaninku da Shafin Yanar Gizo ta hanyar da ta saɓa wa doka, ɓatar da bayani da gangan, zamba ko karya waɗannan Sharuɗɗa ta hanya mai muhimmanci.
terms.sections.19.body.1: Wannan tanadi ya shafi asarar da doka ta danganta da halinku ne kawai, kuma ba ya buƙatar ku biya Kamfanin diyyar asarar da sakacinsa, karya dokarsa ko wani hali da yake da alhakinsa bisa doka suka haifar.
terms.sections.20.heading: 21. Sirri da sadarwa
terms.sections.20.body.0: Med Safar India za ta ɗauki matakai masu dacewa don kiyaye bayanan sirri da aka karɓa dangane da ayyukanta, bisa ga dokar da ta dace da buƙatun ba da waɗannan ayyuka.
terms.sections.20.body.1: Ana iya bayyana bayanai ga Masu Ba da Kiwon Lafiya, abokan hulɗa na ayyuka ko wakilai masu izini da suka dace inda ya zama dole bisa hankali don ba da ayyukan da aka nema kuma inda doka ta halatta.
terms.sections.20.body.2: Kun yarda ku ba da ingantattun bayanan tuntuɓa kuma ku riƙa duba saƙonnin da suka shafi alƙawura, biya, takardu da shirye-shiryen tafiya.
terms.sections.20.body.3: Ana iya amfani da sadarwa ta na'ura don daidaita al'amuran gudanarwa, bisa ga dokar da ta dace da matakan kariya masu dacewa. Duk da haka, imel na yau da kullum ko manhajojin aika saƙo ƙila ba sa samar da matakin tsaro ɗaya da tsarin bayanan lafiya na musamman.
terms.sections.21.heading: 22. Shafukan yanar gizo da kayayyakin ɓangare na uku
terms.sections.21.body.0: Shafin Yanar Gizo na iya ƙunsar hanyoyin haɗi zuwa shafukan yanar gizo na waje, kayayyakin bayani ko masu ba da ayyuka don sauƙi ko don ba da bayani.
terms.sections.21.body.1: Med Safar India ba ta da iko kan duk shafukan yanar gizo na waje, kuma ba ta da alhakin abubuwan da ke cikinsu, tsaronsu, hanyoyin kiyaye sirrinsu ko samuwarsu.
terms.sections.21.body.2: Shiga shafukan yanar gizo na ɓangare na uku ya rage naku, kuma yana ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗansu da manufofinsu na sirri da suka dace.
terms.sections.22.heading: 23. Dakatarwa ko kawo ƙarshen ayyuka
terms.sections.22.body.0: Med Safar India na iya dakatarwa ko daina ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya inda ya zama dole bisa hankali saboda rashin biya, bayanan da ba daidai ba sosai, halin da ya saɓa wa doka, rashin samuwar mai bayarwa ko wasu dalilai na halal na gudanarwa ko na doka.
terms.sections.22.body.1: Inda zai yiwu bisa hankali, Kamfanin zai sanar da dalilin dakatarwa ko kawo ƙarshen ayyuka da duk wasu matakai na gaba da ake da su.
terms.sections.22.body.2: Kawo ƙarshen ayyuka ba zai shafe wajiban biyan da aka riga aka ɗauka ko haƙƙoƙin kwangila da haƙƙin maido da kuɗi da suka riga suka tabbata kai tsaye ba.
terms.sections.22.body.3: Duk wani maido da kuɗi da ya wajaba bayan kawo ƙarshen ayyuka za a yanke hukuncinsa ƙarƙashin yarjejeniyar aiki, sharuɗɗan soke booking da dokar da suka dace.
terms.sections.23.heading: 24. Sauye-sauye ga waɗannan sharuɗɗa
terms.sections.23.body.0: Med Safar India na iya sake duba waɗannan Sharuɗɗa lokaci zuwa lokaci don nuna sauye-sauye a ayyukanta, hanyoyin gudanarwarta ko dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.23.body.1: Za a wallafa sabon tsari a Shafin Yanar Gizo tare da sabuwar ranar fara aiki.
terms.sections.23.body.2: Sauye-sauye za su fara aiki daga nan gaba, bisa ga dokar da ta dace da duk wasu haƙƙoƙin kwangila da ake da su. Inda wani sauyi ya shafi wani booking ko tsarin aiki da ake da shi ta hanya mai muhimmanci, sharuɗɗan da aka amince da su da buƙatun doka na wajibi ne za su yi aiki.
terms.sections.23.body.3: Ya kamata ku riƙa duba waɗannan Sharuɗɗa lokaci-lokaci lokacin da kuke amfani da Shafin Yanar Gizo ko kuke neman ayyuka.
terms.sections.24.heading: 25. Dokar da ke aiki da hurumin kotu
terms.sections.24.body.0: Dokokin Indiya ne za su tsara waɗannan Sharuɗɗa.
terms.sections.24.body.1: Bisa ga dokar da ta dace, kotunan da ke da hurumi a Mumbai, Maharashtra, Indiya, za su sami hurumin sauraron rikice-rikicen da suka taso daga waɗannan Sharuɗɗa.
terms.sections.24.body.2: Babu wani abu a wannan sashe da ke hana Mara Lafiya amfani da haƙƙin kai ƙara gaban hukumar kare masu sayayya, hukumar sa ido ko wani dandali inda dokar da ta dace ta ba da irin wannan haƙƙi.
terms.sections.24.body.3: Ana ƙarfafa ɓangarorin su yi ƙoƙarin warware damuwa ta hanyar tattaunawa cikin kyakkyawar niyya kafin fara shari'a a hukumance, ba tare da taƙaita duk wani haƙƙi na doka ko wa'adin lokaci da ya dace ba.
terms.sections.25.heading: 26. Raba tanadi
terms.sections.25.body.0: Idan wata hukuma mai iko ta gano cewa wani tanadi na waɗannan Sharuɗɗa ba shi da inganci, ya saɓa wa doka ko ba za a iya aiwatar da shi ba, za a taƙaita ko a cire wannan tanadi gwargwadon abin da ya zama dole.
terms.sections.25.body.1: Sauran tanade-tanaden za su ci gaba da aiki gwargwadon yadda suka kasance masu inganci kuma ana iya aiwatar da su ƙarƙashin dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.26.heading: 27. Cikakkiyar yarjejeniya da tsarin fifiko
terms.sections.26.body.0: Waɗannan Sharuɗɗa, tare da ƙiyasin farashi, shawarar aiki, tabbacin booking, Manufar Sirri da duk wata yarjejeniya da aka sa hannu daban da suka dace, su ne sharuɗɗan da ke tsara ayyukan da abin ya shafa.
terms.sections.26.body.1: Idan wata takamaiman rubutacciyar yarjejeniyar aiki ta sauya wani tanadi na waɗannan Sharuɗɗa a fili, wannan yarjejeniya ce za ta yi rinjaye gwargwadon saɓanin, don ayyukan da ta rufe.
terms.sections.26.body.2: Babu wani abu a waɗannan Sharuɗɗa da ke soke wani tanadi na wajibi na dokar da ta dace.
terms.sections.27.heading: 28. Bayanan tuntuɓa
terms.sections.27.body.0: Don tambayoyi, bayani kan waɗannan Sharuɗɗa ko taimako game da ayyukan Med Safar India, don Allah ku tuntuɓi:
terms.sections.27.body.2: Yana aiki da sunan kasuwanci Med Safar India
terms.sections.27.body.3: Office No. 222, 2nd Floor, Neo Corporate Plaza, Malad West, Mumbai, Maharashtra – 400064, India.
terms.sections.27.body.7: Ta hanyar shiga Shafin Yanar Gizo ko ɗaukar ayyukan Med Safar India, kun tabbatar da cewa kun sami damar duba waɗannan Sharuɗɗa, kuma amfaninku da ayyukan da abin ya shafa yana ƙarƙashin tanade-tanaden da suka dace da aka bayyana a sama da kuma ƙarƙashin dokar da ta dace.
