disclaimer.meta.description: Menene bayanan da ke wannan shafin yanar gizo, kuma menene ba su ba.
disclaimer.heading: Sanarwar iyakance alhaki ta shafin yanar gizo
disclaimer.intro: Bayanan lafiya, sauƙaƙa kiwon lafiya da tafiya don jinya.
disclaimer.draft: Daftari. Ana nazarin wannan rubutu ta fuskar doka kuma yana iya sauyawa.
disclaimer.updated.label: An sabunta a ƙarshe
disclaimer.sections.0.heading: 1. Sanarwa ta gaba ɗaya
disclaimer.sections.0.body.0: Bayanan da aka bayar a wannan shafin yanar gizo, ciki har da rubutu, maƙaloli, hotuna, bidiyo, abubuwan da ake iya saukewa, abubuwan kafofin sada zumunta da sauran saƙonnin da Med Safar India (“Med Safar”, “mu”, “gare mu” ko “namu”) ke fitarwa, an yi su ne don ba da bayani da ilimi na gaba ɗaya kawai.
disclaimer.sections.0.body.1: Ko da yake muna taka-tsantsan mai dacewa don kiyaye bayanai daidai kuma na zamani, bayanan kiwon lafiya, ayyukan asibiti, alaƙar likitoci da asibitoci, farashi, samuwa, buƙatun tafiya da sharuɗɗan hukumomi na iya sauyawa. Ba mu ba da tabbacin cewa dukkan bayanai cikakku ne, na zamani ne, ba su da kuskure ko sun dace da yanayin kowane mutum ba.
disclaimer.sections.0.body.2: Amfaninku da wannan shafin yanar gizo ba ya kafa dangantakar likita da mara lafiya, dangantakar asibiti da mara lafiya, dangantakar amana ko wata dangantaka ta ƙwararrun likitanci tsakaninku da Med Safar India.
disclaimer.sections.1.heading: 2. Ba shawarar likita ba ce, ba gano cuta ba ce, ba jinya ba ce
disclaimer.sections.1.body.0: Med Safar India hidima ce ta sauƙaƙa kiwon lafiya da shirya tafiya don jinya. Mu ba asibiti ba ne, ba asibitin shan magani ba ne, ba dakin gwaje-gwaje ba ne, ba kantin magani ba ne, ba hidimar gaggawa ta lafiya ba ne, kuma ba likita ba ne. Sai dai idan an faɗi akasin haka a fili, ba ma gano cuta, ba ma rubuta magani, ba ma fassara binciken lafiya a matsayin likitan da ke jinya, kuma ba ma ba da jinya.
disclaimer.sections.1.body.1: Kada a dogara da abubuwan da ke cikin shafin yanar gizo a matsayin madadin ganawa, gano cuta ko jinya daga ƙwararren ma'aikacin lafiya mai cancanta wanda ya tantance yanayin lafiyarku na musamman.
disclaimer.sections.1.body.2: Kada ku yi watsi da, jinkirta ko daina shawarar ƙwararren likita ko jinyar da aka rubuta muku saboda bayanan da ke wannan shafin yanar gizo.
disclaimer.sections.1.body.3: Kada ku fara, ku daina ko ku sauya wani magani, jinya, abinci ko tsarin jinya bisa abubuwan da ke cikin shafin yanar gizo ko saƙonni daga mai sauƙaƙa jinya kaɗai.
disclaimer.sections.1.body.4: Dole ne a tattauna dacewar jinya, sauran zaɓuɓɓuka, amfani, haɗari, matsaloli, abin da ake tsammani game da murmurewa da hasashen yanayin cuta kai tsaye da likita da asibitin da ke jinya.
disclaimer.sections.1.body.5: Yanayin lafiya ya bambanta daga mutum zuwa mutum. Bayani game da wata cuta ko aikin likitanci ƙila bai shafe ku ba.
disclaimer.sections.2.heading: 3. Al'amuran gaggawa na lafiya
disclaimer.sections.2.body.0: Ba a tsara wannan shafin yanar gizo da hanyoyin sadarwar Med Safar India don al'amuran gaggawa ba, kuma ba a sa ido a kansu a matsayin hidimar amsa gaggawa. Idan kuna tunanin ku ko wani mutum na iya fuskantar gaggawar lafiya, ku kira lambar gaggawa ta yankinku ko ku tafi sashen gaggawa mafi kusa nan take. Kada ku jira amsa daga Med Safar India.
disclaimer.sections.3.heading: 4. Shawarwarin likitanci masu zaman kansu da alhakin mara lafiya
disclaimer.sections.3.body.0: Marasa lafiya suna da alhakin yanke shawarar kiwon lafiya tare da shawarar ƙwararrun likitocin da ke jinyar su. Med Safar India na iya taimakawa wajen shirya sadarwa, alƙawura, raba takardun lafiya, tafiya da sauran shirye-shirye da ba na likitanci ba, amma ba ta yanke hukunci kan ko wata jinya ta dace ta fuskar likitanci ga wani mara lafiya ba.
disclaimer.sections.3.body.1: Kafin ci gaba da kowace jinya, ya kamata marasa lafiya su tattauna da kansu kuma su fahimci shirin jinyar da aka gabatar, sauran zaɓuɓɓuka, amfanin da ake tsammani, manyan haɗari, matsalolin da ka iya faruwa, abin da murmurewa ke buƙata, kulawar bibiya da kuɗin da ake iya kashewa. Ya kamata marasa lafiya su ba da cikakken tarihin lafiya mai inganci kuma su bayyana rashin jituwa da abubuwa (allergies), magunguna, ayyukan likitanci da aka yi a baya da sauran bayanai masu dacewa ga likitocin da ke jinyar su.
disclaimer.sections.4.heading: 5. Babu tabbacin sakamakon jinya
disclaimer.sections.4.body.0: Med Safar India ba ta ba da tabbacin warkewa, nasarar aikin likitanci, jinya ba tare da matsala ba, lokacin murmurewa, sakamakon likitanci, yawan rayuwa, ingantuwar lafiya ko wani takamaiman sakamako ba. Duk wani alƙaluman sakamako, shaidu, misalan al'amura ko maganganun da aka danganta ga mai ba da kiwon lafiya dole ne a karanta su a cikin mahallin da aka faɗa, kuma ba alƙawari ba ne cewa wani mara lafiya zai sami sakamako iri ɗaya.
disclaimer.sections.4.body.1: Sakamakon jinya ya dogara da abubuwa da yawa, ciki har da yanayin mara lafiya, hukuncin likita, zaɓin jinya, yadda jikin kowane mutum ke karɓa, matsaloli da kulawa bayan jinya.
disclaimer.sections.5.heading: 6. Asibitoci, likitoci da masu ba da kiwon lafiya na ɓangare na uku
disclaimer.sections.5.body.0: Asibitoci, likitoci, likitocin tiyata, cibiyoyin bincike, dakunan gwaje-gwaje, kantunan magani da sauran masu ba da kiwon lafiya ɓangarori na uku ne masu zaman kansu sai dai idan wata takamaiman rubutacciyar yarjejeniya ta faɗi akasin haka. Su ke da alhakin ayyukansu na ƙwarewa, shawarwarinsu na likitanci, kayan aikinsu, ma'aikatansu, jinya, takardun marasa lafiya, hanyoyin neman izini, karɓar kuɗi da kula da marasa lafiya.
disclaimer.sections.5.body.1: Duk wani bayani game da asibiti ko likita da ke kan shafin yanar gizonmu an bayar da shi ne don taimaka wa masu amfani su binciki zaɓuɓɓukan da ake da su. Kada a ɗauki lissafawa, bayanin martaba, gabatarwa, shirya alƙawari ko tura mara lafiya a matsayin goyon bayan likitanci, tabbaci, takardar shaida, matsayi ko alƙawari daga Med Safar India.
disclaimer.sections.5.body.2: Takardun cancanta, alaƙa, takardun amincewa, kayan aiki, samuwar jinya da bayanan ayyuka na iya sauyawa, kuma ya kamata a tabbatar da su kai tsaye da mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa kafin yanke shawara.
disclaimer.sections.5.body.3: Takardun amincewa ko na shaida, inda aka ambace su, suna aiki ne kawai a cikin iyakar da aka bayyana da kuma tsawon lokacin ingancinsu.
disclaimer.sections.5.body.4: Med Safar India ba ta da iko kan hukuncin ƙwarewa na kansa ko halin masu ba da kiwon lafiya.
disclaimer.sections.5.body.5: Ya kamata marasa lafiya su yi tambayoyin likitanci, su nemi ra'ayi na biyu inda ya dace, kuma su tabbatar da dukkan bayanan jinya kai tsaye da mai bayarwa da suka zaɓa.
disclaimer.sections.6.heading: 7. Matsayin mai sauƙaƙa jinya da alaƙar kasuwanci
disclaimer.sections.6.body.0: Med Safar India na iya karɓar kuɗaɗen sauƙaƙa jinya, kuɗaɗen tura mara lafiya, kwamishan ko wata ladar kasuwanci daga wasu masu ba da kiwon lafiya ko abokan hulɗa na ayyuka, inda dokar da ta dace da kwangila suka halatta. Inda irin wannan alaƙa ta shafi wani takamaiman lissafawa, matsayi ko saƙo, ya kamata a bayyana ta a fili.
disclaimer.sections.6.body.1: Alaƙar kasuwanci ba ta zama goyon bayan likitanci ba, kuma kada ta maye gurbin tantancewa mai zaman kanta ta dacewar lafiya. Ana ƙarfafa marasa lafiya su yi tambayoyi game da duk wasu kuɗaɗen sauƙaƙa jinya, abubuwan da aka haɗa, waɗanda ba a haɗa ba da tsarin biya kafin su ci gaba.
disclaimer.sections.6.body.2: Sai dai idan an tabbatar a fili a rubuce, Med Safar India ba ta iƙirarin cewa za ta iya samar da wani takamaiman likita, alƙawari, gadon asibiti, ranar aikin likitanci, farashi, ragi, amincewar inshora ko sakamakon jinya ba.
disclaimer.sections.7.heading: 8. Ƙiyasi, kuɗaɗe, fakitoci da biya
disclaimer.sections.7.body.0: Duk wani kuɗin jinya, farashin fakiti, ƙiyasin tafiya, farashin masauki, kuɗin asibiti, ragi, kuɗin sauƙaƙa jinya ko wani adadi da Med Safar India ta nuna ko ta sanar na nuni ne kawai, sai dai idan an faɗi a fili cewa ƙiyasin farashi ne da aka tabbatar a rubuce.
disclaimer.sections.7.body.1: Kuɗaɗen ƙarshe na iya dogara da tantancewar likitan da ke jinya, gwaje-gwaje, aikin likitancin da aka zaɓa, tsawon zama, matsaloli, magunguna, kayan amfani na lokaci ɗaya, irin ɗaki, haraji, sauyin farashin kuɗi da sauran yanayi.
disclaimer.sections.7.body.2: Asibiti ko mai ba da ayyuka na iya sake duba farashinsa, samuwa, abubuwan da aka haɗa ko sharuɗɗansa. Ku tabbatar da ƙiyasin farashi na ƙarshe kai tsaye da mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa kafin biya.
disclaimer.sections.7.body.3: Sai dai idan an faɗi a fili a rubuce, ƙiyasi na iya rashin haɗawa da ƙarin gwaje-gwaje, magunguna, abubuwan da ake sakawa a jiki (implants), tsawaita zama, matsaloli, kulawar bibiya, sauye-sauyen tafiya, kuɗaɗen biza, inshora, haraji ko kuɗaɗen kai.
disclaimer.sections.7.body.4: Ya kamata a tabbatar a rubuce da waɗanda za su karɓi biya, wa'adin biya, sharuɗɗan maido da kuɗi, sharuɗɗan soke booking da harajin da ya dace kafin yin hada-hada.
disclaimer.sections.7.body.5: Med Safar India ba ta da alhakin kuskuren karɓar kuɗi na mai bayarwa na ɓangare na uku, shawararsa kan maido da kuɗi, rikicin biya ko gazawarsa wajen cika ƙiyasin farashinsa, sai dai gwargwadon alhakin da dokar da ta dace ko kwangila ta ɗora kan Med Safar India.
disclaimer.sections.8.heading: 9. Tafiya, biza, masauki da shige da fice
disclaimer.sections.8.body.0: Bayanan tafiya da na tafiya don jinya na gaba ɗaya ne, kuma suna iya sauyawa ba tare da sanarwa ba. Bayar da biza, izinin shiga, izinin shige da fice, jadawalin jiragen sama, hane-hanen tafiya, samuwar masauki da sufuri a cikin gari suna ƙarƙashin ikon hukumomin gwamnati da abin ya shafa da masu ba da ayyuka masu zaman kansu.
disclaimer.sections.8.body.1: Med Safar India ba ta ba da tabbacin amincewa da biza, shiga kowace ƙasa, tashin jirgi, kula da kaya, samuwar masauki ko aikin masu samar da tafiya na ɓangare na uku ba. Dole ne matafiya su tabbatar da buƙatun da ake da su yanzu tare da hukumomin gwamnati da masu bayarwa da abin ya shafa, su sami takardun tafiya da inshora da suka dace, kuma su bar isasshen lokaci don shirye-shiryen tafiya.
disclaimer.sections.8.body.2: Ya kamata marasa lafiya su sami izinin likita na yin tafiya inda ya dace, kuma su tattauna da likitan da ke jinyar su game da ƙarfin hawa jirgin sama, lokacin tafiya bayan aikin likitanci, buƙatun motsi da buƙatar wani ya raka su.
disclaimer.sections.9.heading: 10. Jinya a ƙasashen waje da ci gaba da kulawa
disclaimer.sections.9.body.0: Ya kamata marasa lafiya da ke tafiya zuwa wata ƙasa su tattauna ci gaba da kulawa da likitan da ke jinyar su kafin tafiya. Wannan na iya haɗawa da taƙaitaccen bayanin sallama daga asibiti, takardun magani, takardun lafiya, kula da rauni, gyaran jiki, ganawar bibiya, samuwar magunguna da shirin magance matsaloli bayan komawa gida.
disclaimer.sections.9.body.1: Med Safar India ba za ta iya ba da tabbacin cewa likita ko asibiti a ƙasar mara lafiya za su karɓa, ci gaba ko ba da kulawar bibiya ga jinyar da aka yi a wani wuri ba. Ya kamata marasa lafiya su nemo shirye-shiryen bibiya masu dacewa a gida kafin tafiya.
disclaimer.sections.10.heading: 11. Shaidu, labaran marasa lafiya da nazarin al'amura
disclaimer.sections.10.body.0: Shaidun marasa lafiya da nazarin al'amura suna nuna abin da ya faru da mutum ɗaya ne, kuma ba iƙirarin sakamakon da aka saba samu ba ne ko tabbaci. Abubuwan da mutane suka fuskanta da sakamako sun bambanta. Inda aka wallafa labaran marasa lafiya, hotuna, bidiyo ko maganganunsu, ya kamata a yi amfani da su ne kawai da izinin da ya dace kuma bisa ga buƙatun sirri da talla da suka dace.
disclaimer.sections.10.body.1: Kada a ɗauki shaida a matsayin hujjar likitanci ko madadin shawarar likita mai zaman kanta. Ya kamata a bayyana duk wata muhimmiyar alaƙa ko lada da ke da alaƙa da shaida inda ake buƙata.
disclaimer.sections.11.heading: 12. Shafukan yanar gizo na waje da abubuwan ɓangare na uku
disclaimer.sections.11.body.0: Shafin yanar gizonmu na iya ƙunsar hanyoyin haɗi zuwa shafukan yanar gizo na ɓangare na uku, shafukan kafofin sada zumunta, taswirori, hanyoyin biyan kuɗi, shafukan asibitoci, tushen bincike ko wasu ayyukan intanet. An bayar da waɗannan hanyoyin haɗi ne don sauƙi. Med Safar India ba ta da iko kuma ba ta da alhakin abubuwan da ke ciki, samuwa, tsaro, hanyoyin kiyaye sirri, sahihanci ko sharuɗɗan shafukan yanar gizo na ɓangare na uku.
disclaimer.sections.11.body.1: Shiga shafin yanar gizo na ɓangare na uku ko amfani da hidimar ɓangare na uku ya rage naku, kuma yana ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗa da manufar sirri ta wannan mai bayarwa. Hanyar haɗi ba lallai ba ne ta nuna goyon baya ko haɗin gwiwa.
disclaimer.sections.12.heading: 13. Samuwar shafin yanar gizo, tsaro da bayanan fasaha
disclaimer.sections.12.body.0: Muna burin kiyaye shafin yanar gizo cikin sauƙin shiga da tsaro, amma ba mu ba da tabbacin cewa zai yi aiki ba tare da katsewa ba, ba tare da kuskure ba ko ba tare da ƙwayoyin cutar kwamfuta (virus) ba. Ana iya dakatar da shiga, taƙaita shi ko katse shi saboda gyare-gyare, sabuntawa, dalilai na tsaro, matsalolin fasaha ko yanayin da ya fi ƙarfin ikonmu.
disclaimer.sections.12.body.1: Ya kamata masu amfani su ɗauki matakan kariya masu dacewa don kare na'urorinsu, asusunsu da bayanansu. Kada ku aika takardun lafiya masu muhimmanci ko takardun shaida ta hanyar da ba a amince da ita ba ko maras tsaro. Don Allah ku yi amfani da hanyar tuntuɓa ko aikawa da Med Safar India ta keɓe musamman don irin waɗannan bayanai.
disclaimer.sections.13.heading: 14. Iyakance alhaki
disclaimer.sections.13.body.0: Gwargwadon iyakar abin da dokar da ta dace ta halatta, Med Safar India ba za ta ɗauki alhakin asarar da ta samo asali daga dogaron mai amfani kan bayanan gaba ɗaya na shafin yanar gizo, shawarwarin da aka yanke ba tare da shawarar ƙwararru da ta dace ba, ayyuka ko sakacin masu ba da kiwon lafiya ko tafiya masu zaman kansu, sauye-sauye a ayyukan ɓangare na uku, ko abubuwan da suka fi ƙarfin ikon Med Safar India bisa hankali ba.
disclaimer.sections.13.body.1: Babu wani abu a wannan sanarwa da ke cire ko taƙaita duk wani alhaki da ba za a iya cirewa ko taƙaitawa bisa doka ba ƙarƙashin dokar da ta dace, ciki har da duk wani haƙƙin mai sayayya da ba za a iya yafewa ba, kariyar doka, ko alhakin zamba, mugun aiki da gangan ko wani alhaki da doka ba ta ba mu damar cirewa ba.
disclaimer.sections.13.body.2: Dole ne a karanta duk wani iyakance alhaki bisa ga dokar Indiya da ta dace da takamaiman ayyuka da tsare-tsaren kwangila da abin ya shafa. Ba a yi niyyar wannan sashe ya cire haƙƙoƙin da mara lafiya ko mai sayayya ke da su ƙarƙashin doka ba.
disclaimer.sections.14.heading: 15. Sirri da bayanan sirri
disclaimer.sections.14.body.0: Za a sarrafa bayanan sirri da bayanan da suka shafi lafiya da aka aika wa Med Safar India bisa ga Manufarmu ta Sirri da dokokin kare bayanai da suka dace. Don Allah ku karanta Manufar Sirri don fahimtar irin bayanan da za a iya tattarawa, dalilin amfani da su, lokacin da za a iya raba su da yadda za ku tuntuɓe mu kan al'amuran sirri.
disclaimer.sections.14.body.1: Kada ku aika bayanan sirri ko na lafiya na wani mutum sai dai idan kuna da izinin yin hakan kuma an sami duk wani izinin da ake buƙata.
disclaimer.sections.15.heading: 16. Mallakar fasaha
disclaimer.sections.15.body.0: Sai dai idan an faɗi akasin haka, rubutun shafin yanar gizo, zane, zane-zane, tambura, bidiyo, hotuna da sauran abubuwan da Med Safar India ta mallaka suna ƙarƙashin kariyar dokokin mallakar fasaha da suka dace. Za ku iya duba shafin yanar gizo don amfanin kanku, ba na kasuwanci ba. Kada ku kwafa, sake samarwa, sake wallafawa, rarrabawa, sauyawa ko yin amfani da abubuwan da ke da kariya don kasuwanci ba tare da rubutaccen izini tun da farko ba, sai inda doka ta halatta.
disclaimer.sections.15.body.1: Sunaye, tambura, alamomin kasuwanci da kayayyakin ɓangarori na uku sun kasance mallakar masu su. Bayyanarsu a shafin yanar gizo ba ta nuna cewa Med Safar India ce ta mallake su ko tana goyon bayansu ba.
disclaimer.sections.16.heading: 17. Yara da amfani ta hannun wakilai
disclaimer.sections.16.body.0: Ba a yi shafin yanar gizo don gayyatar yara su aika bayanan sirri ko na lafiya da kansu ko su shirya al'amuran kiwon lafiya ba. Inda ayyuka suka shafi ƙaramin yaro, dole ne iyaye ko mai kula da shi bisa doka su yi aiki a madadinsa kuma su ba da duk wani izini da yarda da doka ke buƙata. Dole ne a bi buƙatun kare yara da kare bayanai da suka dace.
disclaimer.sections.17.heading: 18. Sauye-sauye ga wannan sanarwa
disclaimer.sections.17.body.0: Za mu iya sabunta wannan sanarwa lokaci zuwa lokaci don nuna sauye-sauye a ayyukanmu, shafin yanar gizo, tsare-tsaren abokan hulɗa, fasaha ko dokar da ta dace. Za a wallafa sabon tsari a wannan shafi tare da sabuwar ranar fara aiki ko ta sake dubawa. Ci gaba da amfaninku da shafin yanar gizo bayan wallafa sauye-sauye zai kasance ƙarƙashin sabuwar sanarwar, gwargwadon abin da doka ta halatta.
disclaimer.sections.18.heading: 19. Dokar da ke aiki da hurumin kotu
disclaimer.sections.18.body.0: An yi niyyar fassara wannan sanarwa bisa ga dokokin Indiya, bisa ga duk wata kariya ta doka ta wajibi da haƙƙoƙin hurumin kotu da masu amfani ke da su ƙarƙashin dokar da ta dace. Ya kamata lauyan Indiya ya duba duk wani sashe na dokar da ke aiki ko hurumin kotu a cikin Sharuɗɗa da Ƙa'idojin shafin yanar gizo ko wata yarjejeniya da aka sa hannu daban, don tabbatar da daidaito da yiwuwar aiwatarwa.
disclaimer.sections.19.heading: 20. Bayanan tuntuɓa
disclaimer.sections.19.body.0: Don tambayoyi game da wannan sanarwa ko bayanan da ke wannan shafin yanar gizo, don Allah ku tuntuɓi:
disclaimer.sections.19.body.1: Kamfani bisa doka: TravGrub Private Limited, wanda ke gudanar da sunan kasuwanci Med Safar India.
disclaimer.sections.19.body.3: Ofis: Office No. 222, 2nd Floor, Neo Corporate Plaza, Malad West, Mumbai, Maharashtra – 400064, India.
editorialPolicy.meta.title: Manufar rubutu. Medsafar India.
editorialPolicy.meta.description: Yadda Medsafar ke rubutawa, dubawa da sabunta bayanan da ke wannan shafin yanar gizo.
editorialPolicy.heading: Manufar rubutu
editorialPolicy.intro: Marasa lafiya suna yanke manyan shawarwari bisa abin da suka karanta. Ga yadda muke tabbatar da cewa abin da muke wallafawa a bayyane yake, adalci ne kuma daidai ne.
editorialPolicy.draft: Daftari. Ana nazarin wannan rubutu ta fuskar doka kuma yana iya sauyawa.
editorialPolicy.updated.label: An sabunta a ƙarshe
editorialPolicy.sections.0.heading: Kalmomi masu sauƙi
editorialPolicy.sections.0.body.0: Bayanan kiwon lafiya nauyi ne. Kowane mara lafiya ya cancanci samun bayanai masu inganci, a bayyane, masu sauƙin fahimta kuma amintattu.
editorialPolicy.sections.0.body.1: Med Safar India ta dukufa wajen taimaka wa marasa lafiya da iyalansu su fahimci zaɓuɓɓukan kiwon lafiya kuma su gudanar da tafiya don jinya cikin mutunci da kulawa. An yi rubuce-rubucenmu ne don sanarwa, ilimantarwa da tallafa wa tattaunawa bisa cikakken sani tare da ƙwararrun ma'aikatan lafiya masu cancanta. Kada su taɓa matsa wa wani mutum ya zaɓi wata jinya, asibiti, likita ko tafiya.
editorialPolicy.sections.0.body.2: Muna fifita jin daɗin marasa lafiya, sahihancin gaskiya, bayyana komai a fili, sirri da sadarwa mai ɗa'a fiye da muradun talla.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.heading: Likita ya duba
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.0: Wannan manufa tana kafa ƙa'idojin ƙirƙira, dubawa, amincewa, wallafawa, tallatawa, sabuntawa da gyara abubuwan da Med Safar India ko wani a madadinta ke fitarwa.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.1: Ta shafi duk abubuwa da saƙonnin da ke ƙarƙashin ikonmu, ciki har da:
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.2: Shafukan yanar gizo, bayanin ayyuka, bulogi, maƙaloli, tambayoyin da aka fi yi (FAQ) da abubuwan da ake iya saukewa.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.3: Rubuce-rubuce a kafofin sada zumunta, gajerun bidiyo (reels), bidiyo, shirye-shiryen sauti (podcasts), taruka ta intanet (webinars), wasiƙun labarai da kamfen ɗin imel.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.4: Fakitin bayanai na marasa lafiya, jagororin wurare, bayanin jinya da abubuwan da ake bayarwa kafin isowa.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.5: Jerin asibitoci, likitoci, fannoni da jinya, bayanan martaba, kwatance da hirarraki.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.6: Sanarwar manema labarai, tallace-tallace, ƙasidu, gabatarwa da abubuwan da aka shirya don abokan hulɗa.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.7: Abubuwan da ma'aikata, masu ba da shawara, hukumomi, masu aikin kansu, masu tasiri a kafofin sada zumunta (influencers) ko sauran wakilai suka shirya don Med Safar India.
editorialPolicy.sections.1.body.8: Inda asibiti, likita ko wani abokin hulɗa ne ya ƙirƙira ko yake iko da abubuwan, wannan abokin hulɗa ne ke da alhakin maganganunsa na ƙwarewa da na likitanci. Med Safar India ba za ta wallafa abubuwan abokan hulɗa da gangan ba idan sun saɓa wa wannan manufa ko dokar da ta dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.2.heading: Majiyoyi
editorialPolicy.sections.2.body.0: Med Safar India tana aiki a matsayin hidimar sauƙaƙa kiwon lafiya da shirya tafiya don jinya. Sai dai idan an faɗi akasin haka a fili, ba asibiti ba ce, ba asibitin shan magani ba ce, ba cibiyar bincike ba ce, ba likita ba ce, ba hidimar gaggawa ba ce, kuma ba mai ba da kulawar likitanci ba ce.
editorialPolicy.sections.2.body.1: Abubuwanmu na iya bayyana hanyoyin kiwon lafiya da sauƙaƙa samun bayanai, alƙawura, tura takardu, shirya tafiya da tallafi masu alaƙa da ba na likitanci ba. Ba ma gano cututtuka da kanmu, ba ma rubuta magunguna, ba ma ba da shawarar wata jinya a matsayin madadin likita, ba ma fassara sakamakon gwaje-gwaje a matsayin ƙwararren mai jinya, kuma ba ma ba da tabbacin sakamakon jinya.
editorialPolicy.sections.2.body.2: Dole ne mara lafiya ya yanke shawarar likitanci tare da shawarar ƙwararrun ma'aikatan lafiya masu cancanta da rajista. Kada a gabatar da aikin mai sauƙaƙa jinya a matsayin hukuncin likitanci na kansa na likita.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.heading: Babu alƙawura
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.0: Duk muhimman iƙirari na gaskiya da na likitanci dole ne su kasance daidai, na zamani, masu yiwuwar tabbatarwa kuma an gabatar da su cikin mahallinsu. Dole ne abubuwan su bambance tabbatacciyar hujja daga sabon bincike, ra'ayin ƙwararru, labarin mutum ɗaya da maganganun talla.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.1: Ku yi amfani da tushe na farko ko masu iko amintattu a duk inda ake da su bisa hankali, kamar binciken da ƙwararru suka duba (peer-reviewed), ƙungiyoyin likitanci da aka sani, hukumomin lafiya na gwamnati da takardun asibiti na hukuma.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.2: Ku duba ranakun wallafawa, iyakokin bincike, yawan mutanen da aka yi nazari a kansu, dacewar jama'ar da aka yi nazari, da ko sakamakon na farko ne ko an karɓe shi a ko'ina.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.3: Kada ku mayar da bincike ɗaya, shaida ɗaya ko sakamako ɗaya keɓantacce zuwa alƙawari ko tabbaci na gaba ɗaya.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.4: Ku guji kanun labarai masu tayar da hankali, harshe mai tsoratarwa, gabatar da hotunan kafin da bayan jinya masu ɓatarwa da iƙirarin da ke amfani da raunin mara lafiya.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.5: Kada ku wallafa ƙirƙirarrun alƙaluma, ƙagaggun nazarin al'amura, yawan nasara marasa hujja ko matsayi da ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.6: Inda aka yi amfani da alƙaluma, ku bayyana tushensu, ranarsu, jama'ar da suka shafa da iyakokinsu. Kada ku nuna cewa wani mai bincike mai zaman kansa ya tantance sakamakon asibiti ko likita sai dai idan hakan gaskiya ne a bayyane.
editorialPolicy.sections.3.body.7: Kalmomin da aka hana ko masu haɗari sun haɗa da iƙirari kamar “warkewa 100%”, “tabbatacciyar nasara”, “tiyata ba tare da haɗari ba”, “mafita ta dindindin”, “mafi kyawun likita a Indiya”, “asibiti na 1” ko “tabbataccen sakamako”, sai dai idan akwai takamaiman hujja, ta halal kuma mai zaman kanta da za ta tallafa masa, kuma binciken doka ya amince da ainihin iƙirarin. A al'amuran likitanci, yawanci bai kamata a yi amfani da irin waɗannan iƙirari na cikakken tabbaci ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.heading: 'Yancin kai
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.0: Abubuwan da suka tattauna alamomin ciwo, cututtuka, gano cuta, zaɓuɓɓukan jinya, ayyukan likitanci, magunguna, murmurewa, matsaloli, sakamakon jinya ko binciken likitanci dole ne ƙwararren likita mai cancanta da ya dace ya duba su kafin wallafawa.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.1: Ya kamata mai dubawa ya kasance yana da ƙwarewa a fannin da abin ya shafa. Ana iya nuna sunansa, cancantarsa, fanninsa da ranar dubawa inda ya dace kuma da izininsa. Kada a kira mai dubawa mai binciken likitanci mai zaman kansa idan yana da wata muhimmiyar alaƙar kasuwanci da ba a bayyana ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.2: Idan Med Safar India ba ta da mai dubawa mai cancanta da ya dace, dole ne a taƙaita abubuwan zuwa bayanan hanyoyin aiki da ba na likitanci ba, a samo su cikin taka-tsantsan, ko a riƙe su har sai an sami dubawa da ta dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.4.body.3: Duba ta fuskar likitanci ba ya maye gurbin buƙatar dubawa ta fuskar doka, sirri, talla ko gyaran rubutu.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.heading: Sabunta bayanai
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.0: Bayanan martaba da jeri dole ne su kasance na gaskiya, masu adalci, na zamani kuma bisa amintattun bayanai ko tabbaci daga cibiya ko ƙwararren da abin ya shafa.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.1: Ku tabbatar da sunan likita, cancantarsa, fanninsa, bayanan rajistarsa da alaƙarsa ta aiki ta yanzu ta amfani da tushe na hukuma ko na cibiya da suka dace, inda ake da su.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.2: Ku tabbatar da sunayen asibitoci, wurare, kayan aiki, takardun amincewa, takardun shaida da ayyukan fannoni tare da cibiyar ko hukumar ba da amincewa da abin ya shafa. Ku bayyana iyaka da tsawon lokacin ingancin kowace takardar amincewa inda yake da muhimmanci.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.3: Kada ku nuna cewa Med Safar India ta tantance ta fuskar likitanci, ta jera a matsayi, ta ba da takardar shaida ko ta goyi bayan wani likita ko asibiti sai dai idan akwai rubutaccen tsari mai kariya da ke tallafa wa wannan magana.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.4: Kada ku nuna cewa jerin ya ƙunshi kowa da kowa ko cewa mai bayarwa da ba ya cikin jerin ya fi wasu ƙasƙanci.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.5: Ku nemi izini kafin amfani da tambarin asibiti ko likita, hotuna, kayayyakin alamar kasuwanci, maganganu ko sauran kayayyakin mallakarsu.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.6: Ku samar da hanya ga abokan hulɗa don neman gyaran kurakuran gaskiya, ba tare da ba su haƙƙin danne rubuce-rubucen da ke da adalci da inganci kai tsaye ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.5.body.7: Idan ba za a iya tabbatar da bayani ba, ku bayyana hakan a fili ko kada ku wallafa shi.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.heading: Gyare-gyare
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.0: Med Safar India na iya samun tsare-tsaren kasuwanci, yarjejeniyoyin sauƙaƙa jinya, tsare-tsaren tura marasa lafiya, ɗaukar nauyi ko wasu alaƙar kasuwanci da asibitoci, likitoci, masu ba da masauki, masu sufuri ko sauran abokan hulɗa na ayyuka. Kada a ɓoye waɗannan alaƙoƙi inda za su iya shafar, bisa hankali, yadda mai karatu ke fahimtar shawara, jeri, kwatance ko goyon baya.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.1: Ku bayyana wuraren da aka biya kuɗi don sanyawa, ɗaukar nauyi, kwamishan, tsare-tsaren tura marasa lafiya ko sauran muhimman alaƙar kasuwanci cikin harshe bayyananne kuma fitacce kusa da abin da abin ya shafa.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.2: Kada ku kira wurin da aka biya kuɗi ko wanda kasuwanci ya yi tasiri a kansa matsayi mai zaman kansa, kyauta, bita ko shawarar likitanci.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.3: Kada ku sayar ko ku nuna goyon bayan likitanci. Kada tsare-tsaren kasuwanci su yanke hukuncin dacewar likitanci ga wani mara lafiya.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.4: Inda aka wallafa kwatance, ku bayyana ma'aunai, tushen bayanai, ranar da aka duba da duk wasu muhimman iyakoki.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.5: Dole ne ma'aikata, marubuta, masu dubawa da masu ba da gudummawa su bayyana muradunsu na kai, na kuɗi ko na aiki da za su iya yin tasiri a kan abubuwan da suka rubuta.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.6: Kada ku yi alƙawarin cewa likita ko asibiti zai ba da wani takamaiman ragi, sakamakon jinya ko matakin kulawa sai dai idan an tabbatar a rubuce kuma an gabatar da shi tare da sharuɗɗan da suka dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.6.body.7: Ya kamata bayyanawa ta kasance bayyananna kuma mai sauƙin fahimta, misali: “Med Safar India na iya karɓar kuɗin sauƙaƙa jinya daga wasu abokan hulɗa na kiwon lafiya. Wannan alaƙa ba ta zama goyon bayan likitanci ba. Ya kamata marasa lafiya su tattauna dacewar jinya kai tsaye da likitan da ke jinyar su.” Dole ne a daidaita kalmomin zuwa ainihin tsarin da ake da shi kuma lauya ya duba su.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.heading: 8. Labaran marasa lafiya, shaidu, hotuna da nazarin al'amura
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.0: Abubuwan da marasa lafiya suka fuskanta al'amura ne masu muhimmanci kuma dole ne a kula da su musamman. Shaida labarin mutum ɗaya ne, ba hujja ba ce cewa wani mara lafiya zai fuskanci abu ɗaya ko sakamako ɗaya.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.1: Ku sami izini tun da farko, takamaimai, bisa cikakken sani kuma a rubuce kafin amfani da sunan mara lafiya, hotonsa, muryarsa, bidiyonsa, tarihin lafiyarsa, gano cutarsa, bayanan jinyarsa ko labarin da zai iya gane shi.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.2: Ku bayyana hanyoyin da ake niyya, masu sauraro, dalili, tsawon lokaci da ko za a iya amfani da abubuwan a tallan da aka biya kuɗi ko a raba su da abokan hulɗa.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.3: Ku bayyana a fili cewa ƙin ba da izini ba zai shafi samun ayyukan sauƙaƙa jinya ko shirya kiwon lafiya ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.4: Kada ku gyara shaida ta hanyar da za ta sauya ma'anarta ko ta haifar da fahimta mai ɓatarwa.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.5: Kada ku ƙirƙira, saya, zaɓi sassa don ɓatar da ma'ana ko ba da lada kan shaidu ta hanyar da ba a bayyana ba ko ta yaudara.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.6: Inda aka ba da lada, kyauta, ragi ko wata fa'ida, ku bayyana ta a fili kuma ku tabbatar cewa tsarin ya halatta.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.7: Ku yi amfani da nazarin al'amura da aka ɓoye sunaye ko aka cire alamomin tantance mutum a duk inda zai yiwu. Ku cire alamomin tantancewa na kaikaice har da sunaye da fuskoki.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.8: Kada ku wallafa abubuwa masu ban tsoro, masu wulaƙantarwa ko masu tayar da hankali don kawai jawo hankali.
editorialPolicy.sections.7.body.9: Izinin jinya, raba takardun asibiti da wallafawa don talla al'amura ne daban-daban. Kada a ɗauki izini a kan ɗaya a matsayin izini a kan sauran.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.heading: 9. Sirri, kiyaye asiri da bayanan lafiya masu muhimmanci
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.0: Za mu kula da bayanan marasa lafiya da na waɗanda ke iya zama marasa lafiya cikin cikakken sirri. Dole ne a shiga da amfani da bayanan lafiya, takardun shaida, bayanan tuntuɓa, takardun tafiya, hotuna da saƙonnin marasa lafiya don dalilai masu izini kawai.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.1: Kada ku saka bayanan da za su iya gane mara lafiya a cikin daftarin rubutu, hotunan allo (screenshots), gabatarwa ko rubuce-rubucen jama'a sai dai idan an sami izini da amincewar da ake buƙata.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.2: Ku tattara kuma ku yi amfani da bayanan sirri da ake buƙata bisa hankali kawai don dalilin da aka bayyana, kuma ku bi sanarwar sirri da tsarin neman izini da suka dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.3: Ku raba bayanan mara lafiya da asibitoci, likitoci, abokan hulɗa na tafiya ko masu ba da ayyuka ne kawai inda aka ba da izini, ya zama dole, kuma tsare-tsaren sirri da hujjar doka da suka dace sun rufe hakan.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.4: Ku yi amfani da tsarin da aka amince da su masu tsaro don ajiya da tura bayanai. Kada ku yaɗa takardun lafiya ta asusun kai ko ƙungiyoyin da ba na hukuma ba sai dai idan an ba da izini a fili kuma an kare su yadda ya dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.5: Ku taƙaita shiga bayanan marasa lafiya zuwa waɗanda ke buƙatar sani kawai, kuma ku bi hanyoyin adanawa, gogewa, ba da rahoton aukuwar matsala da sarrafa shiga.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.6: Kada ku yi amfani da bayanan marasa lafiya don talla, tsara bayanan martabar mutane (profiling), shaidu, kayan aikin AI ko dalilan rubutu da ba su da alaƙa ba tare da ingantacciyar hujja da aka rubuta daban ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.8.body.7: Dole ne Manufar Sirri ta ƙungiyar, fom-fom na izini, kwangilolin dillalai da ainihin hanyoyin sarrafa bayanai su dace da wannan sashe da dokar kare bayanai da ta dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.heading: 10. Talla, tallatawa da sadarwa ga jama'a
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.0: Duk abubuwan talla dole ne su kasance na gaskiya, masu hujja, a bayyane kuma ana iya bambance su daga rubuce-rubucen ilimantarwa masu zaman kansu. Cikakkiyar fahimtar da saƙo ke bayarwa na da muhimmanci, ciki har da kanunsa, hotuna, sanarwar iyakance alhaki, tsari da abubuwan da aka bari.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.1: Ku sanya alama a fili kan tallace-tallace, abubuwan da aka ɗauki nauyinsu, haɗin gwiwar da aka biya kuɗi da wuraren talla.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.2: Kada ku yi iƙirari masu ɓatarwa game da sakamakon jinya, sauƙin farashi, sauri, aminci, kayan aikin asibiti, cancantar likita ko cancantar mara lafiya.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.3: Kada ku ƙirƙiri gaggawa ta ƙarya, ku yi amfani da tsoro ko ku nuna cewa dole ne mara lafiya ya ɗauki mataki nan take don guje wa cutarwa sai dai idan likita mai cancanta ya tabbatar da ainihin gaggawar likitanci.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.4: Ku gabatar da farashi, abubuwan da aka haɗa, waɗanda ba a haɗa ba, haraji, ƙiyasi, sharuɗɗan soke booking da ƙarin kuɗaɗen da ka iya tasowa daidai kuma tare da sharuɗɗan da suka dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.5: Kada ku kwatanta asibitoci ko likitoci ta amfani da zaɓaɓɓun bayanai, tsofaffi ko waɗanda ba za a iya tabbatarwa ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.6: Kada ku yi amfani da sunan likita, hotonsa, maganarsa ko abin da ya yi kama da goyon bayansa ta hanyar da za ta iya karya ƙa'idojin aiki ko ɓatar da jama'a.
editorialPolicy.sections.9.body.7: Kafin wallafawa, binciken doka ya kamata ya yi la'akari da Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Dokar Kare Masu Sayayya), jagororin CCPA kan talla da goyon baya da suka dace, ASCI Code inda ya dace, da hane-hanen talla na ƙwararrun likitoci.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.heading: 11. Tsarin doka da na hukumomin sa ido na Indiya
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.0: An yi wannan manufa ne don tallafa wa wallafawa cikin alhaki a Indiya. Ba cikakken bayanin doka ba ce kuma ba ta maye gurbin shawarar lauya. Dokoki da ƙa'idojin da ke aiki sun dogara ne da abubuwan da ke ciki, hidimar, masu sauraro, matsayi a kwangila da ainihin aikin sarrafa bayanai.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.1: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 da jagororin CCPA — Ku guji tallace-tallace masu ɓatarwa, hanyoyin kasuwanci marasa adalci, iƙirarin ƙarya, goyon baya na yaudara da barin muhimman bayanai. Ku duba CCPA Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements and Endorsements for Misleading Advertisements, 2022, kamar yadda aka gyara ko aka ƙara musu.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.2: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 da DPDP Rules, 2025 — Ku sarrafa bayanan sirri na dijital a bayyane kuma bisa doka, tare da sanarwa masu dacewa, izini ko sauran dalilan da aka halatta, matakan kariya, kula da haƙƙoƙi da hanyoyin magance keta bayanai, kamar yadda kuma lokacin da tanade-tanaden da suka dace suka fara aiki suka kuma shafa. Fara aikin yana zuwa ne mataki-mataki; ku tabbatar da tanade-tanaden da ke aiki a lokacin kowane aiki.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.3: Information Technology Act, 2000 da ƙa'idojin da suka dace — Ku tantance wajiban da suka dace kan ayyukan intanet, tsaron intanet, takardun na'ura, ayyukan masu shiga tsakani da sadarwar dijital. Kada ku ɗauka cewa kowace ƙa'idar masu shiga tsakani ko ta kafofin dijital ta shafi Med Safar India; ku nemi shawara da ta dace da matsayinta.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.4: Drugs and Magic Remedies (Objectionable Advertisements) Act, 1954 — Kada ku wallafa tallace-tallace ko iƙirarin da aka hana da suka shafi takamaiman cututtuka, yanayin lafiya, magunguna ko maganin gargajiya. Ku sami binciken doka kafin wallafa tallan da ya shafi magani ko warkar da cuta.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.5: Dokokin ƙwararrun likitoci da buƙatun NMC — Ku girmama National Medical Commission Act, 2019 da buƙatun ɗabi'ar aiki da suka dace da ke tsara likitoci masu rajista. NMC ta fitar da Guidelines on Ethical Advertising and Public Communication by Hospitals/Medical Institutions and Registered Medical Practitioners a ranar 6 ga Oktoba 2026. Dole ne lauyan Indiya ya tantance yadda suka shafi mai sauƙaƙa jinya kai tsaye, da duk wasu wajibai inda Med Safar ke aiki don ko a madadin asibiti ko likita.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.6: Copyright Act, 1957 da Trade Marks Act, 1999 — Ku yi amfani da rubutu, hotuna, bidiyo, zane-zane, kiɗa, alƙaluman bincike, tambura da alamomin kasuwanci ne kawai da izini, ingantaccen lasisi, keɓewar doka ko wata hujja ta halal. Ambaton mai shi kaɗai ba ya maye gurbin izini.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.7: Sauran dokoki da ƙa'idojin fanni da suka dace — Gwargwadon hidimar da abubuwan da ke ciki, ku tantance Clinical Establishments Act da dokokin Jiha da suka dace, ƙa'idojin jinya ta nesa (telemedicine), ƙa'idojin talla, ƙa'idojin aiki, buƙatun kasuwancin intanet, buƙatun haraji da na kwangilar masu sayayya, da sauran dokokin da suka dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.10.body.8: Kada Med Safar India ta faɗi ko ta nuna cewa wannan manufa tana tabbatar da bin doka. Dole ne shugabanni su riƙe sabon kundin dokoki kuma su nemi shawara kan dokokin da suka shafi ainihin tsarin kasuwancinta, tsare-tsaren abokan hulɗa da kasuwannin da take nufa.
editorialPolicy.sections.11.heading: 12. Marasa lafiya na ƙasashen waje da abubuwan da suka shafi ƙasashe da dama
editorialPolicy.sections.11.body.0: Saboda Med Safar India na iya sadarwa da marasa lafiya da iyalansu a wajen Indiya, dole ne a tantance abubuwan da ke ciki da hanyoyin sarrafa bayanai bisa dokokin ƙasashe ko yankunan da ake nufa da wuraren da mutanen suke.
editorialPolicy.sections.11.body.1: Gwargwadon yanayi, wannan na iya haɗawa da buƙatun sirri, kare masu sayayya, talla, ƙwararrun likitoci, kasuwancin intanet da bayanan lafiya a ƙasashe kamar Birtaniya, ƙasashe mambobin Tarayyar Turai, Kenya, Najeriya, Bangladesh, ƙasashen Yankin Gulf da kasuwannin CIS. Dacewa ta dogara ne da ainihin gaskiyar al'amari; wannan manufa ba ta iƙirarin cewa kowace dokar ƙasar waje ta shafi kowace hulɗa ba.
editorialPolicy.sections.11.body.2: Kafin ƙaddamar da kamfen na wata ƙasa ta musamman, ya kamata a sami shawarar lauyan wurin inda ake buƙata. Ku guji iƙirarin cewa an amince da wata jinya, ana samun ta, ana maido da kuɗinta ko ta halatta bisa doka a wata ƙasa sai dai idan an tabbatar da hakan ga wannan kasuwa.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.heading: 13. Haƙƙin mallaka, tushe, hotuna da izini
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.0: Ku yi amfani da abubuwa na asali, abubuwan da ke da ingantaccen lasisi, abubuwan da ke hannun jama'a (public domain) ko abubuwan da aka yi amfani da su ƙarƙashin keɓewar doka da ta shafa a fili.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.1: Ku riƙe bayanan adireshin tushe (URL), bayanan wallafawa, lasisi, izini da buƙatun ambaton mai shi.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.2: Kada ku kwafa maƙaloli, ƙasidun asibiti, zane-zanen likitanci, hotuna, bidiyo ko abubuwan kafofin sada zumunta ba tare da izini ba don kawai jama'a na iya ganin su.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.3: Ku yi amfani da hotuna na gaske da ke wakiltar abin da ake magana a kai daidai. Kada ku yi amfani da hotunan ajiya (stock) ta hanyar da za ta nuna ƙarya cewa suna nuna wani mara lafiya, likita, asibiti ko aikin likitanci da aka ambata.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.4: Kada ku sauya hotunan likitanci ko hotunan jinya ta hanyar da za ta karkatar da ma'anarsu ta likitanci.
editorialPolicy.sections.12.body.5: Ku sami rubutaccen izini don tambura da kayayyakin alamar kasuwanci na abokan hulɗa, kuma ku bi duk wasu sharuɗɗan amfani.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.heading: 14. Basirar na'ura (AI) da kayan aiki masu aiki da kansu
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.0: Ana iya amfani da kayan aikin AI don taimakawa wajen rubuta daftari, inganta harshe, fassara, tsara rubutu, taƙaitawa ko samo ra'ayoyi. Kada a ɗauke su a matsayin tushe masu iko na likitanci, doka ko na hukumomin sa ido.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.1: Dole ne editan ɗan adam ya tabbatar da iƙirarin gaskiya, madogarai, sunaye, cancanta, alƙaluma, fassarori da hanyoyin haɗi kafin wallafawa.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.2: Dole ne iƙirarin likitanci su sami dubawa daga likita mai cancanta, ko mutum ne ya rubuta su ko AI ce ta samar da su.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.3: Kada ku saka bayanan da za su iya gane mara lafiya, takardun lafiya, takardun shaida ko bayanan sirri na abokan hulɗa a cikin kayan aikin AI sai dai idan an amince da kayan aikin da amfanin musamman kuma akwai matakan kariya na sirri da tsaro masu dacewa.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.4: Kada ku ƙirƙiri shaidun marasa lafiya na ƙarya, ƙagaggun likitoci, hujjojin likitanci na roba ko hotuna masu ɓatarwa na sakamakon jinya.
editorialPolicy.sections.13.body.5: Ku bayyana abubuwan da AI ta samar ko ta sauya sosai inda doka, ƙa'idojin dandali ko yanayi suka buƙaci bayyanawa, ko inda rashin bayyanawa zai iya ɓatar da masu karatu.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.heading: 15. Tsarin aikin rubutu da amincewa
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.0: Ya kamata a bi wannan tsarin aiki kafin wallafawa. Dole ne ƙungiyar ta naɗa takamaiman mutane ga kowane matsayi, kuma kada ta yi iƙirarin cewa akwai tsarin dubawa har sai ya fara aiki.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.1: Bayani da rarrabawa — ku gano masu sauraro, dalili, irin abin da za a rubuta, haɗarin likitanci, muradin kasuwanci, tasiri kan sirri da ƙasashen da ake nufa.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.2: Rubuta daftari — ku shirya abin da za a wallafa ta amfani da amintattun tushe da kalmomin alamar kasuwanci da aka amince da su.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.3: Tabbatar da gaskiya — ku tabbatar da sunaye, ranaku, alƙaluma, iƙirari, cancanta, hanyoyin haɗi, farashi da bayanan abokan hulɗa.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.4: Duba ta fuskar likitanci — ku sami dubawa daga mai cancanta don abubuwan likitanci kuma ku rubuta sunan mai dubawa da ranar dubawa.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.5: Duba ta fuskar doka, sirri da talla — ku kai abubuwa masu haɗari sosai, shaidu, iƙirari, tallace-tallacen da aka biya, bayanan marasa lafiya da kamfen na ƙasashe da dama zuwa mataki na gaba.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.6: Amincewar edita — edita mai izini yana duba bayyananniya, daidaito, salo, bayyanawa da bin wannan manufa.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.7: Wallafawa da adana bayanai — ku wallafa sigar da aka amince da ita kuma ku adana tushe, amincewa, bayanan izini da ranar wallafawa.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.8: Sa ido da sake dubawa — ku sa ido kan sauyin gaskiya, ƙorafe-ƙorafe, sabbin hujjoji, cancantar da ta ƙare, sauye-sauyen hukumomin sa ido da sabbin bayanan abokan hulɗa.
editorialPolicy.sections.14.body.9: Matakan haɗari da aka ba da shawara: abubuwan yau da kullum da ba na likitanci ba na iya samun dubawar edita da ta gaskiya; abubuwan likitanci, na kwatance, shaidu, waɗanda aka biya kuɗi, waɗanda za su iya gane mara lafiya ko na ƙasashe da dama suna buƙatar ƙarin dubawa ta ƙwararru.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.heading: 16. Gyara, sabuntawa da ƙorafe-ƙorafe
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.0: Za mu ɗauki matakai masu dacewa don gyara manyan kurakurai da wuri kuma a bayyane.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.1: Masu karatu, marasa lafiya, ƙwararrun ma'aikatan lafiya da abokan hulɗa na iya ba da rahoton kurakuran da ake zargi, tsofaffin bayanai, damuwa kan sirri ko abubuwa masu ɓatarwa ta hanyar tuntuɓa da aka wallafa a shafin yanar gizonmu.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.2: Ku tabbatar da karɓar ƙorafi cikin lokaci mai dacewa kuma ku tantance gaggawarsa, musamman inda lafiyar mara lafiya ko sirrinsa ka iya shafuwa.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.3: Ku gyara ko cire abubuwa inda aka tabbatar da babban kuskure, damuwar doka, matsalar izini ko haɗarin lafiya.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.4: Inda kuskure ya shafi fahimtar mai karatu sosai, ku ƙara bayanin gyara ko ranar sabuntawa maimakon sauya abin a ɓoye, inda ya dace.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.5: Ku riƙe bayanan cikin gida na ƙorafin, bincike, shawarar da aka yanke, gyara da ranar.
editorialPolicy.sections.15.body.6: Don damuwa ta gaggawa kan lafiya ko sirri, ya kamata a cire abin daga wallafawa na ɗan lokaci ko a taƙaita shi yayin da ake tantance al'amarin.
editorialPolicy.sections.16.heading: 17. Sauƙin samu, harshe da sadarwa mai girmamawa
editorialPolicy.sections.16.body.0: Ya kamata a rubuta abubuwa cikin harshe mai sauƙi da girmamawa, kuma a tsara su don marasa lafiya da iyalai daga wurare daban-daban su fahimta. Ku bayyana kalmomin likitanci inda suka zama dole. Ku guji tsangwama, nuna wariya, ra'ayoyin ƙiyayya na gama-gari, saƙonnin kunyatarwa da zato game da shekarun mutum, nakasa, ƙasarsa, samun kuɗinsa, addininsa ko yanayin lafiyarsa.
editorialPolicy.sections.16.body.1: Dole ne fassarori su kiyaye ma'ana, sharuɗɗa da bayanan lafiya na asali. Ya kamata ƙwararren mai dubawa ɗan adam ya duba muhimman fassarori da aka yi wa marasa lafiya.
editorialPolicy.sections.17.heading: 18. Alhaki da sake duba manufa
editorialPolicy.sections.17.body.0: Shugabannin Med Safar India ne ke da alhakin aiwatar da wannan manufa, raba nauyin rubutu da dubawa, adana bayanan amincewa da tabbatar da cewa an sanar da 'yan kwangila da hukumomin da ke aiki a madadinta game da waɗannan ƙa'idoji.
editorialPolicy.sections.17.body.1: Dole ne dukkan ma'aikata, masu ba da gudummawa da hukumomi su kai rahoton abubuwan da ka iya zama ba daidai ba, masu ɓatarwa, masu saɓa wa doka, masu keta sirri ko waɗanda ba su dace da ƙa'idar fifita mara lafiya ba nan da nan.
editorialPolicy.sections.17.body.2: Za a sake duba wannan manufa aƙalla sau ɗaya a shekara da kuma duk lokacin da aka sami babban sauyi a dokar da ta dace, jagororin NMC ko na sauran hukumomin sa ido, ayyukan Med Safar India, tsare-tsaren kasuwanci, fasaha ko kasuwannin da ake nufa.

cancellations.sections.0.heading: 13. Soke booking, maido da kuɗi da janyewa daga ayyuka
cancellations.sections.0.body.0: Haƙƙoƙin soke booking da maido da kuɗi sun dogara ne da irin aikin, matakin da aka soke a cikinsa, ayyukan da aka riga aka yi da sharuɗɗan da suka shafi mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa.
cancellations.sections.0.body.1: Inda manufar soke booking ko maido da kuɗi ta shafa, Med Safar India za ta sanar da sharuɗɗan da suka dace ta ƙiyasin farashi, tabbacin booking, takardar kuɗi ko wata rubutacciyar takarda.
cancellations.sections.0.body.3: Idan Mara Lafiya ya soke kafin ya yi tafiya zuwa Indiya, ya kamata ya sanar da Med Safar India a rubuce da wuri-wuri gwargwadon iko.
cancellations.sections.0.body.4: Za a tantance maido da kuɗaɗen da aka biya Med Safar India bisa ga sharuɗɗan aikin da aka amince da su, ayyukan da aka riga aka bayar, kuɗaɗen soke booking da suka dace da dokar da ta dace.
cancellations.sections.0.body.5: Kuɗaɗen da aka riga aka biya asibitoci, likitoci, otal-otal, kamfanonin jirgin sama ko sauran masu bayarwa masu zaman kansu za su kasance ƙarƙashin manufofin maido da kuɗi da soke booking na mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa.
cancellations.sections.0.body.6: Med Safar India ba za ta iya ba da tabbacin dawo da kuɗin da aka biya wani mai bayarwa mai zaman kansa ba inda sharuɗɗan wannan mai bayarwa ba su halatta maido da kuɗi ba.
cancellations.sections.0.body.8: Idan Mara Lafiya ya yanke shawarar kada ya ci gaba da jinyar da aka gabatar bayan isowa ko ganawa da likita, kuɗaɗen da aka riga aka kashe don ganawa da likita, gwaje-gwaje, masauki, sufuri, ayyukan gudanarwa ko sauran booking na iya ci gaba da kasancewa abin biya.
cancellations.sections.0.body.9: Duk wani maido da ajiyar kuɗin asibiti ko na jinya zai kasance ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗan mai bayarwa da abin ya shafa, bisa ga dokar da ta dace.
cancellations.sections.0.body.11: Idan Mai Ba da Kiwon Lafiya ya soke, ya ɗage ko ya ƙi wani aikin likitanci, Med Safar India za ta, inda zai yiwu bisa hankali, taimaka da sadarwa da shirya sauran zaɓuɓɓukan da ake da su.
cancellations.sections.0.body.12: Za a yanke hukuncin duk wani maido da kuɗaɗen mai bayarwa ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗan mai bayarwa da dokar da ta dace.
cancellations.sections.0.body.14: Inda Med Safar India ta amince da maido da kuɗin da ta karɓa, yawanci za a aiwatar da maido da kuɗin ta hanyar biyan da aka yi amfani da ita da farko, bisa ga buƙatun mai ba da hanyar biya da dokar da ta dace.
cancellations.sections.0.body.15: Dole ne a bayyana duk wani ragi da aka halatta, a ba da hujjarsa, kuma ya dace da sharuɗɗan da aka amince da su da dokar da ta dace.
cancellations.sections.0.body.16: Babu wani abu a wannan sashe da ke cire maido da kuɗi ko mafita da dokar da ta dace ta wajabta.
cancellations.sections.1.heading: 14. Sauye-sauye ga booking da tsarin tafiya
cancellations.sections.1.body.0: Buƙatun sauya ranakun ganawa da likita, jadawalin jinya, masauki, sufuri ko shirye-shiryen tafiya suna ƙarƙashin samuwa da manufofin mai bayarwa da ya dace.
cancellations.sections.1.body.1: Sauye-sauye na iya haifar da ƙarin kuɗaɗe, sabon ƙiyasi ko kuɗaɗen soke booking.
cancellations.sections.1.body.2: Jadawalin jinya na iya sauyawa saboda buƙatun likitanci, samuwar ma'aikatan lafiya, ƙarfin ɗaukar asibiti, gwaje-gwaje ko wasu yanayi da suka fi ƙarfin ikon Med Safar India bisa hankali.
cancellations.sections.1.body.3: Med Safar India za ta yi ƙoƙari mai dacewa don sanar da sauye-sauyen da aka kawo mata sani kuma ta taimaka da daidaitawa inda hakan na cikin ayyukan da aka amince da su.
cancellations.sections.1.body.4: Ya kamata Marasa Lafiya su guji yin booking na tafiya ko na nishaɗi wanda ba a maido da kuɗinsa ba kuma ya dogara da jadawalin jinya da ba a tabbatar ba.
questionnaireText.list.meta.title: Takardun tambayoyin tiyata. Medsafar India.
questionnaireText.list.meta.description: Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi kafin likitan tiyata ya duba al'amarinku. Kyauta ne, kuma yana ɗaukar kusan minti uku.
questionnaireText.list.heading: Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi da farko
questionnaireText.list.intro: Likitan tiyata yana karanta amsoshinku kafin kiran farko, don shawarar da kuka samu ta dace da al'amarinku. Yana ɗaukar kusan minti uku.
questionnaireText.contact.heading: Ina za mu aika da amsar?
questionnaireText.contact.intro: Mai kula da al'amura yana amsawa ta WhatsApp ko ta kira, da abin da likitan tiyata ke tunani.
questionnaireText.done.heading: Mun gode. Mun karɓi amsoshinku.
questionnaireText.done.body: Mai kula da al'amura na Medsafar zai tuntuɓe ku da zarar likitan tiyata ya karanta su.
questionnaireText.errors.required: Don Allah ku amsa kowace tambaya da ba a yi mata alamar ba dole ba.
questionnaireText.note: Ana amfani da amsoshinku ne kawai don shirya kulawarku. Ba gano cuta ba ne: likitan tiyata ne ke yanke shawarar abin da ya dace da ku bayan ya karanta rahotanninku kuma ya duba ku.
Takardar tambayoyin tiyatar rage ƙiba. Medsafar India.
Ku gano ko tiyatar rage ƙiba za ta iya dacewa da ku. Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi kuma likitan tiyata a Indiya zai karanta su kyauta.
Tsawonku, nauyinku da lafiyarku cikin 'yan tambayoyi, don likitan tiyata ya gaya muku ko tiyata za ta iya dacewa da ku.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.intro: Ku gaya mana game da nauyinku da lafiyarku. Likitan tiyatar rage ƙiba a asibitin abokin hulɗa yana karanta amsoshinku ya gaya muku ko tiyata za ta iya dacewa da ku.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.bmi.n: BMI jagora ne na kusan-kusan. Likitocin tiyata yawanci suna la'akari da tiyatar rage ƙiba daga BMI na kusan 35, ko ƙasa da haka ga wasu mutane masu ciwon suga na nau'i na 2. Likitan tiyata ne ke yanke shawara don al'amarinku.
questionnaires.weight-loss-surgery.secti: Kuna da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan?
Tsayawar numfashi lokacin barci ko minshari mai ƙarfi
Me kuka gwada don rage ƙiba?
Magungunan da kuke sha kowace rana
Sunaye da adadin sha, idan kun san su
Akwai wata tiyata da kuke tunani a kai?
Ban tabbata ba, ina son shawara
Duk wani abu da likitan tiyata ya kamata ya sani
Tiyatocin da aka yi a baya, wasu matsalolin lafiya, tambayoyi
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.treatmen: Tiyatar gyaran jiki da ta kyau
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.meta.tit: Takardar tambayoyin tiyatar kyau. Medsafar India.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.meta.des: Ku gaya wa likitan tiyatar gyaran jiki a Indiya abin da kuke son canzawa. Ku amsa 'yan tambayoyi kuma ku samu shawara kyauta don al'amarinku.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.card.bod: Abin da kuke son canzawa da ɗan bayani game da lafiyarku, don likitan tiyata ya ba da shawara kafin ku yi tafiya.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.heading: Takardar tambayoyin tiyatar kyau
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.intro: Ku gaya mana abin da kuke son canzawa da ɗan bayani game da lafiyarku. Likitan tiyatar gyaran jiki a asibitin abokin hulɗa yana karanta amsoshinku ya ba da shawara kan abin da zai yiwu.
questionnaires.cosmetic-surgery.sections: Waɗanne sassa kuke tunani a kai?
Zuƙe kitse (liposuction) ko gyaran siffar jiki
A taƙaice, me kuke son canzawa?
Misali: ƙaramin hanci mai miƙaƙƙen ƙashi
Kun taɓa yin tiyatar kyau a baya?
Kuna da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan?
Matsalar zubar jini ko daskarewar jini
Kuna da ciki, kuna shayarwa ko kuna shirin ɗaukar ciki a shekara mai zuwa?
Magungunan da kuke sha kowace rana
Sunaye da adadin sha, idan kun san su
Har yaushe za ku iya zama a Indiya?
specialities.organ-transplant.name: Dashen sashen jiki
specialities.organ-transplant.summary: Dashen ƙoda, hanta da wasu sassan jiki, sau da yawa daga ɗan uwa mai rai da ya bayar. Ƙungiyar dashe tana duba mara lafiya da mai bayarwa, kuma kwamitin asibiti yana duba takardu kafin a shirya komai.
specialities.oncology.name: Jinyar ciwon daji (oncology)
specialities.oncology.summary: Kulawar ciwon daji: tiyata, maganin chemotherapy, jinyar haske (radiation) da sababbin hanyoyin jinya. Ƙungiyar likitocin ciwon daji tana karanta rahotanni kuma tana shirya jinya tare.
specialities.haematology-bmt.name: Cututtukan jini da dashen ɓargo
specialities.haematology-bmt.summary: Kulawa don cututtukan jini da ciwon daji na jini, har da dashen ɓargo ga manya da yara.
specialities.neurology-neurosurgery.name: Cututtukan ƙwaƙwalwa da jijiyoyi da tiyatarsu
specialities.neurology-neurosurgery.summ: Kulawa da tiyata don ƙwaƙwalwa, kashin baya da jijiyoyi, daga ciwace-ciwace zuwa matsalolin motsi.
specialities.bariatric-surgery.name: Tiyatar rage ƙiba (bariatric)
specialities.bariatric-surgery.summary: Tiyatocin da ke taimaka wa mutane masu ƙiba mai tsanani su rage nauyi kuma su ci gaba da kasancewa a haka, idan tsarin abinci da motsa jiki ba su isa ba.
specialities.fertility-ivf.name: Haihuwa da IVF
specialities.fertility-ivf.summary: Taimako ga ma'aurata da ke ƙoƙarin samun ɗa, har da IVF da ICSI, bayan gwaje-gwaje ga dukansu biyu.
specialities.orthopaedics.name: Jinyar ƙashi da gaɓoɓi
specialities.orthopaedics.summary: Tiyata don ƙasusuwa da gaɓoɓi, kamar maye gurbin kwatangwalo da gwiwa da gyaran raunukan wasanni.
specialities.cardiology.name: Jinyar zuciya da tiyatar zuciya
specialities.cardiology.summary: Gwaje-gwaje, ayyukan jinya da tiyatoci don zuciya, daga angioplasty zuwa tiyatar bypass da maye gurbin bawul ɗin zuciya.
specialities.general-surgery.name: Tiyata ta gama-gari da ta ƙaramar huda
specialities.general-surgery.summary: Tiyata da aka saba yi kamar cire jakar bile (gallbladder), gyaran hernia da cire appendix, galibi ana yin su ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot don murmurewa ta yi sauri.
specialities.gastroenterology.name: Jinyar ciki, hanji da hanta
specialities.gastroenterology.summary: Gwaje-gwaje da jinya don ciki, hanji, hanta da saifa (pancreas), har da endoscopy, ERCP da kulawa don kitse a hanta da cirrhosis.
specialities.urology.name: Jinyar fitsari (urology)
specialities.urology.summary: Kulawa don ƙoda, mafitsara da prostate, da gaɓoɓin haihuwa na maza, daga tsakuwar ƙoda zuwa tiyatar ƙoda da prostate ta na'urar robot.
specialities.gynaecology.name: Jinyar mata (gynaecology)
specialities.gynaecology.summary: Kulawa da tiyata don mahaifa, mahaifar ƙwai (ovaries) da bututun mahaifa (fallopian tubes), galibi ana yin su ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
specialities.ent.name: Kunne, hanci da maƙogwaro (ENT)
specialities.ent.summary: Jinya don kunne, hanci, sinus, maƙogwaro da akwatin murya, har da tiyatar sinus.
specialities.cosmetic-plastic-surgery.na: Tiyatar gyaran jiki da ta kyau
specialities.cosmetic-plastic-surgery.su: Tiyata don sake gina ko canza siffar jiki da fuska, da dashen gashi, wanda ake shiryawa bayan ganawa da likitan tiyata.
specialities.ophthalmology.name: Jinyar ido (ophthalmology)
specialities.ophthalmology.summary: Tiyata da kulawa don idanu, daga yanar ido (cataract) da LASIK zuwa jinyar ƙwayar ido (cornea), glaucoma da retina, bayan cikakken binciken ido.
specialities.dentistry.name: Jinyar haƙori
specialities.dentistry.summary: Dashen haƙori (implants), jinyar jijiyar haƙori (root canal), wayoyin gyaran haƙori da gyaran kyan haƙori, wanda ake shiryawa bayan dubawa da hoton X-ray.
treatments.kidney-transplant.name: Dashen ƙoda
treatments.kidney-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke saka lafiyayyar ƙoda daga mai bayarwa cikin mutumin da ƙodojinsa suka daina aiki.
treatments.kidney-transplant.what: Ana saka lafiyayyar ƙoda daga mai bayarwa a ƙasan ciki kuma a haɗa ta da jijiyoyin jini da mafitsara. Yawanci ana barin ƙodojin mutumin a inda suke. Mai bayarwa galibi ɗan uwa ne mai rai; inda rukunin jini bai dace ba, dashe na musaya (paired) da wani iyali na iya sa hakan ya yiwu a wasu lokuta. Bayan haka mara lafiya yana shan magunguna kowace rana don kada jiki ya ƙi sabuwar ƙodar.
treatments.kidney-transplant.who: Mutanen da ƙodojinsu suka daina aiki (ciwon ƙoda na matakin ƙarshe), ko sun fara wankin ƙoda (dialysis) ko ba su fara ba, waɗanda ke da ƙarfin yin tiyata kuma suke da mai bayarwa da ya dace.
treatments.kidney-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 8: 3 a sashen kulawa ta musamman da 5 a ɗakin kwanciya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.kidney-transplant.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokin yau da kullum masu sauƙi cikin mako 4 zuwa 6. Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan mako 4 zuwa 6 bayan tiyatar don dubawa sosai da gwaje-gwajen jini.
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.0.quest: Shin ɗan uwa daga ƙasata zai iya zama mai bayarwa?
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.0.answe: I. Dokar Indiya ta ba da izinin bayarwa daga makusantan dangi masu rai, kuma kwamitin ba da izini na asibiti yana duba takardun kowane mai bayarwa kafin dashen. Muna taimaka muku shirya waɗannan takardu kafin ku yi tafiya.
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.1.quest: Idan rukunin jinin mai bayarwa bai dace da nawa ba fa?
treatments.kidney-transplant.faq.1.answe: Dashe na musaya (paired) da wani iyali, ko dashe tsakanin rukunin jini dabam-dabam tare da ƙarin jinya tun kafin lokaci, na iya yiwuwa. Ƙungiyar dashe ce ke yanke shawara bayan gwaje-gwaje.
treatments.dialysis.name: Wankin ƙoda (haemodialysis da haemodiafiltration)
treatments.dialysis.summary: Na'ura tana tace jini idan ƙodoji ba za su iya yin hakan ba, yawanci a zama na kusan awa huɗu, sau uku a mako.
treatments.dialysis.what: Ana wuce da jini ta wata matatar da ke wajen jiki wadda ke cire datti da ƙarin ruwa, sannan a mayar da shi. Haemodiafiltration hanya ce mai zurfi ta wannan jinya. Ana kuma iya yin zaman da daddare (nocturnal dialysis) ga wasu marasa lafiya.
treatments.dialysis.who: Mutanen da ƙodojinsu suka daina aiki, har da masu jiran dashe, da marasa lafiya da suka riga suna wankin ƙoda waɗanda ke buƙatarsa yayin da suke Indiya don jinya.
treatments.dialysis.stay: Yawanci ana yi ba tare da kwanciya ba: kuna zuwa don kowane zama kuma ku koma gida a ranar.
treatments.dialysis.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna jin gajiya na 'yan awoyi bayan zama. Wankin ƙoda yana ci gaba muddin ƙodoji ba sa aiki, ko har sai an yi dashe.
treatments.dialysis.faq.0.question: Na riga ina wankin ƙoda. Zan iya ci gaba da shi a Indiya?
treatments.dialysis.faq.0.answer: I. Ku aiko mana da bayanan wankin ƙodarku na yanzu kuma za mu yi muku ajiyar zama a asibiti na duk tsawon zamanku.
treatments.dialysis.faq.1.question: Shin wankin ƙoda yana maye gurbin dashe?
treatments.dialysis.faq.1.answer: A'a. Wankin ƙoda yana yin wani ɓangare na aikin ƙodoji. Dashe, inda ya dace, yawanci yana ba da ingantacciyar rayuwa. Likitan ƙoda ne zai ba da shawarar wanda ya dace da ku.
treatments.liver-transplant.name: Dashen hanta
treatments.liver-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin hantar da ke lalacewa da duka ko wani ɓangare na lafiyayyar hanta daga mai bayarwa.
treatments.liver-transplant.what: Ana cire hantar da ke da cuta a maye gurbinta da lafiyayya. A dashe daga mai bayarwa mai rai, ɗan uwa yana bayar da wani ɓangare na hantarsa; ɓangarorin biyu suna sake girma kusan zuwa cikakken girmansu cikin makonni. A dashe daga mamaci, ana amfani da cikakkiyar hanta.
treatments.liver-transplant.who: Mutanen da hantarsu ta lalace saboda cirrhosis, ciwon hanta (hepatitis), barasa ko kitse a hanta, wasu ciwon daji na hanta, ko wasu cututtukan gado da ba a cika samu ba, a manya da yara.
treatments.liver-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 21 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.liver-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 2 zuwa 3 gaba ɗaya. Yawancin mutane suna komawa rayuwar yau da kullum cikin wata 3 zuwa 6, kuma suna shan magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki har abada.
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.0.questi: Har yaushe mai bayarwa mai rai yake zama a asibiti?
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.0.answer: Yawanci kusan kwana 7 zuwa 10, kuma yawancin masu bayarwa suna komawa rayuwar yau da kullum cikin mako 6 zuwa 8.
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.1.questi: Waɗanne gwaje-gwaje ake buƙata kafin mu yi tafiya?
treatments.liver-transplant.faq.1.answer: Ku aiko mana da rahotanni na baya-bayan nan, hotunan na'ura da gwaje-gwajen jini na mara lafiya, da rukunin jinin masu yiwuwar bayarwa. Ƙungiyar dashe za ta gaya muku abin da kuma ake buƙata.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.name: Dashen saifa (pancreas)
treatments.pancreas-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke saka lafiyayyar saifa (pancreas) daga mai bayarwa cikin mutum mai ciwon suga, don jikinsa ya sake samar da insulin da kansa. Sau da yawa ana yin ta tare da dashen ƙoda.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.what: Ana saka saifa (pancreas) daga mamaci a ƙasan ciki kuma a haɗa ta da jijiyoyin jini da hanji ko mafitsara. Saifar mutumin tana zama a wurinta. Idan sabuwar saifar ta yi aiki, ba a sake buƙatar allurar insulin. Sau da yawa ana yin ta a lokaci ɗaya da dashen ƙoda.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.who: Galibi mutane masu ciwon suga na nau'i na 1: waɗanda ba sa ƙara jin alamun gargaɗin raguwar sugar jini mai haɗari (hypoglycaemia unawareness), waɗanda ke samun lalacewar ƙoda, jijiyoyi ko idanu duk da insulin, da waɗanda kuma suke da ciwon ƙoda na dogon lokaci. Wasu mutane masu ciwon suga na nau'i na 2 ma sun dace. Ciwon suga tare da ciwon ƙoda abu ne mai tsanani: haɗarin mutuwa ya ninka kusan sau biyu na ciwon ƙoda shi kaɗai, matsakaicin tsawon rayuwa kusan shekara 4 zuwa 5 ne, kuma ana rasa kusan shekara 16 na rayuwa.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.stay: Yawanci kusan mako 2 zuwa 3 a asibiti, fiye da haka idan an yi tare da dashen ƙoda. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 2 zuwa 3. Ana shan magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki har abada.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.0.ans: I. Saifar tana zuwa ne daga mamaci, don haka akwai jerin jira. Ƙungiyar za ta bayyana yadda yake aiki ga marasa lafiya na ƙasashen waje.
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.1.que: Shin har yanzu zan buƙaci insulin?
treatments.pancreas-transplant.faq.1.ans: Idan sabuwar saifar ta yi aiki da kyau, a'a. Likitocinku suna duba sugar jininku sosai a makonnin farko.
treatments.intestine-transplant.name: Dashen hanji
treatments.intestine-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke maye gurbin ƙaramin hanjin da ya daina aiki ko aka rasa da lafiyayyen hanji daga mai bayarwa.
treatments.intestine-transplant.what: Ana haɗa ƙaramin hanji daga mai bayarwa da jijiyoyin jini da hanjin mara lafiya, don ya sake iya shan abinci kuma ya daina ciyarwa ta ƙarin ruwa (drip). Yana ɗaya daga cikin dashe mafi sarƙaƙiya kuma yana buƙatar bibiya ta kusa ta tsawon lokaci.
treatments.intestine-transplant.who: A yara, gazawar hanji bayan necrotising enterocolitis (NEC), gastroschisis ko matsalar motsin hanji. A manya, rasa hanji saboda mesenteric ischaemia (toshewar hanyar jini), midgut volvulus (murɗewar hanji) ko ciwace-ciwacen mesentery.
treatments.intestine-transplant.stay: Yawanci mako 4 zuwa 8 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.intestine-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 3 ko fiye. Ana dawo da cin abinci a hankali, kuma ana shan magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki har abada.
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.0.qu: Wa ya dace da shi idan ana ciyar da ni ta drip a gida?
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.0.an: Mutanen da suka dogara da ciyarwa ta drip (parenteral nutrition) kuma suke samun matsaloli da ita, kamar lalacewar hanta ko kamuwa da cuta a bututun drip akai-akai, yawanci ana duba su don dashe.
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.1.qu: Yara za su iya yin sa?
treatments.intestine-transplant.faq.1.an: I. Ana yin dashen hanji da yawa ga yara. Ƙungiyar tana duba kowane yaro daban.
treatments.hand-transplant.name: Dashen hannu
treatments.hand-transplant.summary: Tiyata da ke haɗa hannu ɗaya ko duka biyu daga mamaci ga mutumin da ya rasa nasa, ta hanyar haɗa ƙashi, jijiyoyin jini, jijiyoyin tsoka, jijiyoyin ji da fata.
treatments.hand-transplant.what: Dashen hannu yana motsa fata, tsoka, jijiyar tsoka, ƙashi, jijiyoyin jini da jijiyoyin ji tare, shi ya sa ake kiransa dashen nama mai haɗaka (composite tissue transplant). Likitocin tiyata suna gyara ƙasusuwa, haɗa jijiyoyin jini, gyara jijiyoyin tsoka da haɗa jijiyoyin ji. Bayan haka mara lafiya yana shan magani don hana jiki ƙin sababbin hannayen, kuma yana yin jinyar motsa jiki ta tsawon lokaci. Idan ya yi nasara, dashen hannu na iya dawo da ji, sanin matsayin hannu da motsi mai tsari fiye da abin da hannun roba zai iya bayarwa.
treatments.hand-transplant.who: Mutanen da suka rasa hannu ɗaya ko duka biyu ko damatsa, bayan gwaje-gwaje masu zurfi na lafiya, na ƙwaƙwalwa da na garkuwar jiki. Dole a samu mai bayarwa da ya dace, don haka yawanci akwai lokacin jira.
treatments.hand-transplant.stay: Yawanci kusan mako 3 zuwa 4 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hand-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 3 zuwa 6 don jinyar hannu ta kullum. Motsi da ji suna ci gaba da inganta tsawon shekara ɗaya zuwa biyu yayin da jijiyoyi ke girma.
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.0.questio: Yaushe zan iya amfani da sabon hannun?
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.0.answer: Motsi masu sauƙi yawanci suna farawa cikin makonni. Ji da ingantaccen iko suna dawowa a hankali tsawon watanni, tare da jinya ta kullum.
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.1.questio: Shin zan buƙaci magunguna har abada?
treatments.hand-transplant.faq.1.answer: I. Kamar kowane dashe, yana buƙatar magungunan hana ƙin sashen jiki kowace rana, da dubawa akai-akai.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.name: Dashen ɓargo (dashen ƙwayoyin halitta na stem cell)
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.summar: Jinyar da ke maye gurbin ɓargon da ya lalace ko ke da cuta da lafiyayyun ƙwayoyin stem cell masu samar da jini, ana amfani da ita don wasu ciwon daji na jini da cututtukan jini.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.what: Da farko, maganin chemotherapy mai ƙarfi, wani lokaci tare da jinyar haske (radiation), yana share ɓargon da ke da cuta. Sannan ana ba da lafiyayyun ƙwayoyin stem cell ta drip, kamar ƙarin jini, kuma suna zama a cikin ƙasusuwa su samar da sabon jini. Ƙwayoyin suna zuwa daga mara lafiyar kansa (autologous), daga mai bayarwa da ya dace (allogeneic), ko daga ɗan uwa da ya dace rabi (haploidentical), wanda ke nufin yawancin marasa lafiya za su iya samun mai bayarwa.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.who: Mutane masu wasu ciwon daji na jini, kamar leukaemia, lymphoma da myeloma, da wasu cututtukan jini, kamar thalassaemia, sikila (sickle cell) da aplastic anaemia, a manya da yara.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 30 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.bone-marrow-transplant.recove: Ku shirya zama a Indiya kusan wata 2 zuwa 3 bayan dashen don bibiya ta kusa. Garkuwar jiki tana ɗaukar wata 6 zuwa 12 kafin ta murmure gaba ɗaya.
Wa zai iya zama mai bayarwa gare ni?

Ana fara duba ɗan uwa ko 'yar uwa. Idan babu wanda ya dace gaba ɗaya, iyaye, ɗa ko ɗan uwa da ya dace rabi sau da yawa zai iya bayarwa. Ana yin gwaje-gwaje kafin ku yi tafiya ko jim kaɗan bayan kun iso.
Shin mai bayarwa yana buƙatar tiyata?
Yawanci a'a. Yawancin ƙwayoyin stem cell a yau ana tattara su daga jinin mai bayarwa ta drip, cikin 'yan awoyi.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.name: Jinyar CAR-T cell (adoptive cell therapy)
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.summary: Ana tattara ƙwayoyin garkuwar jikin mara lafiyar kansa, a canza su a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje don su gane ciwon dajinsa, sannan a mayar masa da su ta drip. Ana amfani da ita don wasu leukaemia, lymphoma da myeloma.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.what: Ana tattara fararen ƙwayoyin jini da ake kira T cells daga jinin mara lafiya. A ɗakin gwaje-gwaje ana ba su sabon mai karɓa (CAR) da ke taimaka musu nemo ciwon dajin su kai masa hari. Bayan ɗan gajeren lokacin chemotherapy, ana mayar da ƙwayoyin ta drip, inda suke ƙaruwa suna yaƙi da ciwon dajin.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.who: Manya da wasu yara masu wasu nau'o'in leukaemia, lymphoma ko multiple myeloma da suka dawo ko ba su amsa wata jinya ba.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.stay: Yawanci kusan mako 2 a asibiti bayan an ba da ƙwayoyin. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.recovery: Ku shirya zama kusa da asibiti kusan mako 4 bayan an ba da ƙwayoyin, domin illoli kamar zazzaɓi na iya bayyana a wannan lokaci. Yawancin mutane suna komawa gida cikin wata 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.0.ques: Har yaushe ake ɗauka kafin a yi ƙwayoyin?
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.0.answ: Yawanci 'yan makonni daga tattarawa zuwa bayarwa. Likitanku na iya ba da wata jinya yayin da kuke jira.
treatments.car-t-cell-therapy.faq.1.answ: Zazzaɓi, ƙarancin hawan jini kuma, wani lokaci, ruɗani a makonnin farko. Ƙungiyar tana sa ido sosai kuma tana jinyar su da wuri.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.na: Jinyar ciwon daji da cututtukan jini na yara
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.su: Kulawa ga yara masu leukaemia, lymphoma, ciwace-ciwace masu ƙarfi da cututtukan jini marasa ciwon daji, wanda likitocin da ke jinyar yara kaɗai ke shiryawa.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.wh: Likitan cututtukan jini da ciwon daji na yara (paediatric haemato-oncologist) yana shirya dukan jinyar, wadda za ta iya haɗa chemotherapy, tiyata, jinyar haske (radiotherapy) da dashen ɓargo. Adadin magani da kulawa sun dace da yaro mai girma, tare da tallafi ga iyali a duk tsawon lokacin.
Yara masu ciwon daji na jini kamar leukaemia da lymphoma, ciwace-ciwace masu ƙarfi, ko cututtukan jini kamar thalassaemia da aplastic anaemia.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.st: Ya danganta da shirin jinya. Yawancin zaman chemotherapy ana yi ne ba tare da kwanciya ba; dashen ɓargo yana buƙatar kusan wata ɗaya a asibiti.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.re: Jinya sau da yawa tana ɗaukar watanni da dama. Likita zai bayyana waɗanne sassa dole a yi su a Indiya da waɗanda za a iya ci gaba da su a gida.
treatments.childhood-cancer-treatment.fa: Shin ɗaya daga cikin iyaye zai iya zama tare da yaron?
I. Ɗaya daga cikin iyaye zai iya zama tare da yaron a asibiti. Muna taimakawa da masauki kusa ga sauran iyalin.
Shin wani ɓangare na jinyar zai iya ci gaba a gida?
Sau da yawa, i. Likita zai iya raba shirin da likitanku na gida don sassan da za a iya yi a gida lafiya.
treatments.chemotherapy.name: Chemotherapy (maganin kashe ƙwayoyin ciwon daji)
treatments.chemotherapy.summary: Magungunan da ke kashe ƙwayoyin ciwon daji ko hana su girma, ana ba da su ta drip, allura ko ƙwaya a jerin zama.
treatments.chemotherapy.what: Likitan ciwon daji (medical oncologist) yana zaɓar magunguna, adadi da lokaci bisa irin ciwon dajin da matakinsa. Yawanci ana ba da jinyar a zagaye-zagaye, tare da makonnin hutu a tsakani don jiki ya murmure. Ana iya ba da ita kafin tiyata don rage girman ciwace, bayan tiyata don rage yiwuwar dawowarsa, ko ita kaɗai.
treatments.chemotherapy.who: Mutane masu nau'o'in ciwon daji da yawa, har da na nono, huhu, hanji, mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), kai da wuya, jini da ƙashi. Likitan ciwon dajinku ne zai yanke shawarar ko ya dace da al'amarinku.
treatments.chemotherapy.stay: Yawancin zama ana yi ne ba tare da kwanciya ba: kuna zuwa, a ba ku drip ɗin, sannan ku koma gida a ranar.
treatments.chemotherapy.recovery: Gajiya da sauran illoli yawanci suna sauƙi cikin kwanaki zuwa makonni bayan kowane zagaye. Cikakken jinya sau da yawa tana ɗaukar wata 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.0.question: Shin dole in zauna a Indiya har ƙarshen jinyar?
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.0.answer: Ba koyaushe ba. Sau da yawa ana ba da zagayen farko a Indiya kuma sauran za a iya ci gaba da su a gida, tare da raba shirin da likitan ciwon dajinku na gida.
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.1.question: Shin gashina zai zube?
treatments.chemotherapy.faq.1.answer: Da wasu magunguna, i, kuma yawanci yana sake fitowa bayan jinya. Yawancin magungunan zamani ba sa sa zubewar gashi.
treatments.targeted-therapy-immunotherap: Jinyar da ke kai hari kai tsaye (targeted therapy) da jinyar garkuwar jiki (immunotherapy)
Sababbin magungunan ciwon daji da ke kai hari kan wani rauni na musamman a cikin ciwon dajin, ko suke taimaka wa garkuwar jiki ta yaƙe shi.

Gwaje-gwaje a kan ciwace suna neman canje-canje a ƙwayoyin halittarsa (genes) ko sunadaransa (proteins). Magungunan targeted therapy suna toshe waɗannan canje-canje, don haka suna aiki galibi a kan ƙwayoyin ciwon daji. Immunotherapy tana taimaka wa garkuwar jiki ta gane ciwon dajin ta kai masa hari. Ana kiran waɗannan da precision ko molecular oncology, kuma ana ba da su ta drip ko a matsayin ƙwayoyi.
Mutanen da ciwon dajinsu ya nuna canjin da ya dace a gwaji, ko waɗanda aka san irin ciwon dajinsu yana amsawa, kamar wasu ciwon daji na huhu, nono, ƙoda, hanji, fata da kai da wuya.
Yawanci ba tare da kwanciya ba, ko ƙwayoyin da ake sha a gida.
Yawancin mutane suna ci gaba da rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum lokacin jinya, tare da dubawa da hotunan na'ura akai-akai.
Ta yaya zan san ko ya dace da ni?
Likitan ciwon dajinku yana duba sakamakon gwajin ciwacenku. Idan ba a yi gwajin ba, sau da yawa ana iya yin sa a kan samfurin nama (biopsy) da kuke da shi.
A'a. Yana aiki ta wata hanya dabam kuma yawanci yana da illoli dabam, sau da yawa masu sauƙi. Wani lokaci ana ba da shi tare da chemotherapy.
treatments.radiation-therapy.name: Jinyar haske (radiation, external beam, EBRT)
treatments.radiation-therapy.summary: Jinyar da ke amfani da hasken makamashi mai ƙarfi da aka nufa a hankali don lalata ƙwayoyin ciwon daji a wani sashe na jiki.
treatments.radiation-therapy.what: Hoton na'ura na tsarawa yana zana taswirar ciwacen, sannan na'ura tana nufar hasken zuwa gare shi daga kusurwoyi da dama, tana kare lafiyayyen naman da ke kewaye gwargwadon iko. Kowane zama yana ɗaukar mintuna kuma ba ya ciwo. Yawanci ana ba da jinyar a ranakun aiki na mako ɗaya zuwa makonni da dama.
treatments.radiation-therapy.who: Mutane masu nau'o'in ciwon daji da yawa, ita kaɗai ko tare da tiyata da chemotherapy, kuma wani lokaci don rage ciwo daga ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu.
treatments.radiation-therapy.stay: Yawanci ba a kwanciya a asibiti: kuna zuwa don kowane ɗan gajeren zama.
treatments.radiation-therapy.recovery: Gajiya da ciwon fata a wurin da aka yi jinyar abu ne da aka saba, kuma yawanci suna lafawa cikin 'yan makonni bayan jinyar.
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.0.quest: Shin zan zama mai fitar da haske mai guba (radioactive)?
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.0.answe: A'a. Da jinyar haske daga waje (external beam radiotherapy) ba ku zama radioactive ba, kuma babu haɗari ku kasance tare da iyali.
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.1.quest: Har yaushe zan buƙaci zama a Indiya?
treatments.radiation-therapy.faq.1.answe: Muddin jinyar ta ɗauka, yawanci mako 1 zuwa 7, da 'yan kwanaki don tsarawa. Likitanku zai gaya muku ainihin tsawon lokacin.
treatments.cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji (surgical oncology)
treatments.cancer-surgery.summary: Tiyata don cire ciwace kuma, inda ake buƙata, naman da ke kusa ko ƙwayoyin lymph.
treatments.cancer-surgery.what: Likitan tiyatar ciwon daji yana cire ciwacen tare da ɗan lafiyayyen nama a gefensa, kuma sau da yawa ƙwayoyin lymph na kusa don duba ko ya yaɗu. Inda ya dace da al'amarin, ana yin ta ta ƙaramar huda (laparoscopic) ko ta na'urar robot, wanda yawanci ke nufin ƙananan yanka da saurin murmurewa. Ana bincika naman da aka cire don shirya duk wata ƙarin jinya.
treatments.cancer-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwace-ciwace masu ƙarfi, kamar ciwon daji na kai da wuya, nono, ciki, hanji, hanta, saifa (pancreas), ƙoda, mafitsara, prostate, mahaifa, mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), ƙashi da nama mai laushi.
treatments.cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 10 a asibiti, ya danganta da tiyatar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.cancer-surgery.recovery: Daga mako 2 don ƙananan tiyatoci zuwa mako 6 zuwa 8 don manya. Ku shirya zama a Indiya har sai an duba ɗinkin kuma an tattauna rahoton.
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.0.question: Shin zan buƙaci wata jinya bayan tiyata?
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.0.answer: Wani lokaci. Rahoton naman da aka cire yana nuna ko chemotherapy ko radiotherapy za su taimaka. Ƙungiyar tana tattauna wannan da ku kafin ku koma gida.
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.1.question: Shin za a iya yin ta da na'urar robot?
treatments.cancer-surgery.faq.1.answer: Ga nau'o'in ciwon daji da yawa, i. Likitan tiyata ne ke yanke shawara bisa ciwacen da hotunan na'urarku.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na kai da wuya
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.summ: Tiyata don ciwon daji na baki, harshe, maƙogwaro, akwatin murya, gland ɗin yawu da sinus, tare da kiyaye magana da haɗiya gwargwadon iko.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.what: Ana cire ciwacen, sau da yawa tare da ƙwayoyin lymph na wuya. Inda ya dace da al'amarin, ana yin ta ta baki da laser ko na'urar robot (transoral surgery), ba tare da manyan yanka ba. Idan akwatin murya ya shafu, ana zaɓar tiyatar da ke kiyaye murya inda zai yiwu, kuma ana ba da gyaran murya idan ba zai yiwu ba. Ana iya sake gina wurin a tiyatar guda.
treatments.head-neck-cancer-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na baki, harshe, kunci, maƙogwaro, akwatin murya (larynx), gland ɗin yawu, hanci ko sinus.
