treatments.partial-nephrectomy.what: Da amfani da na'urar robot ta tiyata, likitan tiyata yana yanke ciwacen ya ɗinke ƙodar, don a ceci yawancin ƙodar.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.who: Mutane masu ƙaramar ciwace a ƙoda, musamman waɗanda ke da ƙoda ɗaya ko ƙodarsu ba ta aiki sosai.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.partial-nephrectomy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 3 zuwa 4.
treatments.cystectomy.name: Cystectomy (cire mafitsara)
treatments.cystectomy.summary: Cire wani ɓangare ko dukan mafitsara, galibi don magance ciwon daji na mafitsara.
treatments.cystectomy.what: Ana cire mafitsarar, sau da yawa ta na'urar robot. Idan an cire mafitsarar gaba ɗaya, likitan tiyata yana yin sabuwar hanyar fitar fitsari daga jiki, ko dai ƙaramar jaka a kan ciki ko sabuwar mafitsara da aka yi daga hanji.
treatments.cystectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na mafitsara da ya shiga tsokar mafitsarar, ko wanda ke ci gaba da dawowa.
treatments.cystectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 7 zuwa 10. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.cystectomy.recovery: Ku shirya mako 6 zuwa 8 kafin komawa harkokinku na yau da kullum, tare da taimakon ma'aikaciyar jinya don koyon yadda ake kula da sabuwar hanyar fitsari.
treatments.orchiectomy.name: Orchiectomy (cire ƙwalatai)
treatments.orchiectomy.summary: Cire ƙwalata ɗaya ko duka biyu, don magance ciwon daji na ƙwalatai ko rage sinadaran hormone a ciwon daji na prostate.
treatments.orchiectomy.what: Ta wata ƙaramar yanka a gindin ciki kusa da cinya (groin) ko a jakar ƙwalatai, ana cire ƙwalatar. Ana iya saka ƙwalatar roba don kamanni idan ana so.
treatments.orchiectomy.who: Maza masu ciwon daji na ƙwalatai, da wasu maza masu ciwon daji na prostate da ya yi nisa.
treatments.orchiectomy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.orchiectomy.recovery: Yawancin maza suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.lumpectomy.name: Lumpectomy (tiyatar kiyaye nono)
treatments.lumpectomy.summary: Cire ciwon daji na nono tare da ɗan lafiyayyen nama a gefensa, ana barin sauran nonon.
treatments.lumpectomy.what: Ana cire ciwacen da ɗan gefen da ke kewaye da ita, yawanci tare da wasu ƙwayoyin lymph daga hammata. Yawanci ana bin ta da jinyar haske (radiation) don rage yiwuwar dawowar ciwon dajin.
treatments.lumpectomy.who: Mata masu ciwon daji na nono na farko da ke ƙarami idan aka kwatanta da girman nonon.
treatments.lumpectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.lumpectomy.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2, kafin a fara jinyar haske (radiation).
treatments.mastectomy.name: Mastectomy (cire nono)
treatments.mastectomy.summary: Cire nono gaba ɗaya don magance ko hana ciwon daji na nono, tare da zaɓin sake gina shi.
treatments.mastectomy.what: Ana cire naman nono, wani lokaci ana barin fata ko kan nono. Ana iya cire ƙwayoyin lymph daga hammata. Ana iya sake gina nono a tiyatar guda ko daga baya.
treatments.mastectomy.who: Mata masu babban ciwon daji na nono ko wanda ya bazu, ko masu babban haɗarin ciwon daji na nono da aka gada.
treatments.mastectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4, fiye da haka idan an sake gina nono. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.mastectomy.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.hemicolectomy.name: Hemicolectomy (tiyatar ciwon daji na hanji)
treatments.hemicolectomy.summary: Cire rabin dama ko na hagu na babban hanji, galibi saboda ciwon daji na hanji.
treatments.hemicolectomy.what: Ana cire ɓangaren babban hanjin (colon) da abin ya shafa da ƙwayoyin lymph ɗinsa, sannan a haɗa lafiyayyun ƙarshensa biyu. Yawanci ana yin ta ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.hemicolectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na hanji, da wasu masu tsananin cutar hanji kamar cutar Crohn.
treatments.hemicolectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 7. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hemicolectomy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.hepatectomy.name: Hepatectomy (cire wani ɓangare na hanta)
treatments.hepatectomy.summary: Cire wani ɓangare na hanta don fitar da ciwace. Hantar da ta rage tana sake girma.
treatments.hepatectomy.what: Likitan tiyata yana cire ɓangaren hantar da ke ɗauke da ciwacen. Hantar da ta rage tana sake girma cikin 'yan makonni. Ana iya yin ta ta tiyatar buɗewa, ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.hepatectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na hanta, ko ciwon dajin da ya bazu zuwa hanta daga hanji, idan isasshiyar lafiyayyar hanta za ta rage.
treatments.hepatectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 10. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hepatectomy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 6 zuwa 8.
treatments.whipple-surgery.name: Tiyatar Whipple (pancreaticoduodenectomy)
treatments.whipple-surgery.summary: Babbar tiyata da ke cire kan saifa (pancreas) da gaɓoɓin da ke kusa, don magance ciwon daji a wannan wuri.
treatments.whipple-surgery.what: Ana cire kan saifa (pancreas), ɓangaren farko na ƙaramin hanji, jakar bile (gallbladder) da wani ɓangare na bututun bile. Sannan a mayar da saifa, bututun bile da ciki a haɗa su da hanji.
treatments.whipple-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji a kan saifa (pancreas), bututun bile ko ampulla, da wasu masu ciwace marasa ciwon daji a wurin.
treatments.whipple-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 10 zuwa 14. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.whipple-surgery.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako 3 zuwa 4. Cikakkiyar murmurewa tana ɗaukar wata 2 zuwa 3.
treatments.pancreatectomy.name: Pancreatectomy (tiyatar saifa)
treatments.pancreatectomy.summary: Cire wani ɓangare ko dukan saifa (pancreas), saboda ciwace, ƙuraje masu ruwa (cysts) ko kumburi na dogon lokaci.
treatments.pancreatectomy.what: Ya danganta da inda matsalar take, ana cire wutsiya, jiki ko dukan saifar. Wasu tiyata kuma suna cire saifa ta ciki (spleen). Idan an cire dukan saifar (pancreas), ana buƙatar insulin da sinadaran narkar da abinci bayan haka.
treatments.pancreatectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwace ko ƙuraje masu ruwa (cysts) a saifa (pancreas), da wasu masu tsananin kumburin saifa na dogon lokaci (chronic pancreatitis).
treatments.pancreatectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 7 zuwa 12. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.pancreatectomy.recovery: Cikakkiyar murmurewa yawanci tana ɗaukar mako 6 zuwa 8.
treatments.laryngectomy.name: Laryngectomy (cire akwatin murya)
treatments.laryngectomy.summary: Cire wani ɓangare ko dukan akwatin murya (larynx), don magance ciwon daji na maƙogwaro.
treatments.laryngectomy.what: A partial laryngectomy, ana cire ɓangaren da abin ya shafa kaɗai kuma sau da yawa ana kiyaye murya. A total laryngectomy, ana cire dukan akwatin murya kuma mutum yana numfashi ta wata kafa a wuya. Ana iya dawo da magana ta bawul ɗin murya ko wasu hanyoyi.
treatments.laryngectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na akwatin murya, ko ciwon dajin da ya dawo bayan jinyar haske (radiation).
treatments.laryngectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 10 zuwa 14. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.laryngectomy.recovery: Horon magana da haɗiya yana farawa a asibiti. Ku shirya kusan mako 4 zuwa 6 a Indiya.
treatments.neck-dissection.name: Neck dissection (cire ƙwayoyin lymph na wuya)
treatments.neck-dissection.summary: Cire ƙwayoyin lymph a wuya, don magance ko duba yaɗuwar ciwon daji na kai da wuya.
treatments.neck-dissection.what: Ana cire ƙwayoyin lymph a gefe ɗaya ko duka biyu na wuya, wani lokaci tare da tsoka ko jijiya da ke kusa. Sau da yawa ana yin ta a tiyatar guda da cire babbar ciwacen.
treatments.neck-dissection.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na baki, maƙogwaro, akwatin murya, thyroid ko fata da ya yaɗu, ko zai iya yaɗuwa, zuwa wuya.
treatments.neck-dissection.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.neck-dissection.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 3 zuwa 4. Motsa jiki na wuya da kafaɗa yana taimakawa.
treatments.glossectomy.name: Glossectomy (tiyatar ciwon daji na harshe)
treatments.glossectomy.summary: Cire wani ɓangare ko dukan harshe don magance ciwon daji na harshe, sau da yawa tare da sake gina harshen.
treatments.glossectomy.what: Ana cire ɓangaren harshen da ke da ciwon dajin. Idan an cire babban ɓangare, likitan tiyata yana sake gina shi da nama daga hannu ko cinya, don taimakawa wajen magana da haɗiya.
treatments.glossectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na harshe.
treatments.glossectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 7 zuwa 14. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.glossectomy.recovery: Horon magana da haɗiya yana taimakawa. Ku shirya kusan mako 3 zuwa 4 a Indiya.
treatments.maxillectomy.name: Maxillectomy (tiyatar muƙamuƙin sama)
treatments.maxillectomy.summary: Cire wani ɓangare na muƙamuƙin sama, don magance ciwon daji na sinus, rufin baki ko dasashin sama.
treatments.maxillectomy.what: Ana cire ƙashin muƙamuƙin sama da abin ya shafa. Ana cike gurbin da farantin haƙori (obturator) ko a sake gina shi da ƙashi da nama daga wani wuri a jiki.
treatments.maxillectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na muƙamuƙin sama, rufin baki mai tauri, dasashin sama ko sinus na muƙamuƙin sama (maxillary sinus).
treatments.maxillectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 10. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.maxillectomy.recovery: Ku shirya kusan mako 3 zuwa 4 a Indiya, tare da bibiya don farantin ko muƙamuƙin da aka sake ginawa.
treatments.mandibulectomy.name: Mandibulectomy (tiyatar muƙamuƙin ƙasa)
treatments.mandibulectomy.summary: Cire wani ɓangare na muƙamuƙin ƙasa, don magance ciwon daji na baki ko na ƙashin muƙamuƙi, tare da sake gina muƙamuƙin.
treatments.mandibulectomy.what: Ana cire ɓangaren muƙamuƙin ƙasa da abin ya shafa. Yawanci ana sake gina muƙamuƙin a tiyatar guda da ƙashi daga ƙafa (fibula), wanda ake haɗawa ta ƙaramar tiyatar jijiyoyi (microsurgery).
treatments.mandibulectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na baki da ya kai ƙashin muƙamuƙi, da wasu ciwace-ciwacen ƙashin muƙamuƙi.
treatments.mandibulectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 10 zuwa 14. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.mandibulectomy.recovery: Ku shirya kusan mako 4 a Indiya. Cin abinci da magana suna inganta cikin makonnin da ke biye.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.name: Cire ƙwayoyin lymph (lymphadenectomy)
treatments.lymph-node-removal.summary: Cire ƙwayoyin lymph da ke kusa da ciwon daji, don magance shi ko ganin ko ya yaɗu.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.what: Likitan tiyata yana cire rukunin ƙwayoyin lymph da ke tace yankin ciwon dajin, misali a hammata, gindin cinya (groin), ƙugu ko ciki. Sannan masanin binciken nama (pathologist) yana duba su don ƙwayoyin ciwon daji.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.who: Mutane masu ciwon dajin da ke yaɗuwa ta ƙwayoyin lymph, kamar ciwon daji na nono, fata, mahaifa, prostate da hanji.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 4, ya danganta da wurin. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.lymph-node-removal.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4. Wani lokaci kumburin hannu ko ƙafa na iya biyo baya.
treatments.omentectomy.name: Omentectomy
treatments.omentectomy.summary: Cire omentum, wani lulluɓin kitse a cikin ciki, sau da yawa a matsayin ɓangare na tiyatar ciwon daji na mahaifar ƙwai (ovary) ko na ciki.
treatments.omentectomy.what: Ana cire omentum, wanda ke rataye a gaban hanji, domin ciwon daji na iya yaɗuwa zuwa gare shi. Yawanci ana yin sa tare da wata tiyatar ciwon daji.
treatments.omentectomy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na mahaifar ƙwai (ovary), mahaifa, ciki ko hanji, ko ciwon dajin da ya bazu a cikin ciki.
treatments.omentectomy.stay: Yawanci daidai da babbar tiyatar, kusan kwana 5 zuwa 7. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.omentectomy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.name: Radical hysterectomy (cire mahaifa gaba ɗaya)
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.summary: Cire mahaifa, bakin mahaifa (cervix), saman farji da naman da ke kusa, don magance ciwon daji na bakin mahaifa ko na mahaifa.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.what: Ana cire nama fiye da a hysterectomy na yau da kullum, sau da yawa tare da ƙwayoyin lymph na ƙugu. Yawanci ana yin ta ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.who: Mata masu ciwon daji na bakin mahaifa (cervix) na farko, da wasu masu ciwon daji na mahaifa.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.radical-hysterectomy.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 6 zuwa 8.
treatments.mohs-surgery.name: Tiyatar Mohs (ciwon daji na fata)
treatments.mohs-surgery.summary: Ana cire ciwon daji na fata lulluɓi bayan lulluɓi, ana duba kowane lulluɓi a ƙarƙashin na'urar hangen nesa (microscope), don a rasa lafiyayyar fata kaɗan gwargwadon iko.
treatments.mohs-surgery.what: A ƙarƙashin maganin kashe zafi na wuri ɗaya, likitan tiyata yana cire siririn lulluɓi ya duba shi nan take. Ana maimaita hakan har sai babu sauran ciwon daji. Sannan a rufe ko a gyara raunin.
treatments.mohs-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na fata irin basal cell ko squamous cell, musamman a fuska, kunnuwa, hannaye ko wasu wuraren da kiyaye fata ke da muhimmanci.
treatments.mohs-surgery.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: ana yi a rana ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.mohs-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin 'yan kwanaki. Ana cire ɗinki bayan kusan mako ɗaya.
treatments.adjuvant-neoadjuvant-chemothe: Chemotherapy kafin tiyata da bayanta (neoadjuvant da adjuvant)
Chemotherapy da ake bayarwa kafin tiyata don rage girman ciwace (neoadjuvant), ko bayanta don rage yiwuwar dawowar ciwon dajin (adjuvant).

Ana ba da magungunan ciwon daji a zagaye-zagaye, yawanci ta drip, cikin 'yan watanni. Kafin tiyata, suna iya sa ciwace ta ragu kuma ta fi sauƙin cirewa. Bayan tiyata, suna magance duk wasu ƙwayoyin ciwon daji da suka rage. Jinyar adjuvant na iya nufin jinyar haske (radiation), ta hormone ko targeted therapy bayan tiyata.
Mutane masu ciwon daji irin na nono, hanji, ciki, makogwaron abinci, mafitsara da huhu, bisa shawarar ƙungiyar likitocin ciwon daji.
Yawanci ana bayarwa a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Gajiya da sauran illoli yawanci suna raguwa 'yan makonni bayan zagaye na ƙarshe.
treatments.hormone-therapy.name: Jinyar hormone don ciwon daji
treatments.hormone-therapy.summary: Magungunan da ke toshewa ko rage sinadaran hormone da wasu ciwon daji ke buƙata don girma.
treatments.hormone-therapy.what: Ƙwayoyi ko allurai suna hana jiki samar da wani hormone, ko suna hana ciwon dajin amfani da shi. Sau da yawa ana bayarwa na watanni ko shekaru, tare da ko bayan wata jinya.
treatments.hormone-therapy.who: Mutane masu ciwon dajin da hormone ke shafa, galibi ciwon daji na nono da na prostate, da wasu ciwon daji na mahaifa.
treatments.hormone-therapy.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: ƙwayoyi ko allurai a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hormone-therapy.recovery: Yawanci ana ci gaba da jinyar a gida, tare da duba lafiya daga likitanku.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.name: Photodynamic therapy (jinya da magani da haske)
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.summary: Magani mai jin haske da wani haske na musamman da ake amfani da su tare don lalata ƙwayoyin ciwon daji ko na kafin ciwon daji.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.what: Ana ba da maganin da ke taruwa a ƙwayoyin da ba su da kyau, sannan a haska wurin da laser ko fitila. Hasken yana kunna maganin, kuma yana lalata waɗannan ƙwayoyin.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.who: Mutane masu wasu ciwon daji na fata da yanayin kafin ciwon daji, da wasu ciwon daji na farko na makogwaron abinci ko huhu.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.stay: Yawanci babu kwanciya a asibiti, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.photodynamic-therapy.recovery: Fatar da aka yi wa jinya tana ciwo na 'yan kwanaki. Dole ku guji haske mai ƙarfi na wani lokaci bayan haka.
treatments.brachytherapy.name: Brachytherapy (jinyar haske daga ciki)
treatments.brachytherapy.summary: Jinyar haske (radiation) da ake bayarwa daga cikin jiki, ta hanyar saka tushen haske mai guba (radioactive) a ciki ko kusa da ciwacen.
treatments.brachytherapy.what: Siraran bututu ko ƙananan ƙwayoyi suna kai hasken har zuwa ciwon dajin, don babban adadi ya isa ciwacen, kaɗan kuma ya isa lafiyayyen nama. Ana iya bayarwa a 'yan gajerun zama ko a matsayin ƙwayoyin da ake barinsu a wurin.
treatments.brachytherapy.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na bakin mahaifa, mahaifa, prostate, nono, da wasu ciwon daji na kai da wuya.
treatments.brachytherapy.stay: Sau da yawa ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida; wasu jinya suna buƙatar dare 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.brachytherapy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin 'yan kwanaki.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.sum: Jinyar haske mai tsananin daidaito da babban adadi da ake nufar ƙaramin wuri daga kusurwoyi da yawa, a zama ɗaya zuwa biyar.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.wha: Ba a yin yanka. Hotunan na'ura masu cikakken bayani suna jagorantar siraran haskoki da yawa da ke haɗuwa a kan ciwacen. Ana amfani da ita a ƙwaƙwalwa (SRS) da a jiki, kamar huhu, hanta da ƙashin baya (SBRT).
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.who: Mutane masu ƙananan ciwace a ƙwaƙwalwa, ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu zuwa ƙwaƙwalwa ko ƙashin baya, ciwon daji na huhu na farko, da wasu ciwon daji na hanta da prostate.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.sta: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama ɗaya zuwa biyar ba tare da kwanciya ba. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.stereotactic-radiosurgery.rec: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum a ranar ko washegari.
treatments.tomotherapy.name: Tomotherapy
treatments.tomotherapy.summary: Jinyar haske (radiation) da ake bayarwa a karkace, tare da ɗaukar hoton na'ura kafin kowane zama, don daidaita adadin sosai da ciwacen.
treatments.tomotherapy.what: Na'urar tana haɗa na'urar ɗaukar hoto ta CT da na'urar jinyar haske. Tana zagaya ku, tana duba wurin da ciwacen take tana daidaita hasken don kare gaɓoɓin da ke kusa.
treatments.tomotherapy.who: Mutane masu sarƙaƙƙiyar ciwon daji da ke kusa da muhimman gaɓoɓi, kamar na kai da wuya, prostate da wasu ciwon daji na yara.
treatments.tomotherapy.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama na kowace rana ba tare da kwanciya ba, cikin makonni da yawa. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.tomotherapy.recovery: Illoli sun danganta da wurin da aka yi wa jinya kuma yawanci suna raguwa makonni bayan ƙarshen jinya.
treatments.radiation-therapy-brain-tumou: Jinyar haske don ciwace a ƙwaƙwalwa
Jinyar haske (radiation) da ake nufar ciwace a ƙwaƙwalwa, ita kaɗai ko bayan tiyata.
Ana daidaita haskoki da siffar ciwacen ta amfani da hotunan na'ura da abin rufe fuska da ke riƙe kai a tsaye. Ana iya bayarwa cikin makonni da yawa ko a matsayin radiosurgery a 'yan zama.
Mutane masu ciwace a ƙwaƙwalwa kamar glioma da meningioma, da ciwon dajin da ya yaɗu zuwa ƙwaƙwalwa.
Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama ba tare da kwanciya ba. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Gajiya ta zama ruwan dare yayin jinya da 'yan makonni bayan haka.
treatments.radiation-therapy-breast-canc: Jinyar haske don ciwon daji na nono
Jinyar haske (radiation) ga nono ko bangon ƙirji bayan tiyata, don rage yiwuwar dawowar ciwon daji na nono.
Zama na kowace rana na 'yan mintoci kowanne, yawanci cikin mako 1 zuwa 4. Hanyoyin riƙe numfashi suna taimakawa wajen kare zuciya.
Mata bayan lumpectomy, da wasu bayan mastectomy.
Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama na kowace rana ba tare da kwanciya ba. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Fatar na iya yin ja da ciwo na 'yan makonni. Yawancin mata suna ci gaba da rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum yayin jinya.
treatments.radiation-therapy-lung-cancer: Jinyar haske don ciwon daji na huhu
Jinyar haske (radiation) da ake nufar ciwon daji na huhu, a matsayin babbar jinya ko tare da chemotherapy ko tiyata.
Ana daidaita haskoki da siffar ciwacen kuma a daidaita lokacinsu da numfashinku. Ana iya magance ƙananan ciwon daji na farko da SBRT a 'yan zama; manya kuma cikin makonni da yawa.
Mutane masu ciwon daji na huhu a kowane mataki, har da waɗanda ba su da ƙarfin yin tiyata.
Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama ba tare da kwanciya ba. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Gajiya, tari ko ciwon maƙogwaro na iya faruwa kuma yawanci suna raguwa makonni bayan jinya.
treatments.radiation-therapy-prostate-ca: Jinyar haske don ciwon daji na prostate
Jinyar haske (radiation) don magance ciwon daji na prostate, a madadin tiyata ko bayanta.
Haskoki daga waje cikin 'yan makonni, ko ƙwayoyin brachytherapy da ake sakawa a cikin prostate. Wani lokaci ana ba da jinyar hormone tare.
Maza masu ciwon daji na prostate da bai yaɗu nesa ba, da mazan da ciwon dajinsu ya dawo bayan tiyata.
Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama ba tare da kwanciya ba. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Yawaita fitsari da zawo na iya faruwa kuma yawanci suna lafawa bayan jinya.
treatments.allogeneic-transplant.name: Dashen ɓargo daga mai bayarwa (allogeneic transplant)
treatments.allogeneic-transplant.summary: Dashen stem cell da ke amfani da lafiyayyun ƙwayoyin samar da jini daga mai bayarwa, sau da yawa ɗan uwa, 'yar uwa ko mahaifi.
treatments.allogeneic-transplant.what: Jinya mai ƙarfi tana share ɓargon da ke da cuta, sannan a ba da ƙwayoyin stem cell na mai bayarwa ta drip. Suna zama a cikin ƙasusuwa su samar da sababbin lafiyayyun ƙwayoyin jini da na garkuwar jiki. Mai bayarwa na iya dacewa gaba ɗaya ko rabi (haploidentical).
treatments.allogeneic-transplant.who: Mutane masu leukaemia, wasu lymphoma, myelodysplasia, aplastic anaemia, thalassaemia da cutar sikila (sickle cell).
treatments.allogeneic-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 30 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.allogeneic-transplant.recover: Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan wata 3. Adadin jini da garkuwar jiki suna ɗaukar watanni kafin su murmure sosai.
treatments.autologous-transplant.name: Dashen ɓargo da ƙwayoyin mara lafiyar kansa (autologous transplant)
treatments.autologous-transplant.summary: Dashen stem cell da ke amfani da ƙwayoyin stem cell na mara lafiyar kansa, waɗanda aka tattara aka adana kafin jinya mai ƙarfi.
treatments.autologous-transplant.what: Ana tattara ƙwayoyin stem cell daga jini a daskare su. Sannan a ba da chemotherapy mai ƙarfi don lalata cutar, kuma a mayar da ƙwayoyin da aka adana ta drip don ɓargon ya sake fara aiki.
treatments.autologous-transplant.who: Galibi mutane masu multiple myeloma da wasu lymphoma.
treatments.autologous-transplant.stay: Kusan kwana 30 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.autologous-transplant.recover: Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan mako 6 zuwa 8. Ƙarfi yana dawowa cikin watannin da ke biye.
treatments.plasmapheresis.name: Plasmapheresis (musayar plasma)
treatments.plasmapheresis.summary: Na'ura tana cire ruwan jini (plasma) ta maye gurbinsa, don share ƙwayoyin garkuwa (antibodies) ko sunadaran da ke cutarwa.
treatments.plasmapheresis.what: Ana jan jini ta bututu, a raba plasma a maye gurbinta da plasma daga mai bayarwa ko ruwan sunadari, sannan a mayar da jinin. Kowane zama yana ɗaukar awa 2 zuwa 3, sau da yawa ana maimaitawa cikin kwanaki.
treatments.plasmapheresis.who: Mutane masu wasu cututtukan garkuwar jiki, jijiyoyi, jini da ƙoda, kamar Guillain-Barré syndrome, myasthenia gravis da TTP, da wasu marasa lafiya na dashe.
treatments.plasmapheresis.stay: Ya danganta da cutar; sau da yawa ana bayarwa yayin kwanciya a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.plasmapheresis.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna jin gajiya na 'yan awoyi bayan zama.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.name: Tiyatar farfaɗiya (epilepsy)
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.summary: Tiyata don cirewa ko raba ɓangaren ƙwaƙwalwa inda farfaɗiya ke farawa, idan magunguna ba sa shawo kanta.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.what: Gwaje-gwaje har da video EEG da MRI suna gano inda farfaɗiyar ke farawa. Sannan likitan tiyata yana cire wannan ƙaramin wuri, ko ya saka na'urar da ke kwantar da saƙonnin ƙwaƙwalwa, kamar vagus nerve stimulator.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.who: Mutanen da farfaɗiyarsu ke ci gaba duk da gwada magungunan farfaɗiya biyu ko fiye.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 7, bayan gwaje-gwaje. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.epilepsy-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 6. Yawanci ana ci gaba da shan magungunan farfaɗiya na ɗan lokaci.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.name: Jinyar kumburin jijiyar jini a ƙwaƙwalwa (coiling da clipping)
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.summary: Jinya don rufe jijiyar jini mai rauni da ta kumbura a ƙwaƙwalwa kafin ta fashe, ko bayan ta zubar da jini.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.what: A coiling, ana tura siririn bututu daga gindin cinya (groin) zuwa ƙwaƙwalwa a cike kumburin da lallausan waya mai naɗi (coils) ko stent. A clipping, likitan tiyata yana buɗe ƙoƙon kai ya saka ƙaramin ƙugiya a wuyan kumburin.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.who: Mutane masu kumburin jijiyar jini a ƙwaƙwalwa (aneurysm) da aka gano a hoton na'ura, ko waɗanda suka sami zubar jini a ƙwaƙwalwa saboda shi.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4 bayan coiling; fiye da haka bayan clipping ko zubar jini. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.aneurysm-treatment.recovery: Bayan coiling, yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2; bayan clipping, mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.stroke-treatment.name: Jinyar shanyewar ɓarin jiki (cire daskararren jini)
treatments.stroke-treatment.summary: Kulawar gaggawa da ta bayan haka don shanyewar ɓarin jiki (stroke), har da cire daskararren jini daga jijiyar ƙwaƙwalwa.
treatments.stroke-treatment.what: Maganin narkar da daskararren jini ko siririn bututu da ake tura shi daga gindin cinya (groin) zuwa ƙwaƙwalwa (thrombectomy) yana sake buɗe jijiyar da ta toshe. Sannan kulawa a sashen stroke da horon farfaɗowa suna taimaka wa murmurewa.
treatments.stroke-treatment.who: Mutanen da suka sami shanyewar ɓarin jiki, da mutanen da ke buƙatar horon farfaɗowa ko kariya bayan haka.
treatments.stroke-treatment.stay: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 10. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.stroke-treatment.recovery: Murmurewa tana bambanta sosai. Jinyar motsa jiki (physiotherapy), horon magana da horon ayyukan yau da kullum suna ci gaba na makonni ko watanni.
treatments.cranioplasty.name: Cranioplasty (gyaran ƙoƙon kai)
treatments.cranioplasty.summary: Tiyata don gyara gurbi a ƙoƙon kai, yawanci bayan tiyatar ƙwaƙwalwa ta baya ko rauni.
treatments.cranioplasty.what: Ana maye gurbin ɓangaren ƙoƙon kai da ya ɓace da ƙashin mara lafiyar kansa da aka adana ko da wani abin sakawa da aka ƙera musamman.
treatments.cranioplasty.who: Mutanen da aka cire musu wani ɓangare na ƙoƙon kai don rage matsi a kan ƙwaƙwalwa, ko masu lahani a ƙoƙon kai saboda rauni.
treatments.cranioplasty.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.cranioplasty.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.name: Tiyatar ƙwaƙwalwa ta endoscope
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.summary: Tiyatar ƙwaƙwalwa ta ƙaramar kafa ko ta hanci, ta amfani da siririyar kyamara.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.what: Ana tura endoscope ta ƙaramar huda a ƙoƙon kai ko ta hanci don isa ga ciwace, ƙuraje masu ruwa (cysts) ko hanyoyin ruwa da suka toshe ba tare da babbar buɗewa ba.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.who: Mutane masu ciwace a gland ɗin pituitary, wasu ciwace a gindin ƙoƙon kai, ƙuraje masu ruwa a ƙwaƙwalwa da hydrocephalus (taruwar ruwa a ƙwaƙwalwa).
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.neuro-endoscopy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.nam: Maye gurbin gwiwa da gaɓa ta na'urar robot
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.sum: Maye gurbin gwiwa ko kwatangwalo da ake yi da na'urar robot ta tiyata, don sabuwar gaɓar ta dace daidai.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.wha: Hoton na'ura na gaɓarku yana gina tsari na 3D. Yayin tiyata, hannun robot yana taimaka wa likitan tiyata ya cire ƙashin da ya lalace kaɗai ya saka abin sakawar daidai yadda aka tsara.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.who: Mutane masu ciwon gaɓoɓi (arthritis) a gwiwa ko kwatangwalo da ke buƙatar maye gurbin gaɓa.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.sta: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.robotic-joint-replacement.rec: Yawancin mutane suna tafiya da taimako washegari kuma suna komawa rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.name: Maye gurbin wani ɓangare na gwiwa
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.summ: Maye gurbin ɓangaren gwiwar da ya lalace kaɗai, ana barin lafiyayyun ɓangarori da jijiyoyin haɗa ƙashi (ligaments).
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.what: Ta ƙaramar yanka, ana sabunta ɓangaren gwiwar da ya lalace kaɗai da abin sakawa. Sau da yawa gwiwar tana jin kamar ta asali fiye da bayan cikakken maye gurbi.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.who: Mutanen da ciwon gaɓoɓinsu (arthritis) ya shafi ɓangare ɗaya kaɗai na gwiwa, kuma jijiyoyin haɗa ƙashinsu suna lafiya.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.partial-knee-replacement.reco: Yawancin mutane suna komawa rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum cikin mako 3 zuwa 4.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.name: Maye gurbin kafaɗa
treatments.shoulder-replacement.summary: Maye gurbin gaɓar kafaɗa da ta lalace ko ta karye da ta roba, don rage ciwo da dawo da motsi.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.what: Ana maye gurbin ƙwallon gaɓar da kwanon ta da suka lalace da sassan ƙarfe da roba. Reverse shoulder replacement yana musanya wurin ƙwallon da kwanon, ga mutanen da tsokokin rotator cuff ɗinsu suka yage.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.who: Mutane masu tsananin ciwon gaɓar kafaɗa (arthritis), babban yagewar rotator cuff, ko karaya mai sarƙaƙƙiya.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.shoulder-replacement.recovery: Hannun yana hutawa a rataye (sling) na kusan mako 4 zuwa 6. Cikakkiyar murmurewa tare da physiotherapy tana ɗaukar kusan wata 6.
treatments.elbow-replacement.name: Maye gurbin gwiwar hannu
treatments.elbow-replacement.summary: Maye gurbin gaɓar gwiwar hannu da ta lalace da ta roba.
treatments.elbow-replacement.what: Ana maye gurbin ƙarshen ƙasusuwan hannu da suka lalace a gwiwar hannu da sassan ƙarfe da roba da aka haɗa da maɗaurin ƙofa (hinge).
treatments.elbow-replacement.who: Mutane masu tsananin ciwon gaɓar gwiwar hannu, sau da yawa saboda rheumatoid arthritis, ko karaya mai sarƙaƙƙiya.
treatments.elbow-replacement.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.elbow-replacement.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa amfani mai sauƙi na yau da kullum cikin mako 6 zuwa 8; ana guje wa ɗaukar abu mai nauyi bayan haka.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.name: Knee arthroscopy (tiyatar gwiwa ta ƙaramar huda)
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.summary: Tiyata ta ƙaramar huda don duba cikin gwiwa da gyara lalacewa ta ƙananan yanka.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.what: Ana shigar da ƙaramar kyamara da siraran kayan aiki cikin gwiwa don gyara ko datse guringuntsi (cartilage), cire guntattakin da suka ɓalle ko magance lalacewar jijiyoyin haɗa ƙashi.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.who: Mutane masu ciwon gwiwa, kullewa ko kumburi saboda yagewar guringuntsi, guntattakin da suka ɓalle ko raunin wasanni.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.knee-arthroscopy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna tafiya a ranar kuma suna komawa rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 3.
treatments.meniscus-repair.name: Gyaran meniscus na gwiwa
treatments.meniscus-repair.summary: Tiyata ta ƙaramar huda don ɗinke meniscus da ya yage, guringuntsin da ke kare gwiwa.
treatments.meniscus-repair.what: Ta arthroscope, likitan tiyata yana ɗinke yagewar don ta warke, ko ya datse ɓangaren da ya yage idan ba za a iya gyara shi ba.
treatments.meniscus-repair.who: Mutane masu yagewar meniscus da ke haddasa ciwo, kullewa ko gwiwar ta yi ta kasawa, sau da yawa bayan raunin murɗewa.
treatments.meniscus-repair.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.meniscus-repair.recovery: Bayan gyara, ana amfani da sanduna (crutches) na 'yan makonni. Yawanci ana komawa wasanni cikin wata 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.name: Shoulder arthroscopy (tiyatar kafaɗa ta ƙaramar huda)
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.summary: Tiyatar kafaɗa ta ƙaramar huda don gyara rotator cuff da ya yage, kafaɗa mara ƙarfi ko gaɓa da ta sandare.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.what: Ana shigar da ƙaramar kyamara da kayan aiki cikin kafaɗa ta ƙananan yanka. Likitan tiyata na iya gyara jijiyoyin tsoka (tendons), matse gaɓar ko sakin sandarewa.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.who: Mutane masu yagewar rotator cuff, gocewar kafaɗa akai-akai, kafaɗa da ta sandare (frozen shoulder) ko matsewar gaɓa (impingement).
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.shoulder-arthroscopy.recovery: Sau da yawa ana sanya rataye (sling) na 'yan makonni. Cikakkiyar murmurewa tare da physiotherapy tana ɗaukar wata 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.name: Elbow arthroscopy (tiyatar gwiwar hannu ta ƙaramar huda)
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.summary: Tiyatar gwiwar hannu ta ƙaramar huda don cire guntattakin da suka ɓalle, sakin gaɓa da ta sandare ko magance tennis elbow.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.what: Ana shigar da siririyar kyamara da ƙananan kayan aiki cikin gwiwar hannu ta ƙananan yanka don tsaftacewa ko gyara gaɓar.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.who: Mutane masu ciwon gwiwar hannu, kullewa ko sandarewa saboda guntattakin da suka ɓalle, ciwon gaɓoɓi (arthritis) ko raunin wasanni.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.elbow-arthroscopy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa amfani na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 6.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.name: Wrist arthroscopy (tiyatar wuyan hannu ta ƙaramar huda)
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.summary: Tiyatar wuyan hannu ta ƙaramar huda don ganowa da gyara jijiyoyin haɗa ƙashi ko guringuntsi da suka yage.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.what: Ana shigar da ƙaramar kyamara cikin wuyan hannu don likitan tiyata ya gani ya gyara yagewar jijiyoyin haɗa ƙashi ko guringuntsi, ko ya cire ƙurji mai ruwa (cyst).
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.who: Mutane masu ciwon wuyan hannu da ke ci gaba bayan rauni, ƙurjin ganglion, ko wasu karayar wuyan hannu.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.wrist-arthroscopy.recovery: Ana iya sanya ɗamarar tallafi (splint) na 'yan makonni. Yawancin mutane suna komawa amfani na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 8.
treatments.wrist-surgery.name: Tiyatar wuyan hannu
treatments.wrist-surgery.summary: Tiyata don karayar wuyan hannu, carpal tunnel syndrome, ciwon gaɓoɓi (arthritis) da sauran matsalolin wuyan hannu.
treatments.wrist-surgery.what: Ya danganta da matsalar, likitan tiyata yana gyara ƙasusuwan da suka karye da faranti ko ƙusoshi, yana sakin jijiyar da aka matse, ko yana haɗe ko maye gurbin gaɓar da ta lalace.
treatments.wrist-surgery.who: Mutane masu karayar wuyan hannu, yatsun da ke mutuwa saboda carpal tunnel syndrome, ko ciwon gaɓar wuyan hannu.
treatments.wrist-surgery.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.wrist-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa amfani mai sauƙi cikin mako 2 zuwa 6, tare da jinyar hannu.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.name: Hip arthroscopy (tiyatar kwatangwalo ta ƙaramar huda)
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.summary: Tiyatar kwatangwalo ta ƙaramar huda don gyara guringuntsi da ya yage da sake fasalin gaɓar.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.what: Ana shigar da kyamara da kayan aiki cikin gaɓar kwatangwalo don gyara labrum da ya yage, cire guntattakin da suka ɓalle ko datse ƙashin da ke matse gaɓar.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.who: Mutane masu ƙwazo da ke da ciwon kwatangwalo saboda yagewar labrum ko matsewar gaɓar kwatangwalo, kafin ciwon gaɓoɓi (arthritis) ya yi nisa.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hip-arthroscopy.recovery: Sanduna (crutches) na 'yan makonni. Yawancin mutane suna komawa wasanni cikin wata 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.name: Ankle arthroscopy (tiyatar idon sawu ta ƙaramar huda)
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.summary: Tiyatar idon sawu ta ƙaramar huda don magance ciwo, sandarewa ko lalacewar guringuntsi.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.what: Ana shigar da kyamara da ƙananan kayan aiki cikin idon sawu don cire naman tabo, ƙayayuwar ƙashi ko guntattakin da suka ɓalle, da magance lalacewar guringuntsi.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.who: Mutane masu ciwon idon sawu ko kumburi da ke ci gaba bayan targaɗe, ko masu ciwon gaɓar idon sawu na farko.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.ankle-arthroscopy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa tafiya ta yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 6.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.name: Tiyatar gyaran guringuntsi (cartilage)
treatments.cartilage-surgery.summary: Tiyata don gyara ko sake girmar da guringuntsin gaɓa da ya lalace, galibi a gwiwa.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.what: Hanyoyin sun haɗa da microfracture, wanda ke taimaka wa sabon guringuntsi ya girma, da dasa lafiyayyen guringuntsi daga wani ɓangare na gaɓar ko wanda aka girmar a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.who: Matasa masu ƙwazo da ke da ƙaramin wurin lalacewar guringuntsi, kafin ciwon gaɓoɓi (arthritis) ya fara.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.cartilage-surgery.recovery: Sanduna (crutches) na mako 4 zuwa 6. Cikakkiyar murmurewa da komawa wasanni na iya ɗaukar wata 6 zuwa 12.
treatments.physiotherapy.name: Physiotherapy da horon farfaɗowa
treatments.physiotherapy.summary: Motsa jiki, jinya da hannu da jinyar zafi ko ta wutar lantarki don dawo da motsi da ƙarfi.
treatments.physiotherapy.what: Masanin physiotherapy yana tsara motsa jiki da jinya kamar infrared da sauran jinyar zafi, ultrasound da motsa tsoka da wutar lantarki, kafin da bayan tiyata, ko don raunuka da ciwo na dogon lokaci.
treatments.physiotherapy.who: Mutanen da ke murmurewa daga maye gurbin gaɓa, tiyatar ƙashin baya ko ta raunin wasanni, shanyewar ɓarin jiki, ko masu fama da ciwon baya da na gaɓoɓi.
treatments.physiotherapy.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama ba tare da kwanciya ba, ko yayin zamanku a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.physiotherapy.recovery: Yawancin tsare-tsare suna ɗaukar 'yan makonni, tare da motsa jikin da za a ci gaba da yi a gida.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.name: Tiyatar zuciyar yara
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.summ: Tiyata da ayyukan ƙaramar huda don gyara matsalolin zuciya da jarirai da yara aka haife su da su.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.what: Ana gyara ramuka a zuciya, bawul ɗin da suka matse da sauran lahani na haihuwa ta tiyatar buɗewa ko da na'urorin da ake turawa ta jijiyar jini, ba tare da buɗe ƙirji ba.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.who: Jarirai da yara masu cutar zuciya ta haihuwa, kamar ASD, VSD, PDA da tetralogy of Fallot.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3 bayan aikin catheter; kwana 7 zuwa 14 bayan tiyatar buɗewa. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.paediatric-heart-surgery.reco: Yara sau da yawa suna murmurewa da sauri. Ku shirya kusan mako 2 zuwa 3 a Indiya bayan tiyatar buɗewa.
treatments.icd-implantation.name: Saka na'urar ICD da CRT
treatments.icd-implantation.summary: Ƙaramar na'ura da ake sakawa ƙarƙashin fata da ke lura da bugun zuciya kuma tana gyara bugun zuciya mai haɗari ko zuciya mai rauni wajen tura jini.
treatments.icd-implantation.what: Ta ƙaramar yanka ƙasa da ƙashin wuya, ana tura wayoyi zuwa zuciya a haɗa su da na'urar. ICD tana ba da girgizar lantarki don dakatar da bugun zuciya mai barazana ga rai. Na'urar CRT tana taimaka wa ɓangarorin zuciya biyu su tura jini tare.
treatments.icd-implantation.who: Mutane masu haɗarin tsayawar zuciya kwatsam, da mutane masu gazawar zuciya da zuciyarsu ba ta bugawa daidai.
treatments.icd-implantation.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.icd-implantation.recovery: Ku guji ɗaga hannun da ke wannan gefe sama da kafaɗa na kusan mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.name: Jinyar bugun zuciya mara daidai (EP study da ablation)
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.summary: Ganowa da magance dalilin bugun zuciya mara daidai ko mai sauri da siraran wayoyi da ake turawa zuwa zuciya.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.what: A binciken electrophysiology (EP), wayoyi suna zana taswirar saƙonnin lantarki na zuciya. Sannan ablation yana amfani da zafi ko sanyi don magance ƙaramin wurin da ke haddasa bugun zuciya mara daidai.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.who: Mutane masu atrial fibrillation, SVT, flutter da sauran matsalolin bugun zuciya da magunguna ba sa shawo kansu.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.arrhythmia-ablation.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako ɗaya.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.name: Jinyar ciwace a zuciya
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.summar: Tiyata da sauran jinya don ciwace-ciwacen da ke girma a ciki ko a kan zuciya.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.what: Yawancin ciwace-ciwacen zuciya ba ciwon daji ba ne, kamar myxoma, kuma ana cire su ta tiyatar buɗe zuciya. Ana magance ciwace-ciwacen zuciya masu ciwon daji, waɗanda ba safai suke ba, da tiyata, chemotherapy da jinyar haske (radiation) tare.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.who: Mutanen da aka gano wani ƙari a zuciyarsu a hoton na'ura.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.stay: Yawanci kwana 7 zuwa 10 bayan tiyata. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.heart-tumour-treatment.recove: Ku shirya kusan mako 4 zuwa 6 kafin komawa harkokinku na yau da kullum.
treatments.gastric-balloon.name: Balan-balan a ciki (gastric balloon)
treatments.gastric-balloon.summary: Lallausan balan-balan da ake sakawa a ciki ta baki, don taimaka muku ku ji ƙoshi da wuri kuma ku rage ƙiba. Ba a buƙatar yanka.
treatments.gastric-balloon.what: A ƙarƙashin maganin kwantar da hankali mai sauƙi, ana tura balan-balan mara iska cikin ciki da endoscope a cika shi da ruwan gishiri. Yana zama na kusan wata 6 zuwa 12, sannan a cire shi ta hanya guda.
treatments.gastric-balloon.who: Mutane masu ƙiba da ke son taimako wajen rage ƙiba ba tare da tiyata ba, ko waɗanda ke buƙatar rage ƙiba kafin wata tiyata.
treatments.gastric-balloon.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.gastric-balloon.recovery: Tashin zuciya ya zama ruwan dare na 'yan kwanaki. Tsarin abinci da bibiya suna taimaka muku ku kiyaye ƙibar da kuka rage.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.name: Cire jakar bile (laparoscopic cholecystectomy)
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.summary: Cire jakar bile (gallbladder) ta ƙaramar huda, jinyar da aka saba don tsakuwar jakar bile mai ciwo.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.what: Ta ƙananan yanka uku ko huɗu, ana cire jakar bile da tsakuwoyinta. Kuna iya rayuwa ta yau da kullum ba tare da jakar bile ba.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.who: Mutane masu tsakuwar jakar bile da ke haddasa ciwo, kamuwa da cuta, shawara (jaundice) ko kumburin saifa (pancreatitis).
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.gallbladder-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.hernia-surgery.name: Gyaran hernia (ta ƙaramar huda da ta na'urar robot)
treatments.hernia-surgery.summary: Tiyata don mayar da kumburin wurinsa da ƙarfafa wurin da ke da rauni, yawanci da raga (mesh).
treatments.hernia-surgery.what: Ana gyara hernia ta ƙananan yanka ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot, ko ta yanka ɗaya a tiyatar buɗewa. Yawanci ana saka raga (mesh) don tallafa wa wurin.
treatments.hernia-surgery.who: Mutane masu hernia irin ta gindin cinya (inguinal), cibiya (umbilical), ta wurin tsohon yanka (incisional) ko hiatus hernia da ke ciwo ko ke ƙaruwa.
treatments.hernia-surgery.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hernia-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin mako 1 zuwa 2, da ɗaukar abu mai nauyi cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.appendectomy.name: Cire appendix (appendectomy)
treatments.appendectomy.summary: Cire appendix da ya kumbura, yawanci ta ƙaramar huda.
treatments.appendectomy.what: Ana cire appendix ta ƙananan yanka a ciki. Sau da yawa tiyatar gaggawa ce.
treatments.appendectomy.who: Mutane masu kumburin appendix (appendicitis), ko ciwon appendix da ke maimaituwa.
treatments.appendectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.appendectomy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 3.
treatments.robotic-surgery.name: Tiyata ta na'urar robot da da Vinci ta ƙaramar huda
treatments.robotic-surgery.summary: Tiyatar da ake yi da robot ɗin da Vinci ta ƙananan yanka, don ƙarancin ciwo, ƙarancin zubar jini da komawa gida da wuri.
treatments.robotic-surgery.what: Likitan tiyata yana sarrafa kayan aikin robot daga tebur na sarrafawa da hoton 3D da aka ƙara girmansa. Ana amfani da ita don tiyatar hernia, jakar bile, hanji, rage ƙiba, jinyar fitsari, jinyar mata da ciwon daji.
treatments.robotic-surgery.who: Mutanen da ke buƙatar tiyata inda likitan tiyata ya ba da shawarar amfani da robot.
treatments.robotic-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 4, ya danganta da irin tiyatar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.robotic-surgery.recovery: Yawanci ta fi tiyatar buɗewa sauri; mutane da yawa suna komawa rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 3.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.name: Tiyatar hanta, bututun bile da saifa (pancreas)
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.summary: Tiyata don matsalolin hanta, bututun bile da saifa (pancreas) da ba ciwon daji ba, kamar tsakuwa, ƙuraje masu ruwa (cysts) da toshewa.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.what: Tiyatar sun haɗa da cire ƙuraje masu ruwa a hanta, gyara ko kewaye bututun bile da suka toshe, da zubar da ruwa ko cire wani ɓangare na saifar da ta lalace, sau da yawa ta ƙaramar huda.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.who: Mutane masu tsakuwa ko matsewar bututun bile, choledochal cysts, ƙuraje masu ruwa a hanta da kumburin saifa na dogon lokaci (chronic pancreatitis).
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 10, ya danganta da irin tiyatar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hepatobiliary-surgery.recover: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 6.
treatments.endoscopy.name: Endoscopy da colonoscopy
treatments.endoscopy.summary: Siririyar kyamara da ake turawa ta baki ko ta dubura don duba cikin hanji, ɗaukar samfur da magance matsaloli.
treatments.endoscopy.what: A ƙarƙashin maganin kwantar da hankali mai sauƙi, likita yana duba makogwaron abinci, ciki da hanji. Ana iya cire ƙananan tsiro (polyps) da magance zubar jini a gwajin guda.
treatments.endoscopy.who: Mutane masu ƙwannafi, wahalar haɗiya, zubar jini, ciwon ciki na dogon lokaci ko canje-canje a bayan gida, da kuma don binciken ciwon daji.
treatments.endoscopy.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: 'yan awoyi. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.endoscopy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum washegari.
treatments.ercp-eus.name: ERCP da endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)
treatments.ercp-eus.summary: Endoscopy na zamani don gani da magance bututun bile da saifa (pancreas) ba tare da tiyata ba.
treatments.ercp-eus.what: A ERCP, kyamara ta baki tana isa bututun bile don cire tsakuwa ko saka stent. A EUS, ultrasound da ke kan kyamarar yana ba da hotuna na kusa na saifa (pancreas) da gaɓoɓin da ke kusa kuma yana iya ɗaukar samfur.
treatments.ercp-eus.who: Mutane masu tsakuwar bututun bile, shawara (jaundice), matsewar bututun bile, ko ƙari a saifa (pancreas).
treatments.ercp-eus.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.ercp-eus.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin kwana 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.name: Jinyar kitse a hanta
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.summary: Gwaje-gwaje da tsari don juyar da taruwar kitse a hanta kafin ya haddasa lalacewa ta dindindin.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.what: FibroScan da gwaje-gwajen jini suna auna kitse da tabo a hanta. Jinyar ita ce tsarin rage nauyi, abinci da motsa jiki, shawo kan ciwon suga da cholesterol, da magunguna inda ake buƙata.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.who: Mutanen da aka gaya musu suna da kitse a hanta, sau da yawa tare da ƙaruwar nauyi, ciwon suga ko yawan cholesterol.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: ziyarar asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.fatty-liver-treatment.recover: Rage nauyi a hankali cikin watanni na iya juyar da kitse a hanta na farko.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.sum: Kulawa don rage saurin tabon hanta da magance matsalolinsa, da shirya dashe idan ana buƙata.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.wha: Ana magance dalilin, kamar ciwon hanta (hepatitis), barasa ko kitse a hanta. Ana shawo kan matsaloli kamar kumburin jijiyoyi, taruwar ruwa a ciki da ruɗewar hankali da magunguna da endoscopy. Ana shirya dashen hanta idan hantar tana kasawa.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.who: Mutane masu cirrhosis daga kowane dalili.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.sta: Sau da yawa kulawa a asibiti ba tare da kwanciya ba; ɗan gajeren kwanciya a asibiti don matsaloli. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.liver-cirrhosis-treatment.rec: Cirrhosis yana buƙatar bibiya har tsawon rayuwa tare da ƙwararren likitan hanta.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.name: Jinyar tsakuwar ƙoda
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.summar: Farfasa ko cire tsakuwar ƙoda da ta bututun fitsari (ureter), galibi ba tare da wani yanka ba.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.what: Hanyoyin sun haɗa da girgizar igiyar ruwa daga wajen jiki (ESWL), siririn na'urar dubawa mai laser da ake turawa ta hanyar fitsari (RIRS da URS), da cire manyan tsakuwoyi ta ƙaramar huda ta baya (PCNL).
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.who: Mutane masu tsakuwar ƙoda ko ta bututun fitsari da ke haddasa ciwo, kamuwa da cuta ko toshewa, ko waɗanda ba za su fita da kansu ba.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.stay: Yawanci daga rana ɗaya zuwa kwana 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.kidney-stone-treatment.recove: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin 'yan kwanaki. Ƙaramin bututu (stent) na iya zama a ciki na mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.name: Tiyatar ƙoda da ta hanyoyin fitsari ta na'urar robot
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.summa: Tiyata ta na'urar robot don matsalolin ƙoda, bututun fitsari (ureter), mafitsara da prostate, na ciwon daji da waɗanda ba ciwon daji ba.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.what: Ta amfani da robot ɗin da Vinci, likitocin tiyata suna gyara magudanar ƙoda da ta toshe (pyeloplasty), sake gina bututun fitsari (ureter), cire ciwace-ciwacen ƙoda ko prostate da magance sauran matsalolin fitsari ta ƙananan yanka.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.who: Mutane masu ƙodar da ta toshe, matsewar bututun fitsari (ureter), girman prostate, ko ciwon daji na ƙoda, mafitsara ko prostate.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.robotic-urology-surgery.recov: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4.
treatments.circumcision.name: Kaciya
treatments.circumcision.summary: Cire loɓar azzakari, saboda dalilan lafiya ko bisa zaɓi.
treatments.circumcision.what: Ana cire loɓar a ƙarƙashin maganin kashe zafi, wani lokaci da na'urar stapler ko laser, kuma a rufe fatar da ɗinkin da ke narkewa da kansa.
treatments.circumcision.who: Yara maza da maza masu matsatstsiyar loɓa (phimosis), kamuwa da cuta akai-akai, ko waɗanda suka zaɓe ta saboda al'ada ko addini.
treatments.circumcision.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.circumcision.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.hysterectomy.name: Hysterectomy (cire mahaifa ta ƙaramar huda da ta na'urar robot)
treatments.hysterectomy.summary: Cire mahaifa, yawanci ta ƙananan yanka ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.hysterectomy.what: Ana cire mahaifa, kuma wani lokaci bakin mahaifa (cervix), bututun mahaifa da mahaifar ƙwai (ovaries). Hanyoyin ƙaramar huda da na'urar robot suna nufin ƙarancin ciwo da saurin murmurewa fiye da tiyatar buɗewa.
treatments.hysterectomy.who: Mata masu ƙarin mahaifa (fibroids), zubar jini mai yawa, endometriosis, faɗuwar mahaifa (prolapse) ko yanayin kafin ciwon daji da wasu jinya ba su taimaka ba.
treatments.hysterectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hysterectomy.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.name: Cire ƙurji mai ruwa daga mahaifar ƙwai (ovarian cystectomy)
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.summary: Cire ƙurji mai ruwa (cyst) daga mahaifar ƙwai (ovary) ta ƙaramar huda, ana barin mahaifar ƙwan.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.what: Ta ƙananan yanka, ana raba ƙurjin da mahaifar ƙwai a cire shi, ana kiyaye mahaifar ƙwan da ikon haihuwa.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.who: Mata masu manyan ƙuraje masu ruwa a mahaifar ƙwai, masu ciwo ko masu daɗewa, har da endometrioma da dermoid cyst.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.ovarian-cystectomy.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.name: Salpingo-oophorectomy (cire bututun mahaifa da mahaifar ƙwai)
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.summary: Cire bututun mahaifa (fallopian tube) da mahaifar ƙwai (ovary) ɗaya ko duka biyu (gefe ɗaya ko gefe biyu).
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.what: Ana cire bututun mahaifa da mahaifar ƙwai a gefe ɗaya, ko a gefe biyu, ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.who: Mata masu ƙuraje masu ruwa ko ciwace a mahaifar ƙwai, babban haɗarin ciwon daji da aka gada (kamar BRCA), tsananin endometriosis ko kamuwa da cuta.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.salpingo-oophorectomy.recover: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4. Cire mahaifar ƙwai duka biyu yana kawo ɗaukewar haila (menopause).
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.s: Tiyata ta na'urar robot don ƙarin mahaifa (fibroids), endometriosis, faɗuwar mahaifa (prolapse) da sauran matsalolin mata.
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.w: Da robot ɗin da Vinci, likitocin tiyata suna cire ƙarin mahaifa (fibroids) tare da kiyaye mahaifa (myomectomy), cire endometriosis, gyara faɗuwar mahaifa da yin hysterectomy ta ƙananan yanka.
Matan da ke buƙatar tiyatar mata inda daidaito ke da muhimmanci, kamar ƙarin mahaifa masu sarƙaƙƙiya ko endometriosis mai zurfi.
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.s: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.robotic-gynaecology-surgery.r: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4.
treatments.sinus-surgery.name: Tiyatar sinus (FESS)
treatments.sinus-surgery.summary: Tiyata ta ƙaramar huda ta hanci don buɗe sinus da suka toshe da cire tsiro (polyps).
treatments.sinus-surgery.what: Ana tura siririyar kyamara cikin hanci, likitan tiyata kuma yana share kafofin sinus da suka toshe ya cire tsiro (polyps). Babu yanka a fuska.
treatments.sinus-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon sinus na dogon lokaci (sinusitis), tsiro a hanci (polyps) ko toshewar hanci da magunguna ba su taimaka ba.
treatments.sinus-surgery.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.sinus-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.name: Robotic thyroidectomy (tiyatar thyroid ba tare da tabo ba)
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.summary: Cire thyroid da na'urar robot ta tiyata ta yanka nesa da wuya, ba tare da barin tabon da ake gani a wuya ba.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.what: Robot ɗin yana isa thyroid ta ƙananan yanka a hammata, bayan kunne ko cikin baki. Ana cire wani ɓangare ko dukan thyroid (total thyroidectomy).
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.who: Mutane masu ƙulli a thyroid, makoko (goitre) ko ciwon daji na thyroid da ke son guje wa tabo a wuya kuma wannan hanya ta dace da su.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.robotic-thyroidectomy.recover: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2. Ana iya buƙatar shan ƙwayoyin thyroid har tsawon rayuwa.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.name: Sake gina nono
treatments.breast-reconstruction.summary: Sake gina nono bayan mastectomy, da abin sakawa (implant) ko da nama daga jikinku.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.what: Ana sake gina nono da abin sakawa na silicone, ko da fata da kitse daga ciki, baya ko cinya da aka matsar ta ƙaramar tiyatar jijiyoyi (microsurgery). Ana iya yi a lokacin mastectomy ko daga baya.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.who: Matan da aka yi musu, ko za a yi musu, mastectomy.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 6, ya danganta da hanyar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.breast-reconstruction.recover: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 8.
treatments.body-contouring.name: Tiyatar ƙawata jiki da gyaran siffar jiki
treatments.body-contouring.summary: Tiyata don sake fasalin jiki, kamar matse ciki (tummy tuck), ɗaga ko rage nono, da ɗaga damatsa da cinya.
treatments.body-contouring.what: Ana cire fata da kitse da suka sassauta a matse naman, sau da yawa bayan rage ƙiba mai yawa ko ɗaukar ciki. Sau da yawa ana haɗawa da tsotse kitse (liposuction).
treatments.body-contouring.who: Manya masu lafiya da nauyinsu ya tsaya daidai da ke son canza siffar jikinsu.
treatments.body-contouring.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.body-contouring.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin mako 2 zuwa 3. Ana sanya tufafi masu matsewa na makonni da yawa.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.name: Tiyatar gyaran fuska
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.summar: Tiyata don sabunta ko sake fasalin fuska, kamar ɗaga fuska (facelift), tiyatar fatar ido da gyaran haɓa ko kunne.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.what: Likitan tiyata yana ɗaga fata da naman da suka sauka, cire fatar ido da ta yi yawa, ko sake fasalin haɓa, kumatu ko kunnuwa, tare da ɓoye yanka a cikin layukan fuska na asali.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.who: Manya da ke son su yi kama da sabo ko su gyara wani sashe na fuska, da mutanen da ke buƙatar gyara bayan rauni.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.facial-plastic-surgery.recove: Kumburi da shatin jini suna lafawa cikin mako 2 zuwa 3.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.name: Tiyatar tabbatar da jinsi
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.summ: Tiyata don daidaita jiki da yadda mutum ya ɗauki jinsinsa, a matsayin ɓangare na tsarin kulawa da aka shirya.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.what: Tiyatar na iya haɗawa da tiyatar ƙirji, tiyatar al'aura da tiyatar fuska, waɗanda ake shiryawa tare da kulawar lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa da ta hormone.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.who: Manya masu gender dysphoria waɗanda aka yi musu tantancewar da ƙungiyar tiyata ke buƙata.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 7, ya danganta da irin tiyatar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.gender-affirming-surgery.reco: Murmurewa tana ɗaukar daga mako 2 zuwa wata 2, ya danganta da irin tiyatar.
treatments.male-genital-aesthetic-surger: Tiyatar ƙawata al'aurar maza da ta azzakari
Tiyata don gyara siffa ko girman azzakari, ko magance karkacewa ko matsalolin tashin azzakari.
Ayyukan sun haɗa da gyara karkacewa (cutar Peyronie), saka abin sakawa a azzakari (penile implant) don matsalolin tashin azzakari, da ƙawatawa.
Maza masu karkataccen azzakari, matsalolin tashin azzakari da magunguna ba sa taimakawa, ko damuwa game da kamanni.
Yawanci daga rana ɗaya zuwa kwana 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Yawancin maza suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4; jima'i bayan kusan mako 6.
Tiyatar gyaran jiki ta sabuntawa (dasa kitse da PRP)
Amfani da kitsenku, plasma ko ƙwayoyin jikinku don dawo da cika, warkar da tabo da inganta fata.
Ana ɗauko kitse ta tsotsa a hankali (liposuction), a tsabtace shi a yi masa allura inda ake buƙata. Ana amfani da platelet-rich plasma (PRP) daga jininku don taimakawa warkewa da girman gashi.
Mutane masu tabo, wuraren da suka loɓa bayan rauni ko tiyata, fatar da ta tsufa, ko raguwar gashi.
Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Kumburi yana lafawa cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.name: Tiyatar sake gina jiki
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.summar: Tiyata don dawo da siffa da aikin jiki bayan ciwon daji, rauni, ƙuna ko bambanci na haihuwa.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.what: Ana amfani da dasa fata, naman da aka matsar daga kusa (flaps) da ƙaramar tiyatar jijiyoyi (microsurgery) don gyara fuska, kai da wuya, gaɓoɓi da jiki.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.who: Mutane bayan tiyatar ciwon daji, haɗari, ƙuna, ko masu bambance-bambance na haihuwa.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.stay: Ya danganta da irin tiyatar, daga rana ɗaya zuwa mako 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.reconstructive-surgery.recove: Ya danganta da gyaran; likitan tiyata yana ba da tsari.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.na: Tiyatar baki da muƙamuƙi (oral and maxillofacial)
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.su: Tiyatar baki, muƙamuƙai da fuska, daga haƙoran hikima (wisdom teeth) zuwa gyaran muƙamuƙi.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.wh: Ya haɗa da cire haƙoran hikima da suka maƙale, tiyatar gyaran muƙamuƙi (orthognathic surgery), gyara karayar fuska da cire ƙuraje masu ruwa a muƙamuƙi.
Mutane masu haƙoran da suka maƙale, muƙamuƙin da bai daidaita ba, raunin fuska ko ƙuraje masu ruwa a muƙamuƙi.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.st: Rana ɗaya don haƙora; kwana 2 zuwa 4 don tiyatar muƙamuƙi. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.oral-maxillofacial-surgery.re: Bayan tiyatar muƙamuƙi, ana buƙatar abinci mai laushi na kusan mako 6.
treatments.back-pain-management.name: Jinyar ciwon baya (ba tare da tiyata ba)
treatments.back-pain-management.summary: Jinya don ciwon baya da wuya na dogon lokaci ta amfani da allurai, toshe jijiyoyi da jinya, sau da yawa ba tare da tiyata ba.
treatments.back-pain-management.what: Bayan hotunan na'ura sun gano dalilin, ƙwararren likitan ciwo yana amfani da allurai da aka jagoranta cikin ƙashin baya (epidural ko facet joint injections), toshe jijiyoyi ko jinyar radiofrequency don kwantar da jijiyoyin da ke ciwo, tare da tsarin physiotherapy.
treatments.back-pain-management.who: Mutane masu ciwon baya ko wuya na dogon lokaci, ciwon jijiyar ƙafa (sciatica) ko faifan ƙashin baya da ya zame (slipped disc) da ke son guje wa tiyata ko ba su da ƙarfin yin ta.
treatments.back-pain-management.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.back-pain-management.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna tafiya su fita a ranar. Sauƙi na iya ɗaukar watanni, kuma motsa jiki yana sa ya ci gaba.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.name: Motsa laka da jijiyoyi da lantarki (spinal cord stimulation)
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.summa: Ƙaramar na'ura da ake sakawa a jiki da ke aika ƙananan bugun lantarki zuwa laka (spinal cord) ko wata jijiya don toshe ciwo na dogon lokaci.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.what: Ana saka siraran wayoyi kusa da laka (ko jijiyoyin bayan kai, don occipital nerve stimulation) a haɗa su da ƙaramin batir a ƙarƙashin fata. Ana fara gwaji tukuna don tabbatar da cewa yana taimakawa.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.who: Mutane masu ciwon baya ko ƙafa na dogon lokaci bayan tiyatar ƙashin baya, ciwon jijiyoyi, ko tsananin ciwon kai da wasu jinya ba su taimaka ba.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.spinal-cord-stimulation.recov: Yawancin mutane suna komawa ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin mako 2 kuma suna guje wa sunkuyawa da ɗaukar kaya na kusan mako 6.
Tiyatar ciwace, rauni da kamuwa da cuta a ƙashin baya
Tiyata don cire ciwace daga ƙashin baya, gyara ƙashin baya da ya karye, ko share kamuwa da cuta, tare da sa ido kan jijiyoyi yayin tiyatar.

Likitan tiyata yana cire ciwacen ko naman da ya kamu da cuta kuma, inda ake buƙata, yana riƙe ƙashin baya a tsaye da ƙusoshi da sanduna. Ana lura da saƙonnin laka a duk tsawon tiyatar don kare motsi da jin jiki.
Mutane masu ciwace a ciki ko kusa da ƙashin baya, karayar ƙashin baya, ko tarin fuka (tuberculosis) ko wata cuta a ƙashin baya.
Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 10. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Murmurewa tana ɗaukar makonni zuwa watanni, tare da physiotherapy. Ƙungiyar tana shirya horon farfaɗowa kafin ku koma gida.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.name: Jinyar taruwar ruwa a ƙwaƙwalwa (VP shunt da ETV)
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.summa: Jinya don ruwan da ke taruwa a ƙwaƙwalwa, ta hanyar zubar da shi da shunt ko buɗe sabuwar hanya da endoscope.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.what: VP shunt siririn bututu ne da ke zubar da ƙarin ruwa daga ƙwaƙwalwa zuwa ciki. A endoscopic third ventriculostomy (ETV), ana amfani da kyamara don yin ƙaramar kafa don ruwan ya iya gudana da kansa.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.who: Jarirai, yara da manya masu hydrocephalus, tun daga haihuwa, saboda ciwace, zubar jini ko kamuwa da cuta.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.stay: Kusan kwana 4 don VP shunt: 1 a sashen kulawa ta musamman da 3 a ɗakin kwanciya a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hydrocephalus-treatment.recov: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.na: Allurar botulinum toxin don sandarewar tsoka da matsalolin motsi
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.su: Allurai da gwajin tsoka (EMG) ke jagoranta don sassauta tsokoki masu sandarewa ko masu aiki fiye da kima.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.wh: Likitan jijiyoyi (neurologist) yana gwada waɗanne tsokoki ke aiki fiye da kima, sannan ya yi musu allurar ƙananan adadin botulinum toxin. Tasirin yana ɗaukar kusan wata 3 kuma ana iya maimaitawa.
Mutane masu sandarewar tsoka bayan shanyewar ɓarin jiki ko raunin ƙwaƙwalwa, cerebral palsy, dystonia, murɗewar fuska (facial spasm) ko ciwon kai na migraine na dogon lokaci.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.st: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: ziyarar asibiti ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.botulinum-toxin-injections.re: Babu lokacin murmurewa. Tasirin yana farawa cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.name: Tiyatar ƙafa da idon sawu
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.summary: Tiyata don karayar ƙafa da idon sawu, nakasar yatsun ƙafa kamar bunion, ƙafa mara lanƙwasa (flat feet) da ƙafa mara ƙarfi ko shanyayyiya.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.what: Ya danganta da matsalar, likitan tiyata yana miƙe ƙasusuwan yatsu, sake gina lanƙwasar ƙafa, gyara jijiyoyin tsoka (tendons), gyara ƙasusuwan da suka karye da faranti ko ƙusoshi, ko matsar da jijiyoyin tsoka don taimaka wa ƙafar da ke faɗuwa.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.who: Mutane masu karayar ƙafa ko idon sawu, bunion, yatsun ƙafa masu lanƙwasa (hammer toes), ƙafa mara lanƙwasa, faɗuwar ƙafa (foot drop) ko nakasar ƙafa saboda shanyewa.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.foot-ankle-surgery.recovery: Ana sanya ɗamarar karaya (cast) ko takalmi na musamman na kusan mako 6. Cikakkiyar murmurewa tana ɗaukar wata 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.name: Kulawar ƙafar masu ciwon suga da raunuka na dogon lokaci
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.summary: Jinya don gyambon ƙafa da raunukan da ba sa warkewa, musamman ga masu ciwon suga, don ceton ƙafar.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.what: Ana tsaftace raunin, a cire matacce nama a magance kamuwa da cuta. Ana duba gudanar jini a inganta shi idan ana buƙata, kuma a rufe raunin da dasa fata ko flaps. Takalma na musamman suna taimakawa wajen hana sabon gyambo.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.who: Masu ciwon suga da ke da gyambon ƙafa, kamuwa da cuta ko jinkirin warkewa, da duk wanda ke da rauni ko gyambo na dogon lokaci.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.stay: Daga ziyarar asibiti zuwa mako 1 zuwa 2, ya danganta da raunin. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.diabetic-foot-care.recovery: Warkewa tana ɗaukar makonni zuwa watanni. Shawo kan sugar jini da kula da ƙafa su ne mafi muhimmanci.
treatments.limb-lengthening.name: Tsawaita gaɓa da gyaran nakasa
treatments.limb-lengthening.summary: Tiyata don miƙe ƙafa ko hannu da ya lanƙwashe, ko tsawaita gajere, wanda ake yi a hankali da wani firam ko ƙusa na musamman.
treatments.limb-lengthening.what: Ana yanke ƙashin a riƙa jan shi a hankali, kusan mm 1 a rana, da firam na waje ko ƙusa na ciki, don sabon ƙashi ya girma a gurbin. Ana iya miƙe ƙasusuwan da suka lanƙwashe ta hanya guda.
treatments.limb-lengthening.who: Yara da manya masu ƙafafu marasa tsayi ɗaya, ƙafafu masu baka ko gwiwoyi masu haɗuwa (knock knees), ko nakasa bayan karaya ko kamuwa da cuta.
treatments.limb-lengthening.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.limb-lengthening.recovery: Tsawaitawar tana ɗaukar watanni, tare da duba lafiya akai-akai da physiotherapy. Ƙungiyar tana shirya jadawalin lokaci tare da ku.
treatments.tendon-repair.name: Gyara da sake gina jijiyar tsoka (tendon)
treatments.tendon-repair.summary: Tiyata don ɗinke ko sake gina jijiyar tsoka (tendon) da ta yage a hannu, ƙafa, kafaɗa ko idon sawu.
treatments.tendon-repair.what: Ana ɗinke ƙarshen da suka yage tare, ko a sake gina jijiyar tsokar ta amfani da wata jijiyar tsoka daga wani wuri a jiki. Jinyar hannu ko physiotherapy tana dawo da motsi.
treatments.tendon-repair.who: Mutane masu yagewar jijiyar Achilles, yankakkun jijiyoyin tsoka a hannu, ko yagewar rotator cuff ko wata jijiyar tsoka.
treatments.tendon-repair.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.tendon-repair.recovery: Ana sanya ɗamarar tallafi (splint) ko takalmi na musamman na kusan mako 6. Cikakken ƙarfi yana dawowa cikin wata 3 zuwa 6.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.su: Maye gurbin gwiwa ko kwatangwalo na roba da ya lalace, ya sassauta ko ke ciwo da sabo.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.wh: Ana cire tsohon abin sakawa a saka sabo, wani lokaci tare da dasa ƙashi ko abubuwan sakawa na musamman don cike ƙashin da ya ɓace.
Mutanen da maye gurbin gwiwa ko kwatangwalonsu ya lalace, ya sassauta, ya kamu da cuta ko yake ci gaba da ciwo.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.st: Yawanci kwana 5 zuwa 7. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.revision-joint-replacement.re: Murmurewa ta fi tsawo fiye da bayan maye gurbi na farko, yawanci wata 2 zuwa 3, tare da physiotherapy.
treatments.fracture-surgery.name: Tiyatar karaya da rauni
treatments.fracture-surgery.summary: Tiyata don gyara ƙasusuwan da suka karye da faranti, ƙusoshi, sanduna ko firam don su warke a miƙe.
treatments.fracture-surgery.what: Ana jera guntattakin ƙashin a riƙe su da abubuwan sakawa na ƙarfe. Ana kuma iya gyara karaya masu sarƙaƙƙiya ko tsofaffin karaya da suka warke ba daidai ba.
treatments.fracture-surgery.who: Mutane masu ƙasusuwan da suka karye, karayar da ba ta warke ba (non-union), ko ƙasusuwan da suka warke a karkace.
treatments.fracture-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.fracture-surgery.recovery: Ƙasusuwa yawanci suna warkewa cikin mako 6 zuwa 12, tare da physiotherapy don dawo da motsi.
treatments.nerve-decompression.name: Tiyatar sakin jijiyar da aka matse (carpal tunnel da sauransu)
treatments.nerve-decompression.summary: Tiyata don sakin jijiyar da aka matse, kamar a wuyan hannu a carpal tunnel syndrome, don rage mutuwar jiki da ciwo.
treatments.nerve-decompression.what: Ana sakin matsatstsen naman da ke danne jijiyar ta ƙaramar yanka ko ta ƙaramar huda, don jijiyar ta samu sarari.
treatments.nerve-decompression.who: Mutane masu mutuwar jiki, jin kamar ƙaya ko rauni saboda matsewar jijiya a wuyan hannu, gwiwar hannu ko idon sawu.
treatments.nerve-decompression.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.nerve-decompression.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna amfani da hannun don ayyuka masu sauƙi cikin 'yan kwanaki kuma suna komawa yadda suke cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
treatments.tavi.name: TAVI (maye gurbin bawul ɗin aortic ta catheter)
treatments.tavi.summary: Sabon bawul ɗin aortic da ake sakawa ta jijiyar jini a ƙafa, ba tare da buɗe ƙirji ba.
treatments.tavi.what: Ana jagorantar naɗaɗɗen bawul a kan siririn bututu daga gindin cinya (groin) zuwa zuciya a buɗe shi a cikin tsohon bawul ɗin da ya matse.
treatments.tavi.who: Mutane masu tsananin matsewar bawul ɗin aortic (aortic stenosis), musamman tsofaffi ko waɗanda ke da babban haɗari daga tiyatar buɗe zuciya.
treatments.tavi.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.tavi.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.name: Balloon valvuloplasty (buɗe bawul da balan-balan)
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.summary: Balan-balan da ake turawa ta jijiyar jini yana buɗe bawul ɗin zuciya da ya matse, ba tare da tiyata ba.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.what: Ana jagorantar siririn bututu mai balan-balan zuwa bawul ɗin da ya matse a hura shi don faɗaɗa bawul ɗin.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.who: Yara da manya masu matsewar bawul ɗin mitral, pulmonary ko aortic, sau da yawa saboda cutar zuciya ta rheumatic ko lahani na haihuwa.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 2. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.balloon-valvuloplasty.recover: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako ɗaya.
treatments.vascular-surgery.name: Tiyatar kumburin aorta da ta jijiyoyin jini
treatments.vascular-surgery.summary: Tiyata ko stent graft don gyara babbar jijiyar jini da ta kumbura ko ta toshe, kamar kumburin aorta (aortic aneurysm).
treatments.vascular-surgery.what: Ana ƙarfafa ɓangaren aorta mai rauni da ya kumbura da stent graft da ake sakawa ta gindin cinya (EVAR ko TEVAR), ko a maye gurbinsa a tiyatar buɗewa. Ana kuma iya share ko kewaye jijiyoyin jini da suka toshe a wuya da ƙafafu.
treatments.vascular-surgery.who: Mutane masu kumburin aorta ko yagewarta (dissection), matsewar jijiyoyin wuya (carotid), ko jijiyoyin ƙafa da suka toshe sosai.
treatments.vascular-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4 da stent graft; kwana 7 zuwa 10 bayan tiyatar buɗewa. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.vascular-surgery.recovery: Daga mako 2 bayan stent graft zuwa mako 6 zuwa 8 bayan tiyatar buɗewa.
treatments.lung-surgery.name: Tiyatar huhu (ta ƙaramar huda da ta buɗewa)
treatments.lung-surgery.summary: Cire wani ɓangare na huhu saboda ciwon daji, ƙuraje masu ruwa ko kamuwa da cuta, sau da yawa ta ƙaramar huda (VATS) ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.lung-surgery.what: Ana cire wani sashe, lobe ko, ba safai ba, dukan huhu. Tiyata ta ƙaramar huda tana amfani da ƙananan yanka tsakanin haƙarƙari, tare da saurin murmurewa.
treatments.lung-surgery.who: Mutane masu ciwon daji na huhu, ƙuraje masu ruwa a huhu, huhun da ya lalace saboda kamuwa da cuta ko tarin fuka (tuberculosis), ko huhun da ke yawan faɗuwa (collapsed lung).
treatments.lung-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 4 zuwa 7. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.lung-surgery.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 6. Motsa jiki na numfashi yana taimakawa.
treatments.lung-transplant.name: Dashen huhu
treatments.lung-transplant.summary: Maye gurbin huhu ɗaya ko duka biyu da ke kasawa da lafiyayyun huhu daga mamaci mai bayarwa.
treatments.lung-transplant.what: Ana cire huhun da ke da cuta a haɗa huhun mai bayarwa da hanyar iska da jijiyoyin jini. Ana shan magungunan hana jiki ƙin sabon gaɓa har tsawon rayuwa.
