treatments.lung-transplant.who: Mutane masu cutar huhu ta matakin ƙarshe, kamar pulmonary fibrosis ko tsananin COPD, da wata jinya ba za ta iya taimakawa ba.
treatments.lung-transplant.stay: Yawanci mako 3 zuwa 4 a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.lung-transplant.recovery: Ku shirya zama a Indiya na kusan wata 3 don a riƙa duba ku sosai da horon farfaɗowa.
treatments.poem.name: POEM don achalasia (endoscopic myotomy)
treatments.poem.summary: Aikin da ake yi ta baki da ke sassauta matsatstsiyar tsokar makogwaron abinci don abinci ya sake wucewa, ba tare da yanka a jiki ba.
treatments.poem.what: Da amfani da endoscope, likita yana yin rami a cikin bangon makogwaron abinci ya yanke matsatstsiyar tsokar da ke ƙarshensa na ƙasa.
treatments.poem.who: Mutane masu achalasia da sauran matsalolin haɗiya inda abinci ke maƙalewa a ƙirji.
treatments.poem.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.poem.recovery: Abinci mai ruwa sannan mai laushi na kusan mako 2. Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako ɗaya.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.name: Capsule endoscopy da endoscopy na ƙaramin hanji
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.summary: Kyamarar ƙwaya da ake haɗiyewa, ko dogon endoscope, don duba cikin ƙaramin hanji inda na'urorin dubawa na yau da kullum ba sa isa.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.what: A capsule endoscopy kuna haɗiye kyamara mai girman ƙwayar magani da ke ɗaukar hotuna yayin da take wucewa. Balloon ko spiral enteroscopy tana amfani da dogon na'urar dubawa don gani da jinya, kamar dakatar da zubar jini.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.who: Mutane masu zubar jini ko ƙarancin jini (anaemia) da ba a san dalilinsu ba, ana zargin cutar Crohn, ko ciwace a ƙaramin hanji.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti don capsule; rana ɗaya ko dare ɗaya don enteroscopy. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.capsule-endoscopy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum a ranar ko washegari.
treatments.endoscopic-sleeve-gastroplast: Rage girman ciki da ɗinkin da ake yi ta baki, don rage ƙiba ba tare da yanka ba.
A ƙarƙashin maganin kashe zafi, ana tura endoscope cikin ciki, kuma ɗinkuna suna naɗe shi ya zama kunkuntar bututu, don ku ji ƙoshi da wuri.
Mutane masu ƙiba sosai (obesity) da ba sa son, ko ba su cancanci, tiyatar rage ƙiba ba.
Yawanci dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Abinci mai ruwa sannan mai laushi na 'yan makonni. Yawancin mutane suna komawa aiki cikin mako ɗaya.
treatments.splenectomy.name: Cire saifa ta ciki (splenectomy)
treatments.splenectomy.summary: Cire saifa ta ciki (spleen) ta ƙaramar huda, saboda cututtukan jini, rauni ko girman saifa.
treatments.splenectomy.what: Ana cire saifar (spleen) ta ƙananan yanka. Ana ba da allurar rigakafi kafin ko bayan haka don kariya daga kamuwa da cututtuka.
treatments.splenectomy.who: Mutane masu wasu cututtukan jini (kamar ITP ko thalassaemia), saifar (spleen) da ta yi girma ko ta ji rauni, ko ƙurji mai ruwa ko ciwace a saifar.
treatments.splenectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.splenectomy.recovery: Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 4.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.name: Tiyatar yara (ta yara da ta jarirai)
treatments.paediatric-surgery.summary: Tiyata ga jarirai da yara, daga hernia da lahani na haihuwa zuwa tiyatar ƙirji, hanji da hanta masu sarƙaƙƙiya.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.what: Likitocin tiyatar yara suna magance cututtukan da ke tun haihuwa da na lokacin yarinta, sau da yawa ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot da ta dace da ƙananan jiki, tare da sashen kulawa ta musamman na yara a shirye.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.who: Jarirai da yara masu lahani na haihuwa a hanji, makogwaron abinci, huhu ko ƙoda, hernia, ƙwalatan da ba su sauka ba, ko ciwace.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.stay: Daga rana ɗaya zuwa mako 2, ya danganta da irin tiyatar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.paediatric-surgery.recovery: Yara sau da yawa suna murmurewa da sauri. Likitan tiyata yana ba da tsari don ɗanku.
treatments.myomectomy.name: Myomectomy (cire ƙarin mahaifa, ana barin mahaifa)
treatments.myomectomy.summary: Cire ƙarin mahaifa (fibroids) tare da barin mahaifa, ta ƙaramar huda, ta na'urar robot ko ta tiyatar buɗewa.
treatments.myomectomy.what: Ana yanke kowane ƙari a ɗinke mahaifar, don ɗaukar ciki a nan gaba ya kasance mai yiwuwa.
treatments.myomectomy.who: Mata masu ƙarin mahaifa (fibroids) da ke haddasa haila mai yawa, ciwo, matsi ko wahalar ɗaukar ciki, waɗanda ke son kiyaye mahaifarsu.
treatments.myomectomy.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.myomectomy.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 2 zuwa 6.
treatments.hysteroscopy.name: Hysteroscopy (cire tsiro da ƙari a cikin mahaifa)
treatments.hysteroscopy.summary: Siririyar kyamara da ake turawa ta bakin mahaifa (cervix) don duba cikin mahaifa da cire tsiro (polyps), ƙananan ƙari (fibroids) ko naman tabo.
treatments.hysteroscopy.what: Ba a yin yanka. Ta kyamarar, likita na iya ɗaukar samfur, cire tsiro ko ƙari, ko na'urar hana haihuwa (coil) da ta ɓace.
treatments.hysteroscopy.who: Mata masu zubar jini mai yawa ko mara tsari, zubar jini bayan ɗaukewar haila, tsiro (polyps), ko matsalolin ɗaukar ciki.
treatments.hysteroscopy.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.hysteroscopy.recovery: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin kwana 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.prolapse-repair.name: Gyaran faɗuwar gaɓoɓin ƙugu (prolapse)
treatments.prolapse-repair.summary: Tiyata don ɗagawa da tallafa wa mahaifa, mafitsara ko hanjin da ya sauka cikin farji.
treatments.prolapse-repair.what: Ana gyara tallafin da suka raunana ta farji ko ta ƙaramar huda, wani lokaci tare da hysterectomy.
treatments.prolapse-repair.who: Mata masu jin wani abu yana fitowa ko nauyi, ko matsalolin mafitsara ko hanji saboda faɗuwar gaɓoɓi (prolapse).
treatments.prolapse-repair.stay: Yawanci kwana 1 zuwa 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.prolapse-repair.recovery: Ku guji ɗaukar abu mai nauyi na kusan mako 6.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.name: Tiyatar sake gina farji da labiaplasty
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.summar: Tiyata don gyara ko sake fasalin farji da leɓɓan farji (labia), bayan haihuwa, rauni ko don jin daɗi.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.what: Ana gyara a matse naman da ya miƙe ko ya yage, ko a sake fasalin leɓɓan farji, a ƙarƙashin maganin kashe zafi.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.who: Mata masu lalacewa bayan haihuwa, yoyon fitsari ko bayan gida (fistula), rashin jin daɗi, ko damuwa game da kamanni.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.stay: Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.vaginal-reconstruction.recove: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2; ku guji jima'i na kusan mako 6.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.name: Kulawar ciki mai haɗari da haihuwa
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.summ: Kulawa ta kusa ga cikin da ke da ƙarin haɗari, da haihuwa da aka shirya tare da kulawa ta musamman ga uwa da jariri a shirye.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.what: Likitocin haihuwa (obstetricians) suna lura da magance yanayi kamar hawan jini, ciwon suga a lokacin ciki, tagwaye ko rashin girman jariri yadda ya kamata, kuma suna shirya haihuwa lafiya ta farji ko ta tiyata (caesarean), tare da sashen kulawa ta musamman na jarirai.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.who: Mata masu tagwaye, pre-eclampsia, ciwon suga na lokacin ciki, ɓarin ciki a baya ko wasu haɗari.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 4 bayan haihuwa. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.high-risk-pregnancy-care.reco: Ƙungiyar tana shirya duba lafiyar uwa da jariri bayan haihuwa.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.name: Tiyatar ciwon daji na farji na waje (vulvectomy)
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.summary: Cire ciwon daji na farji na waje (vulva), tare da ƙwayoyin lymph daga gindin cinya (groin) inda ake buƙata.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.what: Ana cire wani ɓangare (hemivulvectomy) ko dukan (radical vulvectomy) farji na waje tare da ɗan lafiyayyen nama a gefensa, kuma a sake gina wurin inda ake buƙata.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.who: Mata masu ciwon daji na farji na waje (vulva) ko wasu yanayin kafin ciwon daji.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.stay: Yawanci kwana 3 zuwa 7. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.vulvar-cancer-surgery.recover: Yawancin mata suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 4 zuwa 8.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.name: Tiyatar sake gina hanyoyin fitsari (matsewar urethra da sauransu)
treatments.reconstructive-urology.summar: Tiyata don gyara bututun fitsari (urethra) da ya matse ko sake gina hanyoyin fitsari bayan rauni ko tiyata ta baya.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.what: Ana buɗe ɓangaren da ya matse ko a maye gurbinsa da nama daga baki ko wani wuri, don fitsari ya sake gudana ba tare da tsaiko ba.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.who: Maza da mata masu matsewar urethra (urethral stricture), rauni a hanyoyin fitsari, ko matsaloli bayan tiyata ta baya.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.stay: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.reconstructive-urology.recove: Bututun fitsari (catheter) yana zama a ciki na mako 1 zuwa 3. Yawancin mutane suna komawa yadda suke cikin mako 4 zuwa 6.
Jinya don zubar fitsari, daga sling da allurai zuwa tiyatar mafitsara.

Don zubar fitsari saboda matsi, sling yana tallafa wa urethra. Don mafitsara mai aiki fiye da kima, magunguna, allurar Botox cikin mafitsara ko motsa jijiyoyi suna taimakawa. Bladder augmentation yana faɗaɗa ƙaramar mafitsara.
Mata da maza da ke zubar da fitsari idan suka yi tari ko dariya, ko waɗanda ke jin fitsari kwatsam mai ƙarfi.
Yawanci ana yi a rana ɗaya a koma gida, ko dare ɗaya. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
Yawancin mutane suna komawa harkokinsu na yau da kullum cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.paediatric-urology.name: Tiyatar hanyoyin fitsari ta yara
treatments.paediatric-urology.summary: Tiyata don matsalolin ƙoda, mafitsara da al'aura na yara, sau da yawa ta ƙaramar huda ko ta na'urar robot.
treatments.paediatric-urology.what: Likitocin tiyata suna gyara ƙodar da ta toshe, fitsarin da ke komawa zuwa ƙoda (reflux), ƙwalatan da ba su sauka ba, hypospadias da sauran yanayin da ake haihuwar yara da su.
treatments.paediatric-urology.who: Jarirai da yara masu hydronephrosis, reflux, hypospadias, ƙwalatan da ba su sauka ba ko matsalolin mafitsara.
treatments.paediatric-urology.stay: Yawanci daga rana ɗaya zuwa kwana 3. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.paediatric-urology.recovery: Yara yawanci suna murmurewa cikin mako 1 zuwa 2.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.name: Jinyar ƙuna da sake gina tabon ƙuna
treatments.burn-reconstruction.summary: Kulawa ga sabbin ƙuna da tiyata don sakin matsatstsun tabon ƙuna da dawo da motsi da kamanni.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.what: Dasa fata da flaps suna rufe wuraren da suka ƙone. Don tsofaffin ƙuna, ana sakin matsatstsun tabon da ke hana motsi a sake gina fatar, tare da laser da jinyar matsewa don inganta tabon.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.who: Mutane masu sabbin ƙuna, ko tsofaffin tabon ƙuna da suka matse, suke ciwo ko suke hana motsi.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.stay: Daga rana ɗaya zuwa makonni da yawa, ya danganta da ƙunar. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.burn-reconstruction.recovery: Kulawar tabo da jinya suna ci gaba na watanni.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.s: Tiyata don dawo da motsi da daidaito ga fuskar da ta raunana saboda lalacewar jijiya.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.w: Matsar da jijiyoyi, matsar da tsokoki ta ƙaramar tiyatar jijiyoyi (microsurgery) da slings na tsaye suna taimakawa wajen dawo da murmushi, rufe ido da daidaitacciyar fuska.
Mutane masu shanyewar fuska saboda Bell's palsy da bai warke ba, tiyata, rauni ko tun haihuwa.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.s: Yawanci kwana 2 zuwa 5. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.facial-palsy-reconstruction.r: Motsi yana inganta a hankali cikin wata 6 zuwa 12, tare da jinyar fuska.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.name: Jinyar fata, tabo da laser (dermatology)
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.summary: Laser da ƙananan ayyuka don tabon kuraje, tawadar Allah (moles), kyasuwa (warts), ƙananan tsiron fata, fararen tabo a fata (vitiligo) da zubar gashi a wurare-wurare.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.what: Jinyar sun haɗa da laser na CO2 da dermabrasion don tabon kuraje, radiocautery don cire tsiro, tiyatar ƙusa, da jinya don vitiligo da alopecia areata.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.who: Mutane masu tabon kuraje, tsiron da ba a so, vitiligo, zubar gashi a wurare-wurare ko wasu damuwar fata.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.stay: Babu kwanciya a asibiti: zama a asibiti. Asibitinku ne zai tabbatar da shi don al'amarinku.
treatments.skin-laser-treatments.recover: Ja yawanci yana lafawa cikin 'yan kwanaki zuwa mako 2.

hospitals.kenia-eye.overview: Asibitin ido na ƙwararru a Santacruz, Mumbai, wanda ke kula da majiyyata tun 1998. Dr. Vaishal Kenia ne ke jagorantarsa, likitan fiɗar yanar ido (cataract) da gyaran gani, tare da ƙungiyar likitoci da masu ba da shawara da ke kula da kowane ɓangare na lafiyar ido. An amince masa ya yi dashen cornea kuma yana da laser mara reza na FEMTO Z8 NEO, na farko a Yammacin Indiya, tare da na'urorin hoto na zamani kamar IOL Master 700, Pentacam, Verion da hoton retina mai faɗi na OPTOS. Yana magance komai daga yanar ido da LASIK zuwa matsalolin cornea, glaucoma, retina, ƙyallin ido da fatar ido. Kenia Dental Clinic, wadda Dr. Pallavi Kenia ke gudanarwa, tana cikin gini ɗaya.

hospitals.kenia-dental.overview: Asibitin haƙori mai fannoni da dama a Santacruz (West), Mumbai, wanda Dr. Pallavi Kenia ke jagoranta, likitar haƙori fiye da shekaru 20. Ta yi shekaru takwas a Jain Health Centre, wata cibiyar agaji a Dadar, Mumbai, inda ta yi wa majiyyata fiye da 100,000 magani, kafin ta buɗe Kenia Dental Clinic don ba da magani na zamani a farashi mai sauƙi. Aikinta ya fi mayar da hankali kan maganin tushen haƙori (root canal), dashen haƙori, tsara murmushi da farar da haƙori, kuma asibitin yana kuma kula da haƙoran yara, wayar haƙori da aligners, kambi (crown), haƙoran roba da kulawar rigakafi. Yana cikin gini ɗaya da Kenia Eye Hospital.

hospitals.wockhardt-mumbai-central.accre: Mai takardar shaidar JCI (Amurka) da NABH (Indiya)
hospitals.wockhardt-mumbai-central.overv: Babban asibitin Wockhardt Hospitals a Kudancin Mumbai. Wockhardt Hospitals ita ce ƙungiyar asibitocin manyan jinya mai fannoni da yawa mafi girma a yammacin Indiya, mai asibitoci 5 da gadaje 1,050. Wannan asibiti gini ne mai hawa 20 mai gadaje 350, gadajen kulawa ta musamman (ICU) 100, ɗakunan tiyata na zamani 8, ɗakunan binciken zuciya (cath lab) guda biyu, sashen zuciyar yara mafi girma a Kudancin Mumbai da babban sashen haɗari da gaggawa. Ƙungiyar ta yi jinyar marasa lafiya fiye da 63,000 daga ƙasashe sama da 100 a cikin shekaru 11 da suka wuce, kuma da yawa daga cikin likitocinta sun yi karatu ko aiki a Amurka, Birtaniya da Turai. posts.bilateral-hand-transplant-nanavati: Dashen hannaye biyu ya dawo wa matashi ɗan shekara 18 hannayensa
Wani matashin manomi da ya rasa hannayensa biyu a hatsari ya karɓi hannaye biyu daga mai bayarwa a tiyatar awa 13 a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.

A watan Janairu 2024, wani ɗan manomi ɗan shekara 18 daga Gujarat ya rasa hannayensa biyu a hatsari da injin gona. Raunin murƙushewa ya yi tsanani sosai da ba za a iya gyara shi ba, kuma dole aka yanke hannayen biyu.

Bayan cikakkun gwaje-gwajen lafiya, na tunani da na garkuwar jiki, likitoci sun ga ya dace da dashen hannaye biyu. Hannayen masu bayarwa ba su da yawa kuma dole su dace sosai, don haka ya jira watanni 13.

A watan Janairu 2026 iyalin wata mace ʼyar shekara 50 da ta rasu a Surat sun amince su ba da gudummawar sassan jikinta. Huhunta, hantarta da cornea ɗinta sun tafi ga majiyyata a Mumbai da Surat, hannayenta kuma gare shi. Ƙungiyoyi a Gujarat da Maharashtra sun yi aiki tare don kawo hannayen zuwa Mumbai cikin ɗan gajeren lokacin da ake da shi.

An yi tiyatar a daren 9 zuwa 10 ga Janairu 2026, ƙarƙashin jagorancin Dr Nilesh Satbhai, Daraktan Tiyatar Gyaran Jiki, Sake Gina Jiki ta Microsurgery da Dashen Hannu. Cikin awa 13 ƙungiyar ta ɗaure ƙasusuwa, ta haɗa jijiyoyin jini, ta gyara tendon, ta haɗa jijiyoyin ji kuma ta rufe fata. Jini ya gudana cikin hannayen biyu da zarar an haɗa jijiyoyin.

Bayan haka ƙungiya ta kula da shi wadda ta sarrafa magani don hana jiki ƙin hannayen, ta sa ido sosai kan gudanar jini, ta hana kamuwa da cuta kuma ta fara gyaran motsi da wuri. Wannan shi ne dashen hannaye biyu na farko a Nanavati Max.

Dashen hannu ya fi dashen gaɓar ciki wuya, domin yana ɗauko fata, tsoka, tendon, ƙashi, jijiyoyin jini da jijiyoyin ji tare, kuma jiki yana iya ƙin fata sosai. Idan ya yi nasara, zai iya dawo da ji da motsi mai daidaito wanda hannun roba ba zai iya ba.
Idan ku ko wani a cikin iyalinku ya rasa hannu ko damtse, ku aiko mana da rahotannin lafiya. Ƙwararre zai gaya muku ko dashe ko sake gina jiki zai iya taimakawa.
Majiyyacin tare da likitoci, ma'aikatan jinya da ma'aikatan Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital da suka kula da shi

posts.thumb-reconstruction-toddler-nanav: An haife ta ba babban yatsa: yadda likitocin fiɗa suka sake gina damƙar wata ƙaramar yarinya
Wata jaririya da aka haifa da tsananin naƙasar babban yatsa a hannayenta biyu yanzu tana iya damƙa da riƙe abu, bayan tiyata biyu a Nanavati Max Super Speciality Hospital, Mumbai.

An haifi wata ƙaramar yarinya ba babban yatsa a hannun hagu, kuma babban yatsan hannun damanta bai girma isasshe da za a yi amfani da shi ba. Ba tare da manyan yatsu masu aiki ba, yaro yana shan wahala wajen koyon kama, tsunkula da riƙe abubuwa.

Dr Nilesh G Satbhai, Daraktan Tiyatar Gyaran Jiki, Sake Gina Jiki ta Microsurgery da Dashen Hannu, da ƙungiyarsa sun tsara tiyata biyu. Jijiyoyin jininta da jijiyoyin jinta ƙanana ne sosai, wanda ya sa aikin ya zama mai laushi, kuma saboda hannayen biyu ne abin ya shafa, dole tiyatocin biyu su yi nasara.

Tiyatar farko, a watan Disamba 2025, ta ƙarfafa raunannen babban yatsan dama kuma ta ɗauko wata tsoka daga tafin hannunta domin babban yatsan ya iya juyawa ya taɓa sauran yatsu. Cikin ʼyan makonni ta fara amfani da shi.

Ta biyu, a watan Fabrairu 2026, ta gina sabon babban yatsa na hagu ta hanyar ɗauko yatsan ƙafa na biyu daga ƙafarta ta hagu zuwa hannunta da haɗa jijiyoyin jininsa, jijiyoyin ji da tendon ƙarƙashin madubin hangen nesa. Likitocin fiɗa sun kuma sake gina ƙafar domin ta ci gaba da aiki kamar yadda aka saba.
Tana da watanni 13 tana iya riƙe yatsun iyayenta. Tiyata irin wannan ta fi aiki idan aka yi ta da wuri, yayin da yaro yake koyon amfani da hannayensa.
Idan an haifi ɗanku da bambancin hannu, ku aiko mana da hotuna da duk wani rahoto. Ƙwararre zai ba ku shawara kan abin da za a iya yi da lokacin yin sa.

bodyAreas.neck.name: Wuya
bodyAreas.neck.hint: Ciwon wuya ko mutuwar hannu saboda faifan ƙashin baya da ya lalace, ƙulli a thyroid, ko ciwon daji a maƙogwaro, akwatin murya ko wuya.
bodyAreas.chest.name: Ƙirji, zuciya da nono
bodyAreas.chest.hint: Ciwon ƙirji, jijiyoyin zuciya da suka toshe, bawul mara kyau, bugun zuciya mara daidai, gazawar zuciya, matsalar zuciyar yaro, ciwace a huhu ko ƙulli a nono.

bodyAreas.belly.hint: Tsakuwar jakar bile, hernia, ciwon appendix, kitse a hanta ko cirrhosis, matsalolin ciki ko hanji, ciwon daji na hanta, saifa (pancreas), ciki ko hanji, ko ƙibar da ke barazana ga lafiya.

bodyAreas.kidneys.hint: Tsakuwar ƙoda, ƙodojin da suka daina aiki, wankin ƙoda (dialysis), ƙodar da ta toshe, ko tsiro a ƙoda.
bodyAreas.spine.name: Ƙashin baya
bodyAreas.spine.hint: Faifan ƙashin baya da ya zame ko ya lalace, ƙashin baya mai karkacewa (scoliosis), ciwace ko rauni a ƙashin baya, ko ciwon baya na dogon lokaci.

bodyAreas.upper-back.hint: Ciwo tsakanin ƙasusuwan kafaɗa, ƙashin baya mai karkacewa ko mai lanƙwasa, ko matsala a saman ƙashin baya.
bodyAreas.middle-back.name: Tsakiyar baya
bodyAreas.middle-back.hint: Ciwo a tsakiyar baya, karayar ƙashin baya, ko ciwo daga ƙoda a gefuna.
bodyAreas.lower-back.name: Ƙasan baya
bodyAreas.lower-back.hint: Ciwon ƙasan baya, ciwon jijiyar ƙafa (sciatica) ko ciwon ƙafa saboda faifan da ya zame, ko ƙashin baya da ya lalace ko ke zamewa.
bodyAreas.pelvis.name: Mahaifa, mafitsara, prostate da haihuwa
bodyAreas.pelvis.hint: Wahalar ɗaukar ciki, ƙarin mahaifa (fibroids), ƙuraje masu ruwa ko zubar jini mai yawa, matsalolin prostate ko mafitsara, ko ciwon daji na mahaifa, mahaifar ƙwai, bakin mahaifa, mafitsara, prostate ko ƙwalatai.

bodyAreas.hips.hint: Ciwon kwatangwalo, sandarewa, yagewar guringuntsin kwatangwalo ko gaɓar kwatangwalo da ta lalace.
bodyAreas.knees.name: Gwiwoyi
bodyAreas.knees.hint: Ciwon gwiwa saboda ciwon gaɓoɓi (arthritis), yagewar jijiyar haɗa ƙashi (ligament) ko meniscus, ko guringuntsin da ya lalace bayan raunin wasanni.
bodyAreas.legs.name: Ƙafafu
bodyAreas.legs.hint: Varicose veins, ciwon ƙafa yayin tafiya, raunin idon sawu, ciwace a ƙashi, ƙafar da ta ji mummunan rauni, ko ƙafa mai kumburi.
bodyAreas.feet.name: Idon sawu da ƙafafu
bodyAreas.feet.hint: Ciwon idon sawu ko ƙafa, targaɗen da bai lafa ba, bunion ko yatsun ƙafa masu lanƙwasa, ƙafa mara lanƙwasa (flat feet), faɗuwar ƙafa (foot drop), ko gyambon ƙafar masu ciwon suga.
bodyAreas.hands.name: Damtse da hannaye
bodyAreas.hands.hint: Ciwo ko sandarewar kafaɗa, gwiwar hannu ko wuyan hannu, yagewar jijiyar tsokar kafaɗa, hannayen da suka ji rauni ko suka sandare, raunin hannu bayan raunin jijiya, ko hannu mai kumburi.

wholeBody.cancer.hint: Magungunan cutar daji a duk inda take a jiki. Likitoci sau da yawa suna haɗa su.
